hero.sub: Vortex peer-to-peer network atana thil hmuhchhuah & verification controller a ni. Hawng. Encrypted a ni. Titawp theih loh.

network.label: NETWORK a ni.
network.body: Peer tin hian signed identity an nei vek a. Client te hian an connect hmain an verify hmasa thin a, node te hian registration ah ownership an prove thin. Crypography-in a nemnghet tawh chu central authority engmahin a fake thei lo.
network.stat_online_sub: active connection te a awm bawk
network.dual_body: Controller AND-ah register a ni a, Solana kaltlangin on-chain-ah seal a ni. Independent witness pahnih chuan code hash leh pubkey te chu an nemnghet. Sensitive session atan a him.
network.ctrl_body: Signature hian node hian a private key a nei tih a finfiah a, mahse code integrity hi on-chain-ah anchor a ni lo. Session tam zawkah chuan fine; risk = controller operator rintlak.
network.unverif_body: Config emaw gossip emaw atanga hriat a ni. Cryptographic proof a la awm lo. Peer list bootstrap nan chauh hmang rawh — live session-a handoff target atan hmang ngai lo.
network.cta_browse: Node zawng zawng browse vek rawh →

security.label: SECURITY a ni.
security.heading_line2: cryptographic model hmanga siam a ni
security.body: Independent Ed25519 keypair pali, hna tawi tak pakhat theuh nei. Key pakhat eng pawh inremna hian a dangte a tichhia lo.
security.release_verified: Clients — build laiin pin an ni
security.node_verified: Controller — registration tih a nih chuan
security.user_signs: Session token, message envelope te pawh a awm bawk
security.step1_d: vortexx.sol chu on-chain-in chhiar rawh. Solana wallet-in record a sign — DNS-hijack theih loh.
security.step2_d: Client chuan /v1/integrity a call a. Pinned release key atanga status: verified tih loh chu chhanna engmah a hnawl.
security.step3_d: API call apiangin {payload, sig, signed_by} a rawn let leh thin. Client chuan Ed25519 signature chu a rin hmain a verify hmasa thin.
security.step4_d: Sealed nodes: client hian Solana registry atang hian code_hash a chhiar thin. Controller atanga inthliarna = blacklist-a awm reng.
security.check_auth: Response authenticity — controller private key tel lo chuan /v1/nodes forge theih loh.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — controller file te chu startup apiangah hash leh cross-check a ni. Tampering hian eng traffic pawh service a nih hmain 503 a rawn kir leh thin.
security.check_identity: Node identity — node te chuan anmahni key hmangin registration an sign tur a ni. Attacker chuan node dang pubkey aiawhin a register thei lo.
security.check_dns: DNS hijack venhimna — .sol records chu Solana-ah live-in a awm. Hmelma chuan DNS registrar chauh ni lovin wallet chu a tihchhiat a ngai a ni.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — session transfer-ah hian Ed25519-a signed tokens anti-replay nei, minute 5 chauh hman theih a ni. Target hian source hriat loh a hnawl.
security.check_transport: Transport privacy — connection URL i ISP / Cloudflare hmuh theih. Metadata a pawimawh chuan Tor mirror hmang rawh.
security.check_content: Message content — NOT controller-in a khawih. User te inkara end-to-end encrypted a ni. Controller hian fully compromised pawh nise engmah a chhiar thei lo.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — VPS chu root a nih chuan key rukbo theih a ni. Paranoid deployment atan hardware-backed signing hmang rawh.

access.label: ACCESS a ni.
access.heading_line1: Engtik lai pawhin thlen theih a ni.
access.heading_line2: Engtik lai pawhin i ta a ni.
access.body: Multiple entry point tih awmzia chu entity pakhat mahin i access chu a block thei lo tihna a ni. Mirror site-ah hian independent infrastructure atanga signed content inang chiah chiah an rawn pe a.
access.tunnel_body: *.trycloudflare.com address a thlawna hman theih a ni. Account a ngai lo. URL chu tunnel a start leh hunah a danglam thin — ephemeral anga ngaih.
access.tor_body: .onion address, Tor kaltlangin chauh thlen theih a ni. Censor-proof leh metadata-private, mahse a slow zawk. Tor client a mamawh.
access.ipfs_body: Static frontend atanga content-addressed copy a awm. IPFS gateway eng pawhin a service thei — server pakhat mah block tur a awm lo.
access.direct_body: Domain pangngai + TLS. A chak ber option. DNS/IP level-ah block theih — censor a nih chuan midangte hnenah tlak leh rawh.
access.mirrors_body: He controller ang chiah chiah signed content rawngbâwltu host dang. Mirror tin hi a hun hunah an probe thin — green dot tih awmzia chu minute 5 hnuhnung berah thlen theih a ni. Tor .onion mirror hi local Tor proxy tel lo chuan health-check theih a ni lo.

start.label: GET STARTED tih a ni.
start.step1: I device — mobile emaw desktop emaw ah Vortex install rawh.
start.step2: Setup wizard ah Global network mode kha thlang la.
start.step3: Controller URL (auto-resolved via SNS) emaw entry URL eng pawh Entries page atang hian paste rawh.
start.step4: I app-a pubkey chu a hnuaia controller fingerprint nen a inmil tih finfiah rawh. Mismatch tih awmzia chu tampering tihna a ni.
start.step5: I connect tawh a ni. Node list, signatures, leh routing te hi automatically hmanga enkawl a ni.
start.fingerprint_note: Response engmah i rin hmain he key hi i client ah pin hmasa phawt ang che.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS tih a ni.
treasury.transparency_title: On-chain-a langtlang taka kalpui a ni
treasury.transparency_body: Protocol fee zawng zawng — node register fee leh premium subscription 20% tihtlem — chu Solana-a treasury wallet-ah a luang lut vek a ni. Transaction zawng zawng hi tu pawhin vantlang hriatah an finfiah theih vek a ni.
treasury.rewards_body: Premium sub tin atanga 70% chu rewards pool-ah a kal a, active node operator-te hnenah pro-rata-in sem a ni. 20% chuan core development atan sum a pe a ni. 10% chu a kang emaw, insurance angin a thu emaw.

Ṭawng dangin library, callback leh boilerplate an mamawhna hmunah chuan Gravitix hian first-class event handler, conversation flows, leh built-in state a pe che a — chu zawng zawng chu Rust aṭanga inspired syntax thianghlim, chhiar awlsam takah a pe vek a ni.

error.p2: finally hi unconditionally-in a kal a — try-in a hlawhtlin emaw, catch-in error a handle emaw. Resources release nan emaw, log emaw, completion message thawn nan emaw hmang rawh.

math_special.p4: Bessel function Jₙ(x) leh Y3(x) te hi Bessel-a differential equation solution an ni a: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Wave propagation, cylinder-a heat conduction, leh quantum mechanics-ah te an lang a ni.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) leh Bi(x) te hi y'' = xy solution a ni. Quantum tunneling (WKB approximation) leh optics (diffraction) ah te an lang thin.
math_special.p6: Heng polynomial chhungkua te hi operator pawimawh tak takte eigenfunction angin an lo piang a, spectral method, quadrature, leh quantum mechanics-ah te hman a ni.
math_special.p7: K(k) leh E(k) te hi elliptic integral kimchang tak, chi khatna leh chi hnihna an ni. Nonlinear pendulum period leh ellipse perimeter an chhut chhuak thin.

architexDocs.title: Architex Ṭawng hman dan tur
architexDocs.subtitle: Vortex Mini Apps tan declarative UI tawng. Reactive state, composable layouts, zero build step te a awm bawk.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex hi declarative te tak te DSL a ni a, Vortex messenger chhunga UI thawn chhuah theih tura duan a ni. Screen chu eng ang nge a nih tur tih i sawifiah a; runtime hian pixels te chu state nen a inmil tir nghal vek a ni. Virtual DOM awm lo, bundler awm lo, JSX lo — `.arx` file hi app a ni.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Declarative — i duh ang UI i ziak a, a siam dan tur step ni lovin
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~count += 1` a ni a, a chhiartu label zawng zawng chu a hmunah update vek a ni
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — `.arx` ang chiah hi web, iOS, leh Android runtime-ah edit tel lovin a kal thei
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer ship in under 30 KB, chuvangin Mini Apps chu a inhawng nghal vek
architexDocs.goalReadable: Chhiar theih — indentation chu structure a ni a; modifiers te chu `::` hmanga chain an ni a; punctuation tax a awm lo
architexDocs.whoIsThisFor: Hei hi tu tan nge ni?
architexDocs.whoDesc: Vortex — customer form, dashboard, vote thlakna page, Telegram-style Mini Apps-a interactive screen thawn duh tan. HTML+CSS+JS i ziak tawh a nih chuan Architex hian i hre tawh ang a, mahse a ziak rang zawk ang. I la nei lo a nih chuan Architex pawh hi reactive programming lama inhriattirna nêm tak a ni a, a chhan chu a ṭawngkam hian footprint a ti tlem a ni.
architexDocs.howToRead: He reference hi chhiar dan tur
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Section tin hian a hmaa mi kha an siam chhuak vek a ni. Quick Start atang khan tan la, Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, leh advanced section chu a tawp berah chhiar rawh. React emaw Svelte emaw i hriat tawh chuan table of contents hmangin zuang kual rawh — concepts te chu a map fai hle.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: File blank atanga running Mini App panna kawng tawi ber.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Hello

  ~name = "khawvel".

  col :: pad(24) gap(12) laiah a awm

    header "Chibai, {~hming}!" :: bold size(28) a ni.

    input ~hming :: pad(8) radius(6) ramri(#ccc) a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a in ang lo.

    text "A chungah hian hming type rawh — he text hi i type ang zelin a update thin."
      :: size(12) rawng(#888) a ni.
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` tih hian root a declare a. `~name = "khawvel"` hian reactive variable a siam a. `col`, `header`, `input`, `text` te hi a chhunga thil awmte a ni. `::` hian modifier (padding, colour, size) a attached thin. User-in input-ah a type chuan `{~name}` interpolation tin hi a update vek a — wiring a awm lo, subscription a awm lo, kut hmanga render a awm lo.
architexDocs.runningIt: Screen a run lai a ni
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Vortex bot studio ah Architex tab kha hawng la, code kha paste la, Run kha hmet rawh. Runtime chu preview pane ah a render a, save ah hot-reload a ni. I publish hian i hmangtute chuan eng chat atang pawhin app hi an hawng thin — install a awm lo.
architexDocs.syntaxAtGlance: Syntax chu a han en teh
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Architex program tin hi thil pali atanga siam a ni a, chungte chu `@` atanga tan declaration te, reactive variable te chu `~` hmanga prefixed te, components bare identifier anga ziah te, leh `::` hnua modifiers attached te an ni.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, leh `@for item in ~list` te hi column 0 atanga tan vek a ni a, an hnuaia indented zawng zawng hi chu block ta a ni.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Components te hi anmahni line-ah an thu a: `text`, `button`, `image`, `header`, `label`, `badge`, `divider`, `col`, `row`. An positional argument chu a hming hnuaiah chiah a lo awm a: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifier: Modifier chain pakhat anatomy (anatomy) a ni
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: `::` hnuah chuan i duh ang zat modifier i chain thei ang. Parentesis chhungah argument zero emaw a aia tam emaw an la vek a: `:: pad(24) gap(16) center bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Modifiers hi positional an ni a, keyword an ni lo — order hi a pawimawh lo, `color` ang chi last-writer-wins te tih loh chu.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: Button (or interactive component eng pawh)-a `=>` hian a hnuaia assignment emaw function call emaw chu a run a. Chain tam tak `=>` a sir lehlamah: `button "Submit" => ~busy = dik => thawn(action: "save", data: ~form)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVars: Reactive variable te pawh a awm
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Hming eng pawh `~` tih hmasak ber chu reactive cell a ni. Declare turin `~count = 0` ziak la, re-assign turin `~count = 5` ziak la, update turin `~count += 1` ziak rawh. Cell chhiartu UI node zawng zawng — direct emaw interpolation hmanga chhiar emaw — chu cell a inthlak chuan a re-render leh thin.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Computed expression declare nan `=` aiah `:=` hmang la: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Dinglam sir hian dependency eng pawh a inthlak apiangin a re-evaluate leh thin. Manual subscription leh stale-value bug a awm lo — expression hmun dangah `~a` i chhiar chuan automatic in i innghat a ni.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Annotations hi duhthlan theih ni mahse autocomplete leh error message-ah a pui a: `~count: number = 0`, `~name: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~items: array = []`, `~user: object = {}`. I skip chuan initialiser atang hian type chu infer a ni.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `number`, `string`, `boolean`, `array`, `thil`, `null` te hi a ni. Date leh blob te hi string leh object angin an pass a. Runtime hian hood hnuaiah JavaScript-a coercion rules a hmang a, chuvangin `~count + 1` hian `~count` hian string anga nun a tan pawhin a thawk thei.
architexDocs.stringInterpolation: String hmanga inthlak danglamna (interpolation) a ni
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: String eng pawhin `{...}` hmangin expression a embed thei a: `"Hello, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Interpolation hi a reactive reng a ni.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex hian composable container pahnih leh leaf component dozen zet a nei a. Indentation hmangin nest rawh — closing tags awm lo.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` hian naupangte chu vertical-in a stack a, `row` chu horizontal-in a stack bawk. An pahnih hian `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, leh width/height modifier te an pawm vek a ni. Naupangte chu level khat thuk zawkah indent la, an awm theih nan.
architexDocs.containerExample:
row :: gap(8) pad(16) lai takah
  thlalak "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20) a ni.
  col :: gap tipung(2) .
    thuziak ~hming :: bold
    text ~bio :: a lian zawng(12) rawng(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — taksa copy eng pawh. `header` — awmziaah chuan thupui a ni. `label` — thuziak te tak te. `button` — tap theihna tur control. `input` — text field chu reactive var-a bound a ni. `image` — thlalak chu URL atanga lak a ni. `badge` — pill ang chi tag. `divider` — separator line te tak te. `toast` — hun rei lote chhunga chaw ei tur. `tabs` / `tab` — tab thlak danglamtu.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` hian static string a rawn tarlang a. `text ~message` hian reactive tak a siam a. Interpolation nen inzawm khawm rawh: `text "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Heading thuziak. `text` aiin a lian zawk, a bolder zawkah default a ni. Positional argument inang chiah: `header "Settings"`. Screen hmanga size scale — `size(n)` hmanga override.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Tap theih element a ni. Positional string chu label a ni a; `=>` action chu tap ah a kal thin. `button "Save" => ~draft = null` tih a ni. Multiple `=>` mei chu a hnuaia mi ang hian.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Kawng hnih atanga inzawm text field. A hming hnuaia reactive variable hian tuna value awm mek chu a keng tel a: `input ~email`. Modifiers: `placeholder("...")`, `debounce(300)` te chu throttled update te tan a ni.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: HTTPS URL emaw `/uploads/...` path atanga load te. Modifiers `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` te hian box chu an trim a. A tla leh a, placeholder silhouette-ah a tla leh a, URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline separator, 1px hian tuna theme colour hman mek chu a chawimawi a ni. Argument a awm lo.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: A chhunga thil awmte kuahtu pill: `badge ~count`, `badge "new"`. Counter chhiar loh leh tag chip atan hman tur.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/helper text — hmuh theiha tihhniam. Form field hming atan Good a ni.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Blocking loh hriattirna. `toast ~visible "Chhanchhuah tawh!" :: duration(2000)` hian `~visible` a dik apiangin s 2 chhung a entir a, chutah chuan auto-dismisses a ni. Modal stacking a awm lo va, z-index wars pawh a awm lo.
architexDocs.componentTabs: tabs / tab te a awm bawk
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab container chu reactive string-ah bound a ni: `tabs ~activeTab`. A chhungah chuan `tab "Label" "key"` tin hian tab pakhat a declare a; a hnuaia indented body chu key a inmil chuan a lang.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers hi component pakhat style theihna awmchhun a ni. `::` hnuah chain rawh. Chhungkaw pangaah an awm a, chungte chu: spacing, sizing, colour, typography, leh behavior te an ni.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — a sir zawng zawnga padding. `pad(x, y)` — dinglam + dinglam. `pad(chunglam, dinglam, hnuai lam, veilam)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — `col` / `row` fate inkar hmun. `margin(n)` — unau atanga pawn lam inkar.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — a zau zawng ruat sa. `h(px)` — a san zawng ruat sa. `grow` — hmun la awm chu row/col-ah luah khat rawh. `center` — cross axis zawh zawnga center; `col`-ah chuan a laiah a innghat a, `row`-ah chuan a laiah a dinglam a ni.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `color(#rrggbb)` — hmalam atanga thlir. `bg(#rrggbb)` — hnunglam. An pahnih hian theme token an pawm a: `color(~primary)` hi tuna `@theme` block atang hian a chhiar thin. Opacity hi digit 8 hex kaltlangin a kal a: `#00000080` hi 50 %% black a ni.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — font lian leh te. `bold` / `italic` — a rit zawng leh a style. `align(left|center|right)` — thuziak alignment.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — flag a dik laiin node chu a unmount thin. `hmu theih(~flag)` — inverse. Unmounted node te hian an DOM an shed a, chuvangin conditional UI hi a man tlawm hle.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` chu `input` ah a throttles updates. `placeholder("...")` hian hint string a rawn tarlang a. `text`-a `format(kind, arg)` hian number a format a: `format("pawisa", "USD")`, `format("za zela")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` hian corner a round a. `border(#rrggbb)` hian 1 px stroke a draw a. `border(px, #rrggbb)` hian thickness a set bawk.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Actions mutate state emaw pawn lam khawvel nena inbiakna emaw. Tap/keypress handler ah chuan synchronous in an kal thin.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~count = 0`, `=> ~busy = dik`, `=> ~list = []`. Reactive variable eng pawh hi ziah theih a ni.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~count += 1` hi counter atan idiomatic a ni.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Line khata `=>` tam tak chuan tick khatah top-to-bottom a kap a, chuvangin UI chu a tawpah vawi khat update a ni: `button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false`. Async hnathawh tur chuan computed `@reaction` hi duh zawk ang che.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` hi bot-a kir lehna tur bridge a ni. Host (Vortex runtime) chuan JSON RPC message angin a dawng a, i bot code chu a call thei bawk. Login, API fetch, payment — eng thil pawh DSL ngeiin a sawi chhuah theih loh atan hmang rawh.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: value, ...)` chuan `@screen` dang chu stack-ah a nawr leh a; `back()` tih a rawn lang ang. Runtime chu default in a animate thin.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — `it` shorthand hi a hmaa expression return value a ni.
architexDocs.advanced: Feature hmasawn tak tak a awm
architexDocs.theme: @theme — design token te chu a awm
architexDocs.themeDesc: Palette vawi khat declare la, hmun tinah hmang leh rawh. Token te hi regular reactive variable a lo nih avangin i app hian dark-mode toggle chu line thum ah a ship thei a ni.
architexDocs.themeExample:
@theme a ni
  ~primary = #4f8ef7 tih a ni
  ~hlauhawm = #e53935
  ~bg = #ffffff a ni
  ~text = #212121 a ni
  ~radius = 12 a ni
architexDocs.imports: @import — module system hmanga siam a ni
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` hian chu file atang chuan `@component` leh `@screen` zawng zawng chu scope awm mek ah a hruai lut vek a. Paths hi importing file nena inzawm a ni a; circular imports te chu parse time ah detect leh report a ni.
architexDocs.components: @component — thil siam chhuah chi hrang hrang
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Vawikhat sawifiah la, vawi tam tak hmang rawh: `@component Avatar url size\n image url :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. Component body chhungah hian parameter hming vuah te chu plain identifier (`~` tel lovin) angin scope-ah an awm a.
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item in ~list` hian element khatah row khat a render thin. `@for item, ~list-a idx` pawh hian zero-based index chu a binding bawk. Runtime hian element ngei hmangin identity a track a, chuvangin 10 000-row list chung bera items te dah belh chuan O(1) DOM work a ngai a ni.
architexDocs.forExample:
@item atan, ~items ah idx
  row :: gap(8) pad(4) a ni.
    badge ~idx tih a ni
    text ~item :: a lo thang lian
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` hian expression pakhat pawm a nihna hmun apiangah hna a thawk. Enums te tan nest: `~status >= 10 ? "high" : ~a dinhmun >= 5 ? "mid" : "hniam"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Component declaration chhungah hian `slot` hian caller taksa plug inna hmun a tarlang a, React children / Vue default slot angin ngaihtuah rawh.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: `~var` tin hi signal a ni. Computed, modifier argument emaw interpolation chhunga i chhiar chuan runtime chuan tuna dependency graph-a read chu a note a ni. I ziah hian a chhiartu node tin chu re-evaluate an ni vek — vawi khat, tuna microtask hman mek tawp lamah.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Handler pakhata write tam tak chu batch a ni. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` hian render pass pakhat chiah a trigger a.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Default-ah chuan runtime hian strict equality (`===`) a hmang a. Value inang ziah hian engmah a re-run lo. Update force turin object/array thar pass rawh; immutability hi fuih ni mahse a ngai lo.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Canonical app pali, mahni inthunun thei leh line 40 hnuai lam. An zinga pakhat tal chu Architex tab ah copy la, Run kha hmet rawh.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter — reactive state, computed, button handler, thuziak binding te a ni.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — list rendering, add / paih, inline editing te a ni.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile — thlalak, badge, conditional visibility, kal dan tur.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Killer features — theme, import, tab, toast, formated number, ternaries, typed vars te a awm a.
architexDocs.errors: Thil tihsual tlanglawn leh tih tur
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `unknown name ~foo` — i declare hmain reactive variable i hmang a. Enclosing `@screen` chung lamah `~foo = ...` tih dah la.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — naupangte chu an nu leh pa aiin level khatin an thuk zawk tur a ni. Architex hian level khatah space pahnih chiah a hmang a; tabs te hi invisible-whitespace bugs awm loh nan reject a ni.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — `:: shadow` i ziak a mahse runtime hian a support lo. A chunga modifier list hi en la; Architex hian forward compatibility humhim nan hming hriat loh chungchangah a khauh hle.
architexDocs.errType: `type inmil lohna` — e.g. number beisei awmna string i pass a. Reactive variable (`~count: number`) chu annotate la, parser chuan bad value lo chhuahna hmun a hrilh ang che.
architexDocs.errDebug: Runtime-a debug tur chuan suspect expression chu `debug(...)`-ah wrap rawh — runtime hian evaluation zawng zawng chu value nghawng lovin console-ah a log vek a ni.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — theme token atan CSS variable hmangin vanilla DOM ah a render thin. React / Vue / Svelte innghahna a awm lo.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — chutiang bawk `.arx` chu parsed a ni a, Vortex iOS host hmangin SwiftUI views ah render a ni. Modifier tin hian SwiftUI style ah an map vek.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — host hian Jetpack Compose ah a render thin. Gesture modifiers (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) te hi Compose tlukpui ah an letling thin.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Version policy — Architex hian `.arx` file te chu version tenau zawng zawngah backward compatibility a tichiang a. 0.1 dodal zawnga ziah `.arx` file chu 0.9-ah a la thawk reng a ni.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Pattern (infinite lists, forms, payments) te, CLI leh VS Code plugin atana tooling guide te, leh built-in component dah duh chuan contribution guide te chu cookbook chhiar la. A thupui kimchang chu github.com/vortex/Architex ah a awm.

architecture.title: Architecture chungchang tlangpui
architecture.subtitle: Process pathum — client, node, controller — leh anmahni bindingtu protocol pakhat.
architecture.intro: Vortex hi decentralized messenger a ni. Company pakhat ta back-end pakhat ni lovin, independent **nodes** open mesh a federate a, chu chu a attested code signed manifest tichhuaktu compact **controller**-in a hmuchhuak a, a vouch a ni. **Clients** te hian private key zawng zawng an vawng vek a, UI an render. He bung dang zawng zawng hian process pathum, an ramri leh an inkara data luang chhuakte chu a kalpui a ni.
architecture.h1p1: Centralized messenger te hi nawr luihna hmun khat a ni. Court order emaw, cloud-provider outage emaw, hostile acquisition emaw chu "users lose access" tihna a ni vek. Vortex chuan chu chu tu pawhin node an kalpui tir a, client te chu re-register lovin node inkarah an kal tir a, chu chu a sidestep a ni.
architecture.h1p2: Decentralization hian thuruk leh dikna humhalh a ngai a ni. Server rintlak loh federation chuan server ten plaintext an chhiar thei lo a, message an forge thei lo a nih chauhvin hna a thawk thei. Vortex hian cross-node message tinah end-to-end encryption leh Ed25519 attestations hmangin a enforce vek a ni.
architecture.h1p3: Controller hi one centralised-ish piece a ni a, mahse a te hle. `INTEGRITY.sig.json` leh entry point rintlak list chauh a tichhuak. Tu pawhin mirror hi self-host an ti thei a, chuvangin controller pawh hi a hlawhchhamna hmun pakhat mah a ni lo — "which pubkey signs official releases" tih thudik source pakhat chauh a ni.
architecture.h1l1: Vendor lock-in a awm lo: client te chuan engtik lai pawhin X25519 pubkey chu JWT thar hmanga sign lehin node inkarah an identity an migrate thei a ni.
architecture.h1l2: No outage correlation: node pakhat a tlak chuan node dang a hmangtute chuan an hre lo.
architecture.h1l3: Jurisdiction pakhat chauh a awm lo: operator-te chuan an legal home an thlang a, user-te chuan an operator an thlang bawk.
architecture.h1l4: No single UI: iOS, Android, web te hi first-class peer an ni — platform engmah hi a dang aia thin wrapper a ni lo.
architecture.h2p1: Client hi user pakhat device-ah a kal a. Chu chu plaintext message, private key leh file-in-the-clear live awmna hmun awmchhun a ni. Node hian a hmu ngai lo.
architecture.h2p2: Supported platform tin hian wire protocol inang (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC) an implement vek a ni. SOLID-split feature module (`api/` protocols, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) te hian contract chu tight takin an vawng a, platform-specific code chu localised takin an dah bawk.
architecture.h2p3: Device-a dahkhawmna: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / Token-te tan HttpOnly cookie; SQLite (iOS-ah GRDB, Android-ah Room, web-ah IndexedDB wrapper) cached ciphertext + FTS index atan.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Package ah hian feature module 30+ a awm a. Min deployment tur chu iOS 17 a ni.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Hla phuah + Hilt tih a ni. minSdk 26, targetSdk 34 a ni.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanilla JS PWA, service worker, ES module bundling aia sang build step nei lo.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop — Tauri wrapper chu web client-ah a awm a; bundle ang chiah, native Chrome renderer a ni.
architecture.h3p1: Node chu Python process (`python -m app.main`, emaw bundled `run.py`) 9000-a default-a ngaihthlak a ni. Ciphertext a persist a, WebSocket events a fans out a, TURN credentials a nei a, node dang nena federation a broker bawk.
architecture.h3p2: Node layer chu tumruh takin a thin. Real-time fan-out atan `/api/*` thing atanga `/ws` bakah hian route 120 vel a pholang a ni. Heavy lifting (crypto, awmna, scheduling) hi `app/security/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/` ah te factor a ni.
architecture.h3p3: Default SQLite mode-a node pakhat hian M1-ah ~50 concurrent users chu nuam takin a handle thei a ni. Postgres leh Redis enable a nih chuan code inang chu horizontal-in a scale a — node tin chu DB leh fan-out kaltlangin stateless a lo ni ta a ni.
architecture.h3l1: Entry point: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrity` leh `/health` te chu nunna atan a ni.
architecture.h3l2: A innghahna: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust hot-path crypto atana extension `vortex_chat` te hi a ni.
architecture.h3l3: A duh chuan: Redis (node ​​tam takah fan-out awmna), Postgres (production DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log shipping) te hi a ni.
architecture.h3l4: Binary size: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust tihzauh a ni. Docker image chu squash hmain 400 MB vel a ni.
architecture.h4p1: Controller hi Python process hran (`vortex_controller`) a ni a, a tum thui tak a ni: `INTEGRITY.sig.json` tihchhuah leh verify, entry URLs expose, leh federated peers hriselna track.
architecture.h4p2: Startup ah chuan controller chuan source tree chu a kalpui a, file tin a hash a, manifest nen a khaikhin thin. Hash eng emaw a inmil lo a nih chuan controller chuan a start duh lo. Hei hian on-disk file tampered chuan `status:"verified"` a service thei lo tihna a ni.
architecture.h4p3: Client te chuan node an rin hmain `/v1/integrity` an hit hmasa thin. `status != "verified"` an hmuh chuan credentials an hlan duh lo, period. Chu chu rinna anchor chu a ni.
architecture.h4l1: `keys/release.key` (Ed25519) hmanga sign a ni. Public half baked a ni a, client release a ni.
architecture.h4l2: Manifest entry: `{path, sha256, size}` file zawng zawng tan gitignored loh.
architecture.h4l3: Siam thar leh: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Repo root ah `INTEGRITY.sig.json` a chhuak thin.
architecture.h4l4: Rotation: operator-te forking Vortex chu `release.key` thlak a ni. Client te chuan an pubkey hmanga configure te chuan chu fork chu an ring ta a ni.
architecture.h5p1: Alice-i'n Bob-a hnena "hi" a thawn lai khan eng nge thleng tih hi han thlir teh:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Client chuan a local store-ah room root key a zawng a. A awm loh chuan `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` atangin a pubkey atan envelope thar a la chhuak thin. A vawi khatna atana DM lo ni tawhte chuan prekey-ah one-round Diffie-Hellman an run a.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Client chuan payload chu CBOR `{v:1, text:"hi", reply_to:null, sent_at:...}` angin a frame a, random 96-bit nonce a siam a, AES-256-GCM hmangin a seal a, `{ciphertext: hex, nonce: hex, sender_pseudo: hex}` tih a ni.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node hian row chu a store a, room a subscribed connected WebSocket zawng zawng hnenah `{type:"m", room:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` a fans out thin.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob-a client chuan frame chu a dawng a, root key inang hmangin a decrypt a, sender pseudo matches expected membership a verify a, bubble chu a render bawk.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob-a client chuan `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` chu a chhiar hnuhnung ber message id nen a post thin. Chu chuan `{type:"r"}` broadcast a trigger avangin Alice-i bubble chuan tick a lantir a ni.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) hi a khauh a, binary a ni a, encode pawh a rang hle. JSON nen khaikhin chuan typical chat ciphertext ah payload size ~30 % in a ti tlem a, whitespace ambiguity a ti bo bawk.
architecture.h6p2: Protobuf nen khaikhin chuan schema generator a mamawh lo va, field number pawh a freeze lo. Chu chu a pawimawh a, a chhan chu Vortex hi a evolve a ni — client hlui tichhia lovin release-ah `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` kan dah belh a ni.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR hi Signal, Matrix, leh NIP-29 te pawhin chhan inang tak tak avanga an hman thin a ni bawk. An duhthlanna inmil tir hian kan protocol hi encoding hre tawh security researcher ten audit a awlsam zawk tihna a ni.
architecture.h7p1: Frame tin hian `v:<int>` a keng tel vek a. Tuna version hman mek chu 1. Version hriat loh frame pakhat chu drop a ni a; clients te chuan warning an log a, frame dang chu an kalpui zel a ni.
architecture.h7p2: Frame eng pawh `v:1` la keng tel tan chuan backwards compatibility a awm ngei ang. Forward compatibility hi best-effort a ni: dict tawp lamah field thar dah belh a ni a, client hlui te chuan an ngaihsak lo.
architecture.h7p3: Hard breakage hi security-critical changes (e.g. swapping HKDF context strings) atan dah a ni. Chutiang hunah chuan version chu 2 ah a bump a, migration window a publish thin.
architecture.h1_a: Vortex network hi process pathum ah a inthen a. Anmahni chauhin an kal a, wire protocol mumal tak hmangin midangte nen an inbia a, mahni inrintawkna neiin an thlak thei bawk. Monolith a awm lo — feature tin hi role pathum zinga pakhatah a plug vek a ni.
architecture.h1_b: Client pakhat chuan keys a keng a, UI a render thin. Node pakhat hian ciphertext a persist a, WebSocket aia tam events a fans out a, broker WebRTC signalling a ti bawk. Controller chuan signed manifest leh entry URL te chu a publish thin. AES-GCM envelope chhunga CBOR-encoded payload hmangin HTTPS + WebSocket hmangin an inbiak thin.
architecture.h1_c: Split hi v0.0.3-ah hian monolith version hmasa ber khan harsatna pahnih a tawk a, chu chu release attestation chu running node-ah a inbun a (chuvangin compromised node chuan a code chungchang a sawi dawt thei a), federation chu a theih loh a, a chhan chu node state leh trust state te chu table inangah an awm a ni. Attestation chu a process-a then darh chuan operator tinte chu pin tur pubkey pakhat chauh a pe a, federation chu arbitrary N-ah scale ila.
architecture.h1_f:
client --HTTPS/WSS--> node a ni
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +------/v1/integrity-- controller (manifest signed) hmanga siam a ni.
architecture.h2_a: Node/controller split hian security-sensitive ber artifact (signed manifest) chu attack surface lian ber (API server) atangin a isolate a ni.
architecture.h2_b: Controller hian SQLite DB te tak te a dahkhawm a: pubkey rintlak, mirror URL, leh health score te. INTEGRITY.sig.json chu on-disk tree nen a inmil lo a nih chuan a tan duh lo — tampered file chuan `status:"verified"` a service thei ngai lo. Node hi a Postgres/SQLite ah a kal a, release key a hold ngai lo.
architecture.h2_c: Pattern hi Chrome-a root-store split (certs te hi browser release track-ah a live a, web origin-ah ni lovin) leh Debian-a Release.gpg (manifest signed, packages unsigned) atanga lo chhuak a ni. Design pahnih hi kum sawm tam tak chhung adversarial review atanga an dam khawchhuah avangin adopt a ni.
architecture.h3_a: TLS Hop tin ah 1.3 a awm a, a chhungah end-to-end encrypted payloads a awm bawk. TLS hian lirthei tlan dan a buaipui a; AES-GCM hian content a handle thin.
architecture.h3_b: Client leh node inkarah hian: HTTPS (`/api/*`) leh WSS (`/ws`). Node inkarah: HTTPS (`/federation/*`) tih a ni. Node leh controller inkarah: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). An vai hian TLS 1.3 an hmang a, Chrome 120 fingerprints hmangin DPI an do thei.
architecture.h3_c: Vortex hmasa khan raw TCP hmangin custom noise-protocol handshake an hmang thin. Custom protocols hian passive observer te tan "interesting" a signal tih a hriat hnuah v0.0.4 ah TLS 1.3 ah a inthlak. TLS 1.3 hi boring, hmun tina awm, leh ECH-ready — kan duh property pathum a ni.
architecture.h3_f:
transport layer: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + duhthlan theih ECH (RFC 9460)
content layer: AES-256-GCM a chhunga sealed CBOR .
architecture.h4_a: Outbound message pakhat hian step pali a paltlang a, frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Client hian room key (X25519 + HKDF) a compute a, message chu CBOR angin a frame a, random 96-bit nonce hmangin AES-256-GCM hmangin a seal a, `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` ah a POST bawk. Node hian ciphertext row chu a store a, room chhunga connected WebSocket subscribe zawng zawngah fans out a ni. Recipient client chuan key ang chiah hmangin a decrypt bawk. Local LAN-ah 50 ms hnuai lam round-trip latency, ~120 ms typical WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Step li nei pipeline hi kum 2014-a Signal-in a hman tawh ang chiah kha a ni a; transport (Signal’s TCP aiah WebSocket) leh encoding (protobuf aiah CBOR) chauh kan thlak a ni. Design finfiah tawh matching hian design thar siam chhuah a hneh zawk.
architecture.h4_f:
msg = CBOR{v:1, thuziak, chhanna, thawn chhuah}.
ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (k, vawi khat, msg, aad=room_id)
POST /api/rooms/{id}/messages {ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex} tih hi a awmzia a awm lo.
architecture.h5_a: Chat workload tak takah payload size, evolvability, leh debug ergonomics te kan khaikhin hnuah JSON leh Protobuf aiin CBOR kan thlang zawk a ni.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR hian unicode-heavy message-ah JSON aiin ~30% payload te zawk a siam chhuak a, whitespace ambiguity a nei lo va, schema generator tel lovin field addition a support bawk. Proto hian release khatah .proto file a mamawh ang a, field number pawh a freeze ang.
architecture.h5_c: Signal hi kum 2017 khan protobuf atanga CBOR-like framing ah a inthlak a, hei hi a chhan ang chiah a ni. Matrix hian a state-resolution layer-ah CBOR a hmang a. CBOR hi IETF standard (RFC 8949) a ni a, kan target ṭawng tin hian library puitling tak an nei vek a ni.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR size: ~0.7 × JSON chu mixed utf-8 ah a ni
          ~1.05 × protobuf chu schema inangah a awm
Field dah belh = a tawpah append. Client hlui te chuan an ngaihsak lo.
architecture.h6_a: Engvangin nge CBOR — architecture bung khata tel. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
architecture.h6_b: "Engvangin nge CBOR" tih atan implementation overview. Mechanism hi a inmil module-ah `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, emaw `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` tih hnuaiah implement a ni. Module README hian file path dik tak a ko chhuak thin.
architecture.h6_c: "Why CBOR" mechanism hi Vortex release hrang hrangah a lo piang chhuak a ni. Design hi a hmaa messenger-te research leh production practice tihchhuah tawh atanga lo chhuak a ni. `CHANGELOG.md`-a version history-ah chuan piece tinte chu engtikah nge a tlak tih leh eng thilin nge a chêttîr tih a record a ni.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — architecture bung khata tel. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
architecture.h7_b: "Protocol versioning" atana hman dan tlangpui. Mechanism hi a inmil module-ah `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, emaw `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` tih hnuaiah implement a ni. Module README hian file path dik tak a ko chhuak thin.
architecture.h7_c: "Protocol versioning" mechanism hi Vortex release hrang hrangah a lo thang chho ta a ni. Design hi a hmaa messenger-te research leh production practice tihchhuah tawh atanga lo chhuak a ni. `CHANGELOG.md`-a version history-ah chuan piece tinte chu engtikah nge a tlak tih leh eng thilin nge a chhan tih a record a ni.

crypto.title: Cryptographic hmanga thil siam chhuah (primitives) te
crypto.subtitle: Stack chhunga algorithm zawng zawng, a tum, a parameter, a RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex hian peer-reviewed primitives chauh a hmang. Custom block cipher awm lo, home-grown KDF awm lo, novel signature scheme awm lo. He bung hian primitive kan hman zawng zawng te, parameter dik tak te, leh duhthlanna tinte chhan (rationale) te a ziak vek a ni.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) chu a Montgomery angin a awm a, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman atan hman a ni. 32-byte private key, 32-byte public key, 32-byte shared secret output te a awm bawk.
crypto.h1p2: A hman thin: static device identity, ephemeral session key, sealed push envelope, room key wrapping, federation envelope te.
crypto.h1p3: iOS kalpui dan: CryptoKit atanga `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` tih hi a ni. Android: `x25519-dalek` tih hi JNI kaltlangin a awm. Node: OpenSSL hmangin `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` tih a ni.
crypto.h1p4: An pathum hian bit-for-bit an inzawm vek a ni. Build tinah RFC 7748 Alice/Bob test vectors hmangin round-trip test a ni.
crypto.h1p5: Performance: 2020 iPhone-ah Diffie-Hellman pakhatah ~100 μs, 2020 Mac-ah ~30 μs a ni. Member 200 awmna group tan room-key wrapping round khat chu wall-clock 10 ms vel a ni.
crypto.h1p6: Constant-time: a ni, curve arithmetic leh raw-byte decoding path-ah te pawh.
crypto.h1p7: Side-channel posture: Montgomery ladder hi Weierstrass curve-a timing attack class-ah a him lo a; OpenSSL leh Swift CryptoKit te hian an hmang vek a.
crypto.h1p8: Key serialisation: 32-byte a zau a ni. Public key hi import-ah clamp a nih avangin malformed inputs hian low-order-point leak a siam lo.
crypto.h1l1: Engvangin nge X25519 leh P-256 ni lo: rang zawk, te zawk, NIST-curve ngaihtuahna awm lo.
crypto.h1l2: Engvangin nge 32-byte output leh 64 ni lo: HKDF-SHA256 input sei zawng nen a inmil chiah.
crypto.h1l3: Engvangin nge Montgomery leh Edwards ni lo: he key material-ah hian signatures ni lovin DH chauh kan mamawh. Edwards hian conversion step a mamawh apiangin a mamawh dawn a ni.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) chu edwards25519 chungah a awm. 32-byte public key, 64-byte signature a ni.
crypto.h2p2: A hman thin: federation message-a node attestation, integrity manifest hmanga release-key signatures, bot deploy signing, Double Ratchet tana device long-term identity.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: kan hman RFC 8032 variant hian message + key pakhat atan signature inang vawi hnih a siam chhuak thin. iOS 17+-a Apple-a CryptoKit hian RFC 8032bis randomized variant a hmang a — an pahnih hian an valid a, an pahnih hian compliant verifier eng pawh hmangin an verify vek a ni.
crypto.h2p4: Verification man: Tunlai CPU ah ~200 μs a ni. Batch verify (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) hi signature khatah ~10× a rang zawk.
crypto.h2p5: Signature format: `R || S`, byte 32 ve ve, little-endian a ni.
crypto.h2l1: Public key aiawh: 32-byte compressed point a ni. A dik reng — "point at infinity" case a awm lo.
crypto.h2l2: Private key aiawh: 32-byte seed a ni. Expanded scalar hi SHA-512 kaltlangin fly-ah a chhuak a ni.
crypto.h2l3: Engvangin nge ECDSA loh: ECDSA hian signature tin atan RNG quality sang tak a mamawh a; a biased RNG chuan private key a leak a. Ed25519 hi deterministic a ni a, sign time-ah RNG a ngai lo.
crypto.h3p1: AES chu Galois/Counter Mode-ah (NIST SP 800-38D) a ni. 256-bit key, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit authentication tag te a awm bawk.
crypto.h3p2: A hman thin: message ciphertext envelope, file chunk envelope, encrypted backup payload, sealed push payload.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce construction: message tin hian 96-bit random nonce thar a siam chhuak thin. Node hian room khatah nonce hnuhnung ber 10^6 a track a, defensive-in duplicate a drop bawk — client chuan a tir lamah duplicate a siam tur a ni lo, mahse assume-nothing is cheap.
crypto.h3p4: Engvangin nge 96-bit nonces leh 128-bit ni lo: 96 bits hi GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce length a ni a, birthday collisions chu ngaihtuahawm a nih hmain random nonces 2^32 min pe a ni. Chumi hma rei takah chuan room key pakhat chu a rotate tawh a, chuvang chuan a him hle.
crypto.h3p5: Tag size: bit 128 a tling. Kan truncate lo — storage savings hi a tlem hle a, truncation hian forgery probability a tipung bawk.
crypto.h3l1: Hardware acceleration: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto extension, Apple Silicon-a crypto block bikte. Encryption throughput chu ~3 GB/s a ni.
crypto.h3l2: Crypto extension nei lo ARM device hluiah chuan: software hmangin ~300 MB/s. Disk IO aiin a la chak zawk.
crypto.h3l3: Associated data: frame header (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) chu AAD anga pass a nih avangin forged header chuan a verify lo ang.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) leh SHA-256. 32-byte input pakhat atang hian 32-byte sub-key tam tak a la chhuak thin.
crypto.h4p2: A hman thin: X25519 output chu encryption key + MAC key + header key-a then; Diffie-Hellman round atanga root ratchet key lak chhuah; file root atanga per-chunk file key siam.
crypto.h4p3: Info string te hi deterministic ASCII a ni fo thin: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:header"`, `"v1:backup"`. Versioning hmang hian info-string change hmangin key hierarchy pumpui kan rotate thei a ni.
crypto.h4p4: Salt hi duhthlan tur a ni. Vortex ah hian room id hi room-key derivation atan salt atan kan hmang a, chuvangin room hrang hrangah X25519 output inang lo lang mahse accident-in derived key an hmang leh thei lo.
crypto.h4l1: Engvangin nge SHA-256 leh SHA-512 loh: platform zawng zawng hian hardware SHA-256 acceleration an nei vek a; SHA-512 hi 64-bit CPU-ah chuan tlem a chak zawk a, phone-ah erawh chuan a chak lo.
crypto.h4l2: Engvangin nge KMAC-based KDF: KMAC hi niche a ni. HKDF hi crypto library kan hman apiangah a awm vek.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) a ni. Parameters: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32 te a ni.
crypto.h5p2: A hman dan: server-side password hash (`users.password_hash`), local-backup wrapping key, seed-phrase import derivation te hi a ni.
crypto.h5p3: Engvangin nge heng parameter te hi: OWASP 2023 rawtna te. 64 MiB + 3 iterations hian iPhone X — kan supported device slow ber — ah ~0.5 s a hmang thin. Phone memory bandwidth 100× nei ASIC attacker chuan attempt khatah ~5 ms a la mamawh a ni. Password sei (entropy > 40 bits) chu computationally infeasible a lo ni ta a, scale-ah crack theih a ni lo.
crypto.h5p4: Storage format: `argon2:<encoded>` chutah chuan encoded chu RFC-format string a ni a, salt, memory, iterations, leh hash te pawh a tel.
crypto.h5l1: Argon2id leh Argon2i emaw Argon2d emaw a nih loh chhan: 2id hi hybrid a ni — first pass hian side-channel (i-mode) a dodal a, a hnua pass te hian GPU/ASIC (d-mode) a dodal. Signal pawhin a hmang ve tho.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash comparison: user a awm loh lai pawhin hash awm reng hmangin fake Argon2 verify kan la run reng a ni. Hei hian login timing a equalise avangin attackers te chuan response time hmangin username an enumerate thei lo.
crypto.h5l3: Login-a rehash: server admin-in memory cost a bump chuan login hlawhtling lo awm turah hash hlui te chu re-hash a ni. User tan chuan transparent a ni.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024) a ni. ML-KEM-768 a ni. 1184-byte public key, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte thuruk insem a ni.
crypto.h6p2: A hman thin: hybrid post-quantum session keys te tan. Peer pahnih hian Kyber support an advertise hian session key chu `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)` a ni.
crypto.h6p3: Engvangin nge hybrid: Kyber hi a hnuah a chhe tawh a nih pawhin (a tehkhin chuan a naupang hle) X25519 part hian min la humhim reng a ni. Combining hian best-of-both a pe a ni.
crypto.h6p4: Engvangin nge Kyber leh NIST candidate dangte ni lo: standardisation atana thlan chhuah kha a ni. Code awm theihna a zau hle (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: A hnathawh dan: key generation ~100 μs, encapsulation ~30 μs, decapsulation ~50 μs. Round-trip latency nena khaikhin chuan a tlem hle.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth man: Session ciphertext khatah byte 1088, public key atan byte 1184 a ni. Session hi first contact-ah pawisa pek a ni a; chumi hnuah chuan zero a ni ta.
crypto.h6l3: Server lam: `pqcrypto` Python package ah hian `kem.ml_kem_768` a awm. Client lam: platform bindings hmanga liboqs te.
crypto.h7p1: Signal-a Double Ratchet (2016 public spec-a tarlan angin) a ni. Diffie-Hellman ratchet leh symmetric-key chain a inzawm khawm a.
crypto.h7p2: A hman thin: device pahnih inkara direct message thawn. Group room-ah chuan room root atanga keyed off "sender key" scheme awlsam zawk an hmang thin.
crypto.h7p3: Properties: forward secrecy (device tihchhiat hian a message dawn tawh chauh a pholang a, nakin lawka message a pholang lo), post-compromise security (key compromise hnua re-ratcheting heals), out-of-order delivery (skip message 1000 thleng).
crypto.h7p4: Kan implementation chu `app/security/double_ratchet.py` leh `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt` ah te a ni.
crypto.h7l1: Chain sei zawng cap: Chain khatah message 1000 vel chu forced re-ratchet hmain. Chain key ruk atanga chhiatna a tihtlem.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache: chain khatah out-of-order key 1000 thleng memory-ah dah a ni. Chumi piah lamah chuan thuchah chu stale anga hnawl a ni.
crypto.h7l3: Header encryption: a hmasa berin on a ni. Header hian ratchet metadata a keng tel a, root atanga HKDF kaltlangin dedicated header key hmanga encrypt a ni.
crypto.h8p1: Non-cryptographic file identity leh integrity hian BLAKE3 a hmang a, a chhan chu blob lian tak takah SHA-256 aiin 10× a chak zawk a ni.
crypto.h8p2: A hman thin: DB-a file `sha256` column (historical name; a takah chuan v0.1.2 atang khan hood hnuaiah BLAKE3), attachment dedup, file-upload integrity check.
crypto.h8p3: Security posture: BLAKE3 hi cryptographically a chak (256-bit) a ni a; migration compatibility atan chauh column hi `sha256` kan ti a.
crypto.h9: Random number siam chhuah a ni
crypto.h9p1: Nonces, prekeys, challenge value zawng zawng hi OS RNG hmanga siam a ni: iOS-ah `SecRandom`, Android-ah `java.security.SecureRandom`, Python-ah `secrets.token_bytes` (wrapping `/dev/urandom` emaw a tlukpui).
crypto.h9p2: `random.random()` tih ngai suh, `Math.random()` tih ngai suh, `rand()` tih ngai suh. Lint dan chuan crypto module-a hman a khap a ni.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC tehkhin dan, signature verification, password hash verification — zawng zawng hian timing side-channels ven nan constant-time primitives an hmang vek a ni.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.compare_digest` tih hi a ni. Swift: `ConstantTimeComparison` tih puitu. Kotlin: `MessageDigest.chu a inang vek`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 hi a Montgomery angin Curve25519 aiin elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman a ni. 32-byte key, 32-byte thuruk insem a ni. Vortex chhunga private key / static device identity / session key zawng zawng hian an hmang vek a ni.
crypto.h1_b: Alice leh Bob te hian private key a, b leh public key A = a·G, B = b·G an nei ve ve a, G chu curve base point a ni. An chhut dan chuan s = a·B = b·A. He shared 32-byte secret hi HKDF-SHA256 ah a lut a, symmetric AES-GCM keys a la chhuak thin. Curve arithmetic hi Montgomery ladder hmangin hun pangngaiah tih a ni a; secret data-ah hian branch a awm lo.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 hi Daniel J. Bernstein-a’n kum 2005 khan a tichhuak a, RFC 7748 (2016)-a IETF-in a thlang a ni. Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard hmanga pawm a ni. Vortex hian a hmang a, a chhan chu P-256 aiin a chak zawk a, 32-byte key size a tight zawk a, NIST curve concerns a pumpelh a, platform tin hian hardened implementation an ship vek bawk.
crypto.h1_f:
Mimal key: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian) a ni.
Mipui key: A = a · G (32-byte compressed point) 1. A chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun.
Thuruk insem: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, →HKDF input) a ni.
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 hi X25519 signature sibling a ni a, a twisted-Edwards form-ah pawh curve ang chiah hi a hmang a ni. 32-byte public key, 64-byte signatures, default-in deterministic a ni.
crypto.h2_b: Private key d hmanga message m sign tur chuan: r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a compute rawh. Signature chu (R, S) a ni. Verification: R + c·A = S·G tih enfiah rawh. Deterministic signing hian nonce-reuse risk a pumpelh vek a ni — key inang message pakhata signatures pahnih chu bit-identical a ni.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) hi kum 2011-a Bernstein-a paper-ah Duif, Lange, Schwabe, leh Yang-te nen a rawn chhuak a. Kum 2013 hnu lamah nasa takin hman a ni a, Apple-a CryptoKit, Google-a Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH te hian an hmang vek a ni. Vortex hian federation envelope tin leh node attestation tin chu Ed25519 hmangin a sign vek a ni.
crypto.h2_f:
Chhinchhiahna(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G a ni
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m) a ni a;  S = r + c·a tih a ni
              a rawn kir leh (R, S) .

A dik leh dik loh enfiah rawh: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G tih a ni
crypto.h3_a: AES chu Galois/Counter Mode ah a awm. 256-bit key, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit authentication tag te a awm bawk. Vortex a encrypted blob zawng zawng hian GCM an hmang vek.
crypto.h3_b: GCM hian AES chu CTR mode-ah a run a, encryption key atanga key danglam tak hmangin ciphertext + AAD chungah GHASH a compute thin. Tag = GHASH(AAD, ciphertext) ⊕ AES-CTR(0) a ni. Decryption hian GHASH a re-compute a, a tehkhin — bit-flip pakhat chauh pawh verification a hlawhchham. Tunlai CPU zawng zawngah AES-NI emaw ARMv8-A crypto extension hmangin hardware-accelerated a ni.
crypto.h3_c: AES hian kum 2001 khan NIST AES intihsiaknaah a champion a, GCM hi kum 2007 khan NIST SP 800-38D khan standardized a ni a, TLS 1.3-ah chuan default AEAD a ni. Vortex hian classical adversaries lakah 128-bit a tawk viau nachungin 256-bit keys a pick a — 256-bit-a jump hian Grover-a algorithm hnuaiah post-quantum security bit 128 vel min pe a ni.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt) a ni.
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1) a ni.
                          ct∥tag chu a rawn let leh ang
Nonce reuse ⇒ thuruk + dikna tihchhiat.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) hian chabi pakhat chu tam takah a chantir a. Entropy sang tak input leh context label a la a; label khatah byte 32 a pe chhuak thin.
crypto.h4_b: Step hnih: Extract leh Expand. A chhuahna = HMAC-SHA256(chi, IKM) → PRK. Expand = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) chu len byte atan concatenated a ni. Hei hi X25519 output chu encryption key, MAC key, leh header key info string "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header" neia then nan kan hmang a ni.
crypto.h4_c: HKDF hi Hugo Krawczyk chuan EUROCRYPT 2010 khan a tichhuak a, kum 2010 khan RFC 5869 tiin standardized a ni a, TLS 1.3 chuan a schedule atan a hmang a, Signal for Double Ratchet chuan a hmang a, WireGuard chuan session key atan a hmang bawk. Info string-a versioning hian key hierarchy pumpui chu "v1" → "v2" bump-in kan rotate thei a ni.
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(chi, IKM) tih a ni.
A rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah em em bawk a. T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i)
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... len byte-ah truncated a ni
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id hi memory-hard password hash a ni a, GPU leh ASIC attackers te do thei tura siam a ni. Parameters m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32 te a ni.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id hian Argon2i (password-derived data-a branching loh avangin side-channel a dodal) leh Argon2d (parallel hardware-in corner a cut theih loh avangin memory a fill theih loh avangin a mix) a ni. First half-pass hi data-independent (i-mode) a ni a; a bak chu data-a innghat (d-mode) a ni. Kan parameter-ah iPhone X-ah second 0.5 compute, ASIC-ah chuan roughly 5 ms — ~100× speedup hi SHA-256-based hashes nena khaikhin chuan a tlem hle a, ASIC-te chuan 1 000 000×-in hnehna an chang.
crypto.h5_c: Kum 2015-a Dmitry Khovratovich leh Alex Biryukov-te buatsaih Password Hashing Competition-ah Argon2 hian hnehna a chang. Kum 2021 khan RFC 9106 tia standardized a ni a, 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass te hman a ni. Vortex parameters hi OWASP 2023 recommendation atanga lo chhuak a ni a, kan supported device slow ber (iPhone X) ah second 1 hnuaiah login theih turin tuned down a ni.
crypto.h5_f:
iPhone X-ah chuan a man(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5 s a ni
attacker man: m × t × (p / beihpui thlakna_parallelism) a ni.
1010 guess/s ah 40-bit password entropy hmangin:
  Second 1012 = kum 32 000 chhung a ni
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) hi NIST-a standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism a ni a, hei hi a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur a ni. Quantum-safe session keys X25519 nena inzawm a pe.
crypto.h6_b: Alice chuan (pk, sk) a siam chhuak thin. Bob chuan Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss) a ko a; Alice hnenah c a thawn a. Alice chuan Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss a ko a. Tunah chuan an pahnih hian ss an insem tawh a, hei hi 32-byte secret a ni. Security chu Module-LWE problem-ah a tlahniam a, chu chu quantum-hard nia rin a ni. X25519 nen kan inzawm khawm a: session_key = HKDF(x25519_output ∥ kyber_output). A chanve zinga pakhat emaw chu a damchhuak a nih chuan session chu a damchhuak ta a ni.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber hi kum 6 chhung inelna a neih hnuah July 2022 khan NIST chuan a thlang a. August 2024 khan FIPS 203 tia standardized a ni a, Vortex chuan Kyber hi optional angin a thawn a, a chhan chu session khatah ~2 KB a dah belh avangin; paid tiers tan default-in enable a ni a, hmun dangah opt-in theih a ni. Hybrid approach hi Signal chuan kum 2023 khan a rawt a, Chrome chuan kum 2024 khan a hmang ta a ni.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B. A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a
A rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah em em bawk a. ss ∈ {0,1}256
hybrid session = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1") a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.
crypto.h7_a: Signal-a Double Ratchet hian 1:1 chat-ah forward secrecy leh post-compromise security a pe a ni.
crypto.h7_b: Chain pahnih: thawn chhuahna chain leh dawngtu chain. Message tin hian HKDF hmangin a chain a ti hmasawn thin. Vawi tam tak chu Diffie-Hellman ratchet chuan root chu a ti hmasawn a, chain pahnih chu a re-key leh thin. Chain key tihchhiat hian a direct-a a encrypt message chauh a pholang a ni. DH ratchet hnuah chuan attacker-in chain key a ruk pawhin nakin lawka message lo thleng tur chu a him a ni.
crypto.h7_c: Kum 2013-a Trevor Perrin leh Moxie Marlinspike-te design a ni a, Signal 2014-ah hman a ni a, WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations-in a pawm a ni. Public spec in 2016. Vortex kalpui dan hi direct port a ni a; Signal-protocol client dangte nena interop chu v0.4 roadmap-ah a awm.
crypto.h7_f:
thawn: CK = HKDF(CK, "step");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg") tih a ni.
dawng tur: CK' = HKDF(CK', "step"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg") tih a ni.
A rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah em em bawk a. DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(kan_eph, an_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 files hashing — crypto chapter atanga lo chhuak a ni. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
