cryptoWire.title: Crypto wire hmanga siam theih a ni
cryptoWire.subtitle: Encrypted blob tin tan byte layout dik tak.
cryptoWire.intro: He bung hian wire-a byte awmte chu a spell chhuak a. Alternative client emaw forensics tool emaw implement tu tu pawhin a chhiar ve thei.
cryptoWire.h1: Room message envelope a awm a
cryptoWire.h1p1: Structure: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<variable hex>, thawntu_pseudo:<32-hex>, thawn_at:<unix_ms>}`. HTTPS (POST) leh WebSocket (frame type `m`) aia tam thawn a ni.
cryptoWire.h1p2: AES-GCM decryption hnua `ciphertext` content: CBOR `{v:1, text?:<string>, attachment?:[<file_id>, ...], reply_to?:<msg_id>, edit?:[<prior_text>, ...], sawi?:[<user_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag chu a hnungah a awm a: `ciphertext` byte string chu (encrypted payload || 16-byte tag) a ni. Client chu a sei zawngin a inthen darh thin.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: a lower-case hex room id chu associated data angin pass a ni. Room id binding hian cross-room replay a veng thei.
cryptoWire.h2: File chunk envelope a awm a
cryptoWire.h2p1: File root key hi random 32 byte a ni. Chunk pakhatah key: `HKDF(root, info: "file:chunk:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk ciphertext: AES-GCM chu chunk key pakhatah, random 96-bit nonce, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset>` tih a ni. Max chunk size chu 512 KiB a ni.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Whole-file integrity: client chuan plaintext hmangin BLAKE3 a compute a, room message hmangin a dawngtu hnenah `plain_blake3` angin a thawn thin. Recipient chuan download hnuah a compute leh a, a verify leh thin.
cryptoWire.h3p1: Client chuan `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) chu node ah a upload thin.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Push a due chuan node hian ephemeral X25519 key a siam a, `p256dh_pub` hmangin DH a ti a, HKDF kaltlangin AES-GCM key a derive bawk.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Sealed blob: `{endpoint, p256dh: client-a pub, auth: byte 16, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM te hian `data` chauh an hmu thin.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Client hian receive-ah a private key leh `p256dh` (a takah chuan envelope chhunga node-a ephemeral pub a ni) hmangin a decrypt thin.
cryptoWire.h4p1: Password hian Argon2id hmangin backup key a la chhuak thin (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, salt=<random 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{chi, nonce, ciphertext}` tih hi a ni. Ciphertext hi `{v:1, rooms:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, contacts:[...]}` atanga CBOR a ni.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Local-ah (iCloud / Google Drive) emaw, user-te private room-a node-ah emaw dah a ni.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Cross-node message: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, chhung lam: {... room envelope nen a inang ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` hian CBOR-a seriesized `{source_node, target_user, inner}` a huam a ni. Target hian `trusted_nodes` atanga `source_node` pubkey lakah a verify thin.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Wire-a room message pakhat chu CBOR dict a ni a, encrypted payload, nonce, sender pseudonym leh timestamp a awm bawk. Envelope hi HTTPS (POST) emaw WebSocket (frame type `m`) emaw ride pawh nise a inang vek.
cryptoWire.h1_b: Client chuan message body `{v:1, text, reply_to, sent_at}` chu CBOR → `pt` angin a serialise thin. Random 12-byte nonce a siam chhuak thin. `aad = hex(room_id)` tih a chhut. `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(room_key, nonce, pt, aad)` tih a ko thin. `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), sender_pseudo: hex(pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` ah a wrap a, a thawn bawk. Receiver chuan decrypt laiin GCM tag chu a verify a, chutah chuan plaintext chu CBOR-parse a ni.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Wire shape hi v0.0.4 atang khan version-tagged a ni a, abortive v0.0.3 release hnuah `v` field a nei lo — `thread_id` kan dah khan format pumpui kan bump a ngai a, a chhan chu client hlui te chu unknown key ah an crash a ni. Zirna: nakin lawka wire shape tin hian a field hmasa berah `v:N` a keng tel avangin forward compatibility hi a chiang hle.
cryptoWire.h2_a: File te hi fixed-size chunks ah then a ni a, file root atanga lak chhuah key leh chunk offset atanga lak chhuah key nei theuh a ni. Per-chunk encryption hmang hian sender chu chunk boundary eng pawhah pause/resume theih a ni.
cryptoWire.h2_b: File root key hi random 32 byte a ni. Chunk pakhatah key chu `HKDF(root, info="file:chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)` a ni. Chunk tin hi a key, random 96-bit nonce, leh `aad = file_id ∥ offset` hmanga AES-GCM encrypted a ni. Chunks default chu 512 KiB a ni a; 4 MiB cap a ni. Full-file BLAKE3 hi room message-ah `plain_blake3` angin thawn a ni a, chu chuan file chu a reference a, chutiang chuan recipient-te chuan decrypt hnuah an verify thei a ni.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption with per-chunk keys hi Mega.nz chuan kum 2013 khan a hmahruaitu a ni a, kum 2019 khan Signal-in large-file support hmangin a tithianghlim a, Vortex-a 512 KiB default hi mobile 4G-a TCP flow control-in pipe chu tail sei tak nei lovin a khat reng theihna size a ni. 256/512/1024/4096 KiB kan test a, kan tehnaah chuan 512 chu sweet spot a ni.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Sealed push envelope hian device-specific X25519 key hmanga encrypt in Apple / Google / Mozilla atanga notification payload a thup a ni.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Client hian node ah `p256dh_pub` leh `auth` a register thin. Push a due chuan node chu p256dh_pub hmangin ephemeral-ECDH a run a, HKDF hmangin key + nonce a derive a, auth secret chu salt angin a hmang bawk. `{title, taksa, room_id, message_id}` chu AES-GCM hmangin a encrypt. Record chu opaque `data` field angin push provider hnenah a thawn thin. Device extension hian a re-derive a, a decrypt a, a render bawk.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Sealed push hi Web Push Message Encryption spec (RFC 8291, 2017) a ni. Apple chuan iOS 16-a Notification Service Extension-ah a hmang a ni. Sealed push hi nasa taka thlawp a nih hma hian Signal leh WhatsApp te chuan content awm lovin silent "something arrived" ping an thawn a, wake-up-ah app hian message chu a rawn la tir a — chu chu a slow hle. Sealed push hian end-to-end privacy min pe bakah instant render min pe bawk.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob hmang hian password atang chauhvin device thar ah room keys + profile + last 90 chhung chu a restore thei a ni.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Backup key hi password atanga Argon2id kaltlangin random 16-byte salt hmanga lo chhuak a ni. Payload chu CBOR: `{v:1, room: [{id, key, msg_ref_ids}], profile, contacts}` a ni. Derived key hnuaiah AES-GCM hmanga encrypt a ni. Local (iCloud / Google Drive) emaw, user private cloud room-a file angin emaw dah a ni. Restore: password → Argon2id → decrypt → key leh reference te import leh rawh.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Format hi 1Password-a OPVault (2013) leh Bitwarden-a encrypted export (2017) hmanga model a ni. An pahnih hian KDF-then-AEAD chu salt-bundled metadata nen an hmang a. Vortex chuan ni 90 chhunga trimming chu a dah belh a, a chhan chu full history backups chu testing-ah 100 MB+ a nih vang a ni; restore tam zawk hian tun hnaia message chauh an mamawh a, user-in connectivity a neih laiin content hlui zawk chu server ciphertext hmangin a la thleng thei tho.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Cross-node federation message hian inner envelope encrypt tawh chu source node authenticate signed outer envelope-ah a wrap a.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A hian `{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, inner_nonce, sent_at}` chu CBOR tiin a serialize a. A Ed25519 private release key → `sig` hmangin a sign thin. Node B-a `/federation/deliver`-ah `{envelope, sig}` a POST thin. B hian `federations`-a `source_node` atan pubkey lakah `sig` a verify a, minute 5 chhunga skew window chhungin timestamp a check a, chutah chuan target user tan a inner ciphertext chu a mah ngeiin `messages` table-ah a ziak lut a ni.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Signed outer envelope te hi Matrix-a federation spec (2015) leh ActivityPub-a HTTP Signatures (2018) atanga loan lak a ni. Minute 5 chhunga window hi SMTP-a RFC 5321 recommendation nen a inmil a, attacker-in federation POST pakhat a man a, darkar engemaw zat hnuah a replay lehna replay attack a veng a ni. Vortex chuan RSA-PSS aiin Ed25519 a thlang zawk a, a chhan chu Ed25519 signatures hi 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048-a 256 bytes a nih vang a ni — federation chatty lai hian a pawimawh.
cryptoWire.h1_f:
pt = CBOR{v:1, thuziak, chhanna_to?, thread_id?, sawina?, thawn_at}
ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(room_key, nonce, pt, aad=hex(room_id)) a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.
wire = CBOR{ a ni.
  v: 1, 10 a ni.
  ciphertext: hex(ct), // a sei zawng danglam thei
  vawi khat lo: hex(12 B), .
  a thawntu_pseudo: hex(16 B), .
  thawn_ah: unix_ms
} .
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = rand (32) a ni.
chunk_key(o) = HKDF(file_root, "file:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), thuziak pangngai, aad=file_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(file_full_fleintext_bytes_a_full_file) // plain_blake3 anga thawn a ni
cryptoWire.h3_f:
hun rei lote chhunga awm = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub) tih a ni.
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm) tih a ni.
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "A chhunga thu awmte-Encoding: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\0", 12) A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a.
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{thupui, taksa, room_id, thuchah_id})
wire = chi(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ idlen(1) ∥ hun rei lote chhunga awm.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
chi = rand(16) a ni.
key = Argon2id(password, chi, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32) tih a ni.
vawi khat lo = rand(12) .
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{room, profile, inzawmna}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
file = {v:1, chi, nonce, ct} tih a ni.

auth.title: Authentication tih hi a ni
auth.subtitle: Register, login, refresh, revoke te pawh a awm bawk. JWT + X25519 + duhthlan tur passkey / chi / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex hian JWT hun rei lote chhung (15 min access, ni 30 chhung refresh) a pe chhuak a, user-in X25519 public key a bound in a, sensitive endpoint zawng zawngin JWT + key chu revoked a nih loh thu a verify vek a ni. He bung hian flow end-to-end tin a huam vek a ni.
auth.h1p1: Client chuan OS RNG hmangin 32-byte X25519 private key thar siamin a tan a. Public key a derive a, hex char 64 angin a encode a ni.
auth.h1p2: Client chuan `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}` hmangin `POST /api/authentication/register` a post a.
auth.h1p3: Node hian a validate: username chu `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (homograph squat awm loh nan lower-case) nen a inmil a; password chuan zxcvbn-style chakna a paltlang (min score 2); phone match E.164 pek a nih chuan; email matches RFC 5322 basic regex pek a nih chuan.
auth.h1p4: Node hian `x25519_public_key` uniqueness a check thin — pubkey tin hian account pakhat chiah an register thei. Hei hian pubkey ang chiah hmang nawn lehtu bulk registration attack te chu a titawp ta a ni.
auth.h1p5: Node hian password (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ah Argon2id a run a, `users.password_hash` ah `argon2:$...$` a dah thin.
auth.h1p6: Node hian JWT pahnih mint a: access (15 min, `jti:<device_id>`) leh refresh (30 d). A sawi dan chuan: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, type: access|refresh, exp: ...}`. `.env` atanga 64-byte server secret load hmanga sign HS256.
auth.h1p7: Node hian `user_devices` row a siam a: `{user_id, device_id, user_agent, created_at}`. Refresh tin hi a device_id-ah a inzawm vek a; device revoke hian chu stream chauh chu a that thin.
auth.h1p8: Chhanna: `{ok, user_id, username, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Client hian token te chu Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Cookie khauh tak (web) ah a dah thin.
auth.h1l1: Rate limit: Second 60 chhungin IP khatah registration 5. TESTING=true hian hei hi a titawp a ni.
auth.h1l2: Invite mode: `REGISTRATION_MODE=invite` a nih chuan body-ah hian `invite_code` dik tak a awm tur a ni. Code hi admin API kaltlangin siam a ni.
auth.h1l3: Mode khar: `REGISTRATION_MODE=khar a ni`. Seed admin chauh a inziak lut thei. A hnu lama hmangtute chu invite link hmangin room bik hrang hrangah an thleng thin.
auth.h2p1: Client chuan `POST /api/authentication/login` chu `{username, password}` hmangin a post thin.
auth.h2p2: Node hian `users` te chu username tenau hmangin a zawt thin. A hmuh loh chuan timing (~0.5 s either way) equalize turin constant hash lakah dummy Argon2 verify a la run reng a ni.
auth.h2p3: Argon2 verify a hlawhtlin a, account a disable loh chuan node hian register ang chiah envelope a rawn pe let leh thin. `user_devices` row thar siam a ni a; row awmsa te chu a awm mai mai avangin user chu device hrang hrangah a sign in thei a ni.
auth.h2p4: Verify a hlawhchham chuan node chuan `{error:"invalid credentials"}` hmangin 401 a rawn pe leh ang. Chhannaah hian "username dik lo" leh "password dik lo" tih hi thliar hran a ni lo.
auth.h2l1: Rate limit: IP khatah second 60 chhungin vawi 10 hlawhchham tum. A aia tam chuan `Retry-After` header hmangin 429 a rawn pe leh thin.
auth.h2l2: Account lockout: 24 h chhunga failed attempts 20 a awm chuan admin review atan account flag a ni. Legit hmangtute chuan an luh theihna tur password-reset mai mai a ni.
auth.h2l3: Session tracking: `/api/authentication/devices` hian active session zawng zawng a list vek a; user chuan eng pawh a revoke thei.
auth.h3p1: Access token expiry hnaih a nih chuan (client chuan locally `exp` a track) emaw request pakhatin `token expired` hmanga 401 a rawn thawn leh chuan client chuan `{refresh_token}` hmangin `POST /api/authentication/refresh` a post thin.
auth.h3p2: Node hian refresh chu a decode a, `user_devices`-ah `jti` a la awm tih a check (revoked lo), `exp` a check a, access token thar mint bawk.
auth.h3p3: Refresh rotation hi default-in off a ni. Refresh thar pawh chhuah theih nan `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` hmangin enable rawh.
auth.h3p4: Refresh chu expire, revoked, forged a nih chuan node chuan 401 a rawn pe kir leh a, Client chu local-in a log out a, re-login turin a ngen.
auth.h4p1: Web client te chuan platform authenticator (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) an register thei a ni. Server hian `{credential_id, public_key, counter}` a dahkhawm thin.
auth.h4p2: Login: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → server chuan challenge a rawn pe leh a; client sign-te chu passkey private (Secure Enclave / TPM-a vawn) hmangin a sign a; `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → server chuan a verify a, a issue JWT.
auth.h4p3: Counter monotonicity check: verification apiangin counter chu a increment vek tur a ni. A nih loh chuan passkey chu cloned anga ngaih a ni a, reject a ni.
auth.h5p1: Disaster-recovery path angin a hmangtu chuan thumal 24 BIP-39 chi chu a export thei a ni. Device eng pawha import hian X25519 identity (seed → HKDF → static key) chu a siam thar leh a, signed challenge hmangin possession a finfiah bawk.
auth.h5p2: Seed hian device chu a chhuahsan ngai lo. Node hian derived X25519 public key leh server challenge chunga signature chauh a hmu a ni.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bits (32 bytes) a ni. BIP-39 checksum hi standard a nih avangin typos hi server a thlen hmain a man thin.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) a ni a, step 30 leh digit 6 code a awm bawk. User pakhat tan duhthlan theih a ni.
auth.h6p2: Enrolment: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` hian thuruk + otpauth URI + QR a rawn pe leh thin. User chuan Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password hmangin a scan thin. User hian app hnathawh dan finfiah nan sample 6-digit code a post back thin.
auth.h6p3: 2FA hmangin login rawh: password a pass hnuah node chuan `{needs_2fa: true}` a rawn pe leh thin. Client chuan code a zawt a, `/api/authentication/login/2fa` ah a post thin.
auth.h6p4: Rate limit: User pakhatin min 5 chhungin 5 TOTP attempts. A aia tam chuan second 60 chhunga cooldown leh email warning a thlen thin.
auth.h6p5: Backup code: Enrolment-naah vawi khat 12 × 10-digit code tarlan a ni. Code tin hi vawi khat chiah hman theih a ni.
auth.h7: QR login (account inang pairing) a ni.
auth.h7p1: Phone logged-in chuan QR code nei tablet thar a onboard thei a ni. Device A hian `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` a post → server chuan nonce leh TTL a rawn pe leh thin.
auth.h7p2: Device A hian `nonce + user_id + server_url` awmna QR a rawn tarlang a. Device B hian nonce hmangin scan in `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` a post thin.
auth.h7p3: Server chuan nonce chu a la live tih a verify (TTL 60 s, one-shot), device B-a X25519 pubkey thar chu user A account (`user_devices` row thar)-ah a tie a, JWT chu device B-ah a rawn kir leh a ni.
auth.h7p4: Device A hian WebSocket notification `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` a dawng a, chuvang chuan user chuan real time-in a confirm / revoke thei a ni.
auth.h8p1: "Username hriat loh" leh "password dik lo" tan pawh tumruh takin error ang chiah hi kan rawn thawn let leh thin. Signup rate limit hian eng username nge awm tih a thup a ni.
auth.h8p2: Profile endpoint (`/api/users/{username}`) ah chuan auth a ngai a ni. Attacker hian token dik tak tel lo chuan username a enumerate thei lo.
auth.h8p3: `/api/authentication/login`-a rate limit hian brute force chu crawl-ah a vawng reng a ni.
auth.h1_a: Registration hian identity thar a siam a: device-ah X25519 keypair, server-ah Argon2id password hash, hlawhtlinnaah JWT pair pek chhuah.
auth.h1_b: Step 1: client chuan X25519 private key atan `crypto.randomBytes(32)` a run a, public key (phone-ah ~100 μs) a derive a. Step 2: POST /api/authentication/register tur chu `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji}` hmangin i ziak ang. Step 3: node chu Pydantic hmangin a validate (username regex, password ≥ 8 chars, phone E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Step 4: node hian Argon2id(password) → `argon2:...` a run a, `users.password_hash` ah a dah a. Step 5: node hian access JWT (15 min) + refresh JWT (ni 30) a issue a, `user_devices` row a awm reng.
auth.h1_c: Flow hi PHP-a mysql_real_escape_string hunlai tunlai evolution a ni. Tunlai auth stack zawng zawng — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — hian roughly he shape hi an ti vek a ni. Vortex-a specific twist chu register call-a X25519 pubkey thawn a ni: chu chu account chu frame khatna atang khan hun rei tak chhunga E2E identity-ah a inbun tihna a ni a, a hnua added a ni lo. Kum 2013-a Signal-in protocol design a siam aṭanga infuih tharna a ni.
auth.h2_a: Login hian password chu Argon2 hash dahkhawm nen a verify a, a inmil chuan fresh JWT pair a pe chhuak thin.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login chu `{username, password}` hmangin a ni. Node hian `users` te chu username tenau hmangin a zawt thin. A hmuh chuan Argon2id chu `users.password_hash` lakah constant time-in a verify thin. A hmuh loh chuan timing equalize turin constant string lakah dummy Argon2 verify a la run reng a ni. Hlawhtlinna → JWT pair thar + `user_devices` row thar (logged-in device khatah pakhat). Failure → 401 chu generic "invalid credentials" nen — username tha lo leh password tha lo inthliarna a awm lo, enumeration dodal turin.
auth.h2_c: User awm lote tana constant-time verification leh dummy hashing hi kum 2014-a zirchiangtute’n an login endpoint-a timing enumeration an lantir hnua Signal-in a hman dan a ni. Chumi hnuah chuan nasa takin an hmang ta a ni — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak te hian an hmang vek a ni. Practice hian login attempt hlawhchham apiangin ~0.5 s a belh a, chu chu a tha; engtin pawhin login hi 10/min/IP ah kan rate-limit thin.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id("__timing_equaliser__", chi=fixed, ...)

login(u, p) a ni a.
  row = hmangtute.find(username=u.hnuai zawk())
  row chu None a nih chuan:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // hun hman dan inang tlang
      401 tihpun a ni
  a nih loh chuan Argon2Verify(row.password_hash, p): a ni.
      401 tihpun a ni
  issue_jwt(row) ah rawn kir leh rawh.
auth.h3_a: Access token hi minute 15 hnuah a tawp thin. Refresh hian hun rei tak chhunga awm tawh refresh token chu access token thar nen a thlak a, user hnenah an password zawt nawn leh lovin.
auth.h3_b: Client hian `exp` chu local-ah a track thin. `now + 30s > exp` a nih chuan, emaw request pakhatin `token_expired` hmanga 401 a rawn thawn let chuan client chuan refresh token chu `/api/authentication/refresh` ah a POST thin. Node hian a decode a, `jti` chu `user_devices` ah a awm tih a check a, `revoked_at` ah a awm lo tih a check a, `exp` a check a, minute 15 chhunga access token thar a mint bawk. Refresh rotation hi `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` hmangin opt-in a ni — off by default a ni a, a chhan chu access refresh apianga refresh token rotate hian client pahnih a ruala an refresh hian race a siam thin a ni.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) hmangin access + refresh inthenna a rawn hmang a. Minute 15 chhunga access lifetime hi industry pumpuiah median a ni — Google hian darkar 1 a hmang a, Auth0 hian darkar 24 a default a, Okta hian darkar 1 a hmang. 15 min kan thlang a, chu chu stolen access token hman tangkai theihna window minimize nan a ni. Ni 30 chhunga refresh hi mobile app tam zawkin thla khat chhunga an inactivity chhunga an log in reng theihna tura an mamawh nen a inmil a ni.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / passkey login ah hian password aiah platform authenticator (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) hman a ni.
auth.h4_b: Enrolment: server hian challenge a post a; client authenticator chuan a secure enclave chhungah keypair thar a siam a, public key + attestation chu a thawn let leh thin. Server hian `{credential_id, public_key, counter}` a dahkhawm thin. Login: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → server chuan challenge a rawn pe leh a; client chuan authenticator-a private key (Secure Enclave-a vawn, chip chhuahsan ngai lo) hmangin a sign a; `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → server chuan signature chu a dahkhawm public key nen a verify thin. Monotonic counter hian cloned authenticators a hmuchhuak thin.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn hi FIDO Alliance-in kum tam tak an thawh hnuah kum 2019 khan W3C chuan standardized a ni. Apple iOS 16 (2022)-ah platform-authenticator support a dah belh a; Google, Microsoft, 1Password hmanga zui a ni. Vortex chuan v0.0.8-ah WebAuthn a hmang. Optional mahse strongly recommended — passkey hmangtute chuan phishing-based account takeover an hmu ngai lo a, a chhan chu private key hian device boundary a pel ngai lo.
auth.h4_f:
register_begin(): harsatna = rand (32) a ni.
                    options = { rp.id, user.id, pubKeyCredParams, challenge } te chu a hlawhtling hle.
                    return options a awm bawk

register_finish(a hriatpuina) a ni.
  TPM / Secure Enclave root CA dodalna attestation finfiah rawh.
  store { credential_id, vantlang_key, counter: 0 } a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.
auth.h5_a: Seed-phrase recovery hian thumal 24 awmna BIP-39 mnemonic atang hian device thara X25519 identity chu a siam thar leh thin. Server hian decryption material engmah a vawn tir ngai lo.
auth.h5_b: User chuan a launch hmasa berah mnemonic chu a ziak chhuak thin (optional, one-time prompt). Recover tur chuan: device thar ah chuan user chuan mnemonic a lut a; client hian PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic", round 2048) → chi byte 64 a tlan thei. Seed-a byte hmasa 32 chu X25519 private key a lo ni ta a; public key tihchhuah a ni. Server chu public key thar chauh hrilh a ni a; Ed25519 challenge-response (signed nonce) hmangin possession a verify a, chutah chuan JWTs a pe chhuak leh thin.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) hi cryptographic secrets te chu hriatreng tlak thumal list anga encode dan canonical tak a ni. 2048-word English dictionary a ni a, a tawpah chuan 4-byte checksum a awm bawk. Vortex hian thumal 24 a hmang a, a chhan chu high-security wallet (Trezor, Ledger) atana industry standard chu 24 a nih vang a ni a, 128-bit security atan chuan thumal 12 hi a tawk ang a, mahse a hmangtu tam zawk tan chuan a substantial tawk lo niin a lang.
auth.h5_f:
thumal = BIP39_Encode (entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum) a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.
chi = PBKDF2-SHA512(thumal, "hriatrengna", round=2048, len=64)
sk = chi[0:32] // X25519 mimal
pk = sk · G // X25519 mipui hriatah
auth.h6_a: Two-factor authentication hian password verification hnuah time-based one-time password (TOTP) step a dah belh a ni.
auth.h6_b: Enrolment: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → server hian 160-bit random secret a siam a, base32 string + QR scanning atan otpauth:// URI angin a rawn pe kir leh thin. User chuan Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password hmangin a scan thin; setup a thawk tha tih finfiah nan sample 6-digit code a post back. Login: password a pass hnuah server chuan JWTs ai chuan `{needs_2fa: true}` a rawn pe leh thin. Client chuan digit 6 code a zawt a, POST `/api/authentication/login/2fa` a ti bawk. Server chuan HOTP(secret, T=now_unix / 30) chu code nen a verify a.
auth.h6_c: TOTP hi kum 2011 khan Mark Pei chuan RFC 6238 tiin standardized a ni. Chumi hma chuan RSA SecurID hian proprietary algorithm a hmang a; hnuah, 2FA app tin chu TOTP ah a settled vek. Vortex hian second 30 step leh digit 6 a sei zawng hi RFC default a ni. Backup code (12 × 10-digit, vawi khat tarlan) hi kum 2012 atanga GitHub design atanga loan lak a ni.
auth.h6_f:
secret = rand(20 bytes) // RFC 6238 ah bit 160 a awm
TOTP(thuruk, t) = HOTP(thuruk, ⌊t / 30⌋) a ni.
A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em bawk a. HOTP(k, c) = truncate( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

window: clock skew atan ±1 step tolerated a ni
auth.h7_a: QR login hian password type nawn ngai lovin device thar chu account awmsaah a pair thin. Phone login tawh hian nonce a sign a, chu chu device tharin authenticate nan a hmang a ni.
auth.h7_b: Device A chuan `/api/authentication/qr/begin` a post a. Server hian TTL 60s nei 128-bit nonce a siam a, A-a user_id-ah a bind a, a rawn pe kir leh thin. A hian nonce encoded chu QR (`nonce + user_id + server_url` a huam) angin a tarlang a. Device B chuan a scan a, nonce hmangin `/api/authentication/qr/verify` a post a. Server: nonce valid leh one-shot a ni em? B-a X25519 pubkey thar chu user_id (`user_devices` row thar) nen inzawm tir la, B tan JWTs mint rawh.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing hi WhatsApp Web-in kum 2015 khan a lar hmasa ber a, Telegram-in a zui a; Signal chuan kum 2021 khan an multi-device support atan an copy a, Vortex-a twist: pairing event tin hi original device-ah "confirm" button hmangin a rawn lang chhuak a, chuvangin attacker chuan screenshot atanga QR chu a man chuan device A-a user interaction awm lovin pairing a zo thei lo.
auth.h8_a: Account enumeration dodalna — auth bung chhunga tel ve. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
auth.h8_b: "Account enumeration resistance" atana hman dan tlangpui. Mechanism hi a inmil module-ah `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, emaw `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` tih hnuaiah implement a ni. Module README hian file path dik tak a ko chhuak thin.
auth.h8_c: "Account enumeration resistance" mechanism hi Vortex release hrang hrangah a lo thang chho ta a ni. Design hi a hmaa messenger-te research leh production practice tihchhuah tawh atanga lo chhuak a ni. `CHANGELOG.md`-a version history-ah chuan piece tinte chu engtikah nge a tlak tih leh eng thilin nge a chhan tih a record a ni.

rooms.title: Room leh messaging te pawh a awm bawk
rooms.subtitle: Room chi pali, membership, key rotation, message te.
rooms.intro: Room chi pali — DM, private group, public group, channel — te hian `rooms` table hnuaia awm pakhat an hmang vek a. Behavior hi boolean flag hmanga gate a ni.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: member pahnih chiah, `is_dm=dik`, `is_private=dik`. Member dang handle-ah hming auto-set rawh.
rooms.h1p2: **Mimal group**: sawmna chauh, `is_private=dik`, `is_channel=dik lo`. Member tam ber 5000 vel default a ni.
rooms.h1p3: **Mipui pawl**: `is_private=dik lo`. Invite link nei apiangin an join thei a; a neituin a duh chuan public directory-ah listed a ni.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: tihchhuah chauh, `is_channel=dik`. A neitu/admin-te chauhin an post thei a; member pangngaiin an chhiar thin.
rooms.h2: Member nihna leh chanvo hrang hrang
rooms.h2p1: Hnathawh tur: `neitu`, `admin`, `member`. Room khatah neitu pakhat chauh (assignable).
rooms.h2p2: Admin te hian room settings an invite thei a, an kick thei a, an mute thei a, an edit thei bawk. Member ten message an thawn thei a, an react thei a, an edit thei bawk a, an delete thei bawk.
rooms.h2p3: Permissions cascade: neitute hian admin power zawng zawng an nei vek. Admin te hian a neitu chu an demote thei lo.
rooms.h2p4: Role thlak danglamna hian member tinte hmuh theih tur system message (`kind: "role_changed"`) a siam chhuak thin.
rooms.h3p1: Room tin hian 32-byte **root key** a nei a, chu chu a siamtu device-a `secrets.token_bytes(32)` hmanga siam chhuah a ni.
rooms.h3p2: Member tin hian envelope `{member_id, envelope: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` an dawng a, chu chu `room_keys`-ah dah a ni.
rooms.h3p3: Member pakhatin a join chuan member awm tawh tu pawhin an tan envelope thar min siamsak thin. Envelope minting hi join khatah O(1) a ni.
rooms.h3p4: Member pakhat a chhuah chuan room chu a rotate a: creator (or first active admin) chuan root thar a derive a, member la awmte hnenah re-envelope a, WebSocket kaltlangin `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` a post thin. Ciphertext hlui chu key hlui hmangin chhiar theihin a awm reng a, chu chu client-te’n an la cach tawh a ni.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: member > 1000 awmna public room tan chuan envelope scaling tihtawp a ni. Chu ai chuan a neitu chuan `room_public_keys` table-ah root key awm mek chu a sign a, a publish zawk a ni. Client te chuan room neitu pubkey nen signature an verify thin. Chuvangin member leave-a rotation hi Variant-B room tan chuan no-op a ni.
rooms.h3l2: Per-room pseudo: room tin hian `room_pseudo_salt` an nei bawk. Message-a member hming lemte chu `HMAC-SHA256(salt, user_id)` hex char 16-a tihtlem a ni. Node hian client-side mapping awm lovin eng user nge eng message nge thawn tih a hre thei lo.
rooms.h4p1: Message-te hian room khatah monotonic ID an nei (64-bit auto-increment, Postgres-ah `bigserial`, SQLite-ah `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`).
rooms.h4p2: Ordering hi server-in a ruat a ni. Client te hi timestamp chungchangah an insual lo va; ID order-in an render a, a thawntu wall-clock hun chu UI metadata chauh angin an lantir bawk.
rooms.h4p3: Edits: ciphertext thar hian in-place hlui, `edited_at` updates te chu a thlak a ni. Client te hian `(edited)` mark an lantir thin.
rooms.h4p4: Deletes: `deleted_at` set la, ciphertext chu null out rawh. `{type:"m", tihbo:true}` tihchhuah a ni.
rooms.h4p5: Chhanna: `reply_to` = thuchah id referenced. Client te hian quote header te tak te an render thin.
rooms.h5p1: Reactions chu `reactions(message_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)` a row awm a ni. Client chuan `/api/messages/{id}/reactions/{emoji}` a POST thin. DELETE chu un-reacts te tan a ni.
rooms.h5p2: Node hian subscriber tin hnenah `{type:"m", reactions:[...]}` a fans out thin. Client te chu an aggregate thin.
rooms.h5p3: Emoji — Unicode eng pawhah khapna a awm lo. Client te chuan de-dupe leh render count an ti thin.
rooms.h6p1: Thread chu thuchah atanga zung kai, pseudo-room a ni. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` hian `{id: <room_id_thar>, nu leh pa_message_id: <msg_id>, nu leh pa room_id: <original>}` a siam a.
rooms.h6p2: Thread room te hian nu leh pa hnen atangin membership an rochun thin. Parent-room member tu pawhin eng thread-ah pawh post theih a ni.
rooms.h6p3: Key derivation: thread root key = `HKDF(nu leh pa_root, info: "thread:" + <nu leh pa_thuchah_id>, len: 32)`. Thread key compromise hian parent a leak lo.
rooms.h7p1: Admin ten room khatah message 10 thleng an pin thei. `POST /api/rooms/{id}/pin` tih hmangin `{message_id}` tih a ni.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned set chu room open-ah load a ni a; clients te chuan a chung lamah pinned header an render thin.
rooms.h8p1: Room khata draft te chu node: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` ah hian a awm reng a, `{text}` nen. `GET` hian current a rawn pe leh thin. `DELETE` a tifai.
rooms.h8p2: Client te hian device hrang hrangah draft an sync avangin phone-a type chu desktop-ah a tawp ta a ni. Draft hi end-to-end encrypted a ni lo — server-a hmuh theih plaintext a ni. Chu chu cross-device UX atana tumruh taka sumdawnna a ni. User object tu te chuan sync per-room an disable thei.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` tih hmangin `{room_id, ciphertext, send_at}` tih a ni. Node hian `scheduled_messages` ah a dah a; cron hnathawk pakhat chuan a hun takah a commit thin.
rooms.h9p2: send_at tick a kang thlengin edit theih leh cancel theih a ni. Send hnuah chuan message chu `messages`-ah row pangngai a lo ni ta a ni.
rooms.h1_a: Room chi pali (DM, private group, public group, channel) te hian `rooms` table pakhat an hmang vek a. A danglamna chu boolean flag pathum ah a awm.
rooms.h1_b: Flags: `is_dm`, `hi_mimal`, `hi_channel` tih te a ni. DM: is_dm=dik, is_private=dik, member 2 chiah. Mimal pawl: is_private=true, is_channel=false, member 5000 thleng an awm. Public group: is_private=false, neituin a duh chuan directory-ah list a ni Channel: is_channel=true, neitu/admins chauhin an post. An vai hian key management, fan-out, reaction, thread te an insem vek.
rooms.h1_c: Single-table polymorphism hi Martin Fowler-a *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002) atanga lak chhuah a ni. Telegram hian chhungril lamah room chi hrang hrang pathum a hmang a; Slack hian channel + DM + multi-party DM hi chi li angin a hmang a; Discord hian engkim atan "channel" a hmang thin. Profiling-in a senso ber chu fan-out a nih thu a lantir hnuah one-table kan thlang a (chu chu type hrang hrangah uniform a ni) leh v0.0.3 refactor-in table inang pathum chu pakhatah a dah khawm hnuah.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE room (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  type VARCHAR(16), -- legacy, flag awmna redundant
  hming VARCHAR(256), .
  a_mimal BOOLEAN, .
  chu_channel a ni BOOLEAN, .
  is_dm BOOLEAN, 1999 a ni.
  member_count INT, 2019 a ni.
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512) ah a awm a, a man pawh a tlawm hle.
  siam_chuan TIMESTAMP, .
  created_by BIGINT REFERENCES hmangtute(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Role hi tier thum a ni a, neitu, admin, member. Room khatah neitu pakhat chiah, admin pakhat tal, duh duh member tam tak.
rooms.h2_b: `room_members(room_id, user_id, chanvo, joined_at, muted_until)`. Roles cascade: neitute hian admin power zawng zawng an nei vek. Admin te hian room settings an invite, kick, mute, leh edit thei mahse a neitu chu an demote thei lo. Member ten message an thawn thei a, an react thei a, an edit thei bawk a, an delete thei bawk. `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` kaltlangin `new_owner_id` hmangin neitu transfer — neitu hlui chu admin-ah a tla thla.
rooms.h2_c: Owner/admin/member hi kum 1988 atanga tripartite IRC op/voice/user model a ni a, a hnuah Slack, Discord, Telegram te chuan an hmang ta a ni. A neitu pakhat chiah (a tam lo) neih duhna bik chu dan anga ngaihtuah a\anga lo chhuak a ni: group-liability dan nei jurisdiction-ah chuan neitu pakhat chiang tak neih hian DMCA leh a ang chi dilnate a ti awlsam a ni.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE room_member (
  room_id BIGINT, 2019 a ni.
  user_id BIGINT, 1999 a ni.
  chanvo VARCHAR(16) CHECK(role IN (‘neitu’,‘admin’,‘member’)), .
  TIMESTAMP, 2019 khan a zawm.
  TIMESTAMP thlengin muted_in, .
  PRIMARY KEY (room_id, user_id) tih a ni.
);
rooms.h3_a: Room tinah hian 32-byte symmetric root key a awm a. Member-te chuan an X25519 pubkey hnuaiah copy khuh an keng a.
rooms.h3_b: Siam a nih chuan client hian `root_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)` a siam chhuak thin. Member tin tan client chuan `X25519(member_pubkey)` → envelope hnuaiah `root_key` a encrypt thin. Envelope te hi `room_keys(room_id, user_id, envelope)` ah an awm thin. User pakhatin a join hian member awm tawh tu pawhin an tan envelope thar a mint thin. User a chhuah chuan a neitu emaw active admin hmasa ber emaw a rotate — root_key thar a siam a, member la awmte tan a envelope leh a, WebSocket chungah `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` a broadcast a ni.
rooms.h3_c: Per-member wrapping hi Signal-in kum 2014-a a group-v2-a a hmahruaitu pattern a ni. Matrix-a Megolm pawhin hetiang bawk hian "sender keys" approach a hmang bawk. Vortex chu per-member envelope nen a kal a, a chhan chu ngaihtuah a awlsam zawk a ni: senders inkara forward secrecy drift awm lo. Trade-off chu membership thlak danglam chungchangah O(N) envelope minting a ni a, hei hi member ~5000 thleng a ni a; public-channel Variant-B chuan a huam chin chu a sidestep a ni.
rooms.h3_f:
on create:
  root_key = rand (32) tih a ni.
  member zingah m tan:
    envelope[m] = X25519_Encrypt(m.pubkey, root_key) tih a ni.

chawlh neiin:
  thar_root = rand (32) a ni.
  rebroadcast(member la awmte tan envelope thar)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish hian member pakhat tan envelope chu signed key pakhat hmangin a thlak a, public-read table-ah post a ni. Member 100k+ thleng scale a ni.
rooms.h4_b: O(N) envelope minting ai chuan a neitu chuan root_key chu sign in `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)` ah a post thin. Client te chuan an la a, a neitu Ed25519 pubkey nen an verify a, an hmang bawk. Rotation hi membership thlak danglamna atana no-op a ni — chabi neitu apiangin an kick tawh pawhin an la nei tho. Chu chu "deep history" hi threat model ni lo mahse reach and scale a nihna public announce-channel tan chuan pawm theih a ni.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B hi Matrix-a "world readable" history visibility leh signed key rotation nena inzawm model a ni. Beta hian 50k-member public channel a neih hnuah v0.0.8-ah Vortex-ah dah belh a ni a, a periodic re-envelope bursts chuan node chu a saturate a ni. Signed-and-published approach hi membership inthlak danglamna (a awm reng) aiin key rotations (a tlem hle) hmangin linear takin a scale zawk a ni.
rooms.h4_f:
Variant-B-ah hian a awm a.
  neitu chhinchhiahna: sig = Ed25519Sign(neitu_priv, room_id ∥ root_key ∥ version)
  publish: room_public_keys += {room_id, root_key, version, sig} te chu a hlawhtling hle.
  client: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → owner_pubkey lakah sig tih finfiah rawh
rooms.h5_a: Invite code hi hex char 32 a ni. Optional max_uses, expires_at, assign_role, tihdanglam theih te a ni.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-only) hian `invites(code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)` ah row a siam a. `POST /api/rooms/join` code hmang hian validity a check (revok lo, expired lo, used_count < max_uses), `used_count` a tipung a, `room_members` row a siam a, room metadata a rawn pe leh bawk. `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` hmanga revoke — a hnu lama join te chu a hlawhchham.
rooms.h5_c: Primitive anga invite code hi IRC-a `+i` mode (1988) ang bawka hlui a ni. Telegram-a public invite links expiry leh use limits nei chu kum 2017 khan hman tan a ni a, Vortex-a variant hian `assign_role` a dah belh a, chuvang chuan neitute chuan admin-granting code chu him takin one-shot format-ah an sem chhuak thei a ni — an user id dik tak chu upfront-a hriat ngai lovin moderator thar onboard-na atan a tangkai hle.
rooms.h5_f:
sawmna row:
  code : VARCHAR(64) -- Hex char 32 a awm
  room_id : BIGINT tih a ni.
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = tihkhawtlai loh
  hman tawh zat : INT .
  expires_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = engtikah mah
  assign_role : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = member a ni
  revoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = nung reng a ni
rooms.h6_a: Message row pakhatah hian ciphertext + metadata a awm a; sender hi plaintext-ah dah a ni ngai lo.
rooms.h6_b: `messages(id, room_id, thawntu_id, ciphertext, nonce, thawntu_pseudo, thawn_at, edit_at?, deleted_at?, reply_to?, thread_id?, chi)`. `sender_id` hi access control atan a awm a, index a ni. `sender_pseudo` hi sender_id a per-room deterministic hash a nih avangin fan-out hian users table a khawih a ngai lo. `kind` hi: thuziak, thlalak, file, aw, call, system zinga pakhat a ni. `ciphertext` chu opaque AES-GCM output a ni a; key nei room member chauhvin an decrypt thei.
rooms.h6_c: Sender_pseudo ngaihtuahna hi Signal sealed-sender (2018) atanga lo chhuak a ni. Signal hian server chu sender identity a blind nan a hmang a; kan hmang bawk a, mahse `sender_id` cleartext for ACL leh rate limits kan vawng reng thung. Split hian full DB dump-a server-in tuin nge eng nge a sawi tih a hriat lohvin "member chauhin an post thei" tih kan enforce thei a ni.
rooms.h7_a: Edits chuan `ciphertext` chu a hmunah a overwrite a, `edited_at` chu a bump bawk. Null out ciphertext a delete a, `deleted_at` a set.
rooms.h7_b: Edit: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` chu `{ciphertext, nonce}` thar nen. A thawntu chauhvin anmahni message an edit thei. Row-a ciphertext/nonce thlak a ni a, `edited_at = now`, `kind` tihdanglam loh. Fan-out `{type:"m", id, ct, nonce, edited_at}` tih a ni. Delete: `DELETE /api/thuchah/{id}` tih hi a ni. Sender emaw admin emaw a delete thei. `deleted_at = tunah`, `ciphertext = NULL` tih te hi a ni. Row a awm reng avangin reply te hian awmzia a la nei tho. Fan-out `{type:"m", tihbo:dik, id}` tih a ni.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place chu Telegram/Slack pattern a ni a; Discord hian a tir lamah edit history kimchang a vawng a, chutah chuan privacy atan a drop leh ta a ni. Vortex hian a thar ber chauh a vawng reng — edit history hi deleted-edit recoverable a nih chuan PR incidents source a ni. Null ciphertext nei soft-delete hi Telegram playbook atanga lak a ni a, content vawng reng lovin reply chain a humhim thei bawk.
rooms.h7_f:
edit: UPDATE thuchah SET ciphertext = $1, nonce = $2, edited_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
delete: UPDATE message SET delete_at = NOW(), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $1

files.title: File leh attachment te pawh a awm bawk
files.subtitle: Single-shot for small, resumable for large, client-side encryption pahnih tan.
files.intro: File upload apiang hi encryption pipeline khat kaltlangin a kal vek a. Path hrang hrangte inthlauhna chu network resilience chungchang chauh a ni: resumable hian flaky links a tuar thei.
files.h1p1: Cap: 5 MB a ni. Thlalak, voice note, short clip atan hman a ni.
files.h1p2: Client hian file pumpui chu AES-GCM hmangin a encrypt a, random 96-bit nonce, key = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: `multipart/form-data` chu `/api/files` ah a POST a, field `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (hint; server chuan `python-magic` hmangin a check leh thin).
files.h1p4: Node hian `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` hnuaiah a dah a, `{file_id, url}` a rawn pe leh thin.
files.h1p5: Client chuan room message a post a, chu chuan file_id chu a reference a, a ciphertext-ah file_root chu a keng tel a, chutiang chuan room member-te chuan an decrypt thei a ni.
files.h2: Upload dan tur chu resumable theih a ni
files.h2p1: Cap: 5 GB (`RESUMABLE_MAX=5368709120` hmanga siam theih a ni).
files.h2p2: Stage 1: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` tih hmangin `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` tih a ni. Node hian upload id a allocate a, chunk size (default 512 KiB, 4 MiB-a capped) a thlang a, `{upload_id, chunk_size}` a rawn pe leh thin.
files.h2p3: Stage 2: chunk tin tan `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` chu raw ciphertext body nen. Offsets chu `chunk_size` ah a align tur a ni.
files.h2p4: Stage 3: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` chu `{plain_blake3}` hmangin a ni. Node hian a reassemble leh a, size a verify a, a store a, `{file_id, url}` a rawn pe leh bawk.
files.h2p5: Failure handling: upload tihtawp chu offset awm lo chauh re-post-in a chhunzawm leh thei. Node hian Redis (or in-memory for SQLite mode) ah eng offset nge lo thleng tih a track thin.
files.h2p6: TTL: upload zawh loh chu 24 h hnuah purge a ni.
files.h3p1: Image upload (MIME `image/*`) hian Pillow-based thumbnail generator chu 256×256 JPEG q=80 ah a trigger thin. `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg` hnuaiah dah a ni.
files.h3p2: Thumbnail pawh client-side encrypted a ni bawk — recipient hian render turin file_root a mamawh a ni. List preview atan bandwidth a save thin.
files.h3p3: Video upload (MIME `video/*`) hian clip duration 10 % ah ffmpeg-based poster extraction a tichhuak a, chutiang bawka dah a ni.
files.h4p1: Client-in a thehluh `mime_type` chu a hint a ni. Server hian a hmasa ber 1 KB lakah `python-magic` a run a, sniffed type chu deny list-ah a awm chuan a reject a: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Hei hian naive users te chu messenger kaltlangin malware an sem palh loh nan a titawp a ni. Motivated attackers te hian container label dik tak hmangin an la bypass thei tho a ni — defense chu client-side unwrap refusal a ni a, server-side sniff a ni lo.
files.h5p1: Default: tualchhung filesystem a ni. Good chu single-node deploy atan a ni.
files.h5p2: S3: `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...` tih kha set rawh. File te chu node disk khawih lovin S3 ah direct in stream a ni. Download atan hian URL presigned te hman a ni.
files.h5p3: IPFS: experimental a ni. Upload-te chuan DHT kaltlangin CID an puang a; downloads chuan pinning node eng pawh a la chhuak thin.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload hi 5 MB hnuai lam eng thil pawh tan chuan kawng chak tak a ni — thlalak, voice note, short clip. HTTPS POST pakhat, encrypted blob pakhat, `files`-a row khat.
files.h1_b: Client chuan file byte chu a tawp atanga a tawp thlengin AES-GCM hmangin random 32-byte `file_root` hnuaiah a encrypt thin. `multipart/form-data` chu `/api/files` ah a POST a, field `file` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (hint) te a awm bawk. Node hian receive buffer level-ah 5 MB cap chu a enforce a, type detection atan `python-magic` a run a, MIME chu deny list-ah a awm chuan a reject a, `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin` hnuaiah a dah a, `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}` a rawn pe leh bawk. Client chuan `file_id` reference-in room message a post a, a ciphertext-ah `file_root` a keng tel bawk.
files.h1_c: 5 MB cap hi Slack leh Telegram te hian an "inline" upload path atana an hman number inang a ni. File lian zawk chu resumable path ah a kal thin. Vortex hmasa khan 100 MB single-shot cap a nei a; profiling-ah 5 MB aia sang single-shot upload-ah mobile network-ah 40 % drop rate a awm tih kan hmuh hnuah 5 MB-ah kan tlahniam a ni. Resumable path hi file lian zawk tan chuan strict takin a tha zawk a, happy path-a roundtrip tam zawk ni mahse.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload hi file lian tak tak tan chuan kawng a ni. Client hian fixed-size chunks a upload a, a pause thei a, chunk boundary eng pawhah a resume thei a, network blip atanga a recover thei bawk.
files.h2_b: Stage thum nei protocol a ni. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` hmangin `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → node chuan `upload_id` a pe a + chunk size a nemnghet. Chunks: offset tin atan `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` chu raw ciphertext body nen. Offsets chu chunk_size multiple a ni tur a ni. Finalise: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` chu `{plain_blake3}` hmangin — node chu a inzawm khawm leh a, size + tag a verify a, a dahkhawm a, `{file_id, url}` a rawn pe leh a ni.
files.h2_c: Stage thum nei protocol hi tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 multipart uploads, leh Google Drive resumable uploads te nen a pianzia inang a ni. Vortex hian tus.io shape hi a hmang a, a chhan chu FastAPI + streaming atana match awlsam ber a nih vang a ni. Upload zawh loha 24 h TTL hi S3 default nen a inmil a, server disk hman dan nen balance resume flexibility a awm bawk.
files.h3_a: Thumbnail hi upload laiin server-side-ah siam a ni a, mahse file root khat hnuaiah encrypted-in a awm reng a, chuvangin room member-te chauhvin an render thei a ni.
files.h3_b: `Image/*` MIME tan chuan Pillow hian decrypted preview atang hian 256×256 JPEG q=80 a siam chhuak thin. Nghak rawh — ni lo, server hian plaintext a nei ngai lo. Flow dik: client hian thumb chu local-in a generate a, file_root + new nonce ang chiah hmangin a encrypt a, sibling blob angin a upload a, room message-ah `thumb_id` a reference bawk. Server hian ciphertext chu a dahkhawm thin. `video/*` tan chuan client hian ffmpeg atanga chhuak keyframe hmangin chutiang bawk chuan a ti thin.
files.h3_c: Vortex hmasa khan plaintext atanga server-side thumbnail generation a nei a — security review-in E2E guarantee a bawhchhiat thu a tarlan hnuah v0.0.4-ah chu capability chu kan strip a ni. Client-side thumbs hi Signal-in kum 2018 aṭanga a hman ṭhin pattern a ni a, WhatsApp-in kum 2020 aṭanga a hman ṭhin pattern a ni a, bandwidth man hi a tlem hle — 256×256 JPEG chu 20 KB hnuai lam a ni.
files.h4_a: Server chuan accidentally-distributed executables tihtawp nan sniff layer-ah MIME deny list a enforce a.
files.h4_b: Full upload (single-shot) emaw finalize (resumable) hnuah server chuan ciphertext-a host container 1 KB hmasa ber chungah `python-magic` a run a, type dik tak chu a hmuchhuak a ni. Sniff hian `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), emaw `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O) emaw a report chuan upload chu 415 Unsupported Media Type hmangin a reject a ni. Hei hi server policy a ni a, security boundary a ni lo — client room member-te chuan sniff bypass thei wrapper format an la install thei tho.
files.h4_c: MIME denial policy anga sniffing hi kum 2012 atanga IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X a ni a, Discord / Slack / Telegram an ti vek. A limitation (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) hi kum 2016 atang khan hriat a ni tawh — kan defense hi layered a ni: plus user-side warnings on any file with an executable extension.
files.h5_a: Storage backends — files bung khata tel. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
files.h5_b: "Storage backends" atana implementation thlirletna. Mechanism hi a inmil module-ah `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, emaw `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` tih hnuaiah implement a ni. Module README hian file path dik tak a ko chhuak thin.
files.h5_c: "Storage backends" mechanism hi Vortex release hrang hrangah a lo thang chho ta a ni. Design hi a hmaa messenger-te research leh production practice tihchhuah tawh atanga lo chhuak a ni. `CHANGELOG.md`-a version history-ah chuan piece tinte chu engtikah nge a tlak tih leh eng thilin nge a chhan tih a record a ni.

presence.title: Presence leh delivery signal te a awm
presence.subtitle: Typing indicator, read receipt, last-seen — zawng zawng hi ephemeral vek a ni.
presence.intro: Heng signal te hi a ri nasa hle. Vortex hian default-in off-persistence-ah a dah a: type hi Redis (or in-memory)-ah a nung a, read receipt hi restart atanga damchhuak signal awmchhun a ni.
presence.h1: Typing indicator te pawh a awm
presence.h1p1: Client chuan keystroke-ah `{type:"t", room:..., state:"start"|"stop"}` a thawn thin. Debounced chu a tam berah 3 s chhungin event pakhatah a ni.
presence.h1p2: Node hian subscribed WebSockets zawng zawng hnenah `{type:"t", room:..., user:..., state:...}` a tichhuak thin.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: client side-a s 10 hnuah a hnuaia `stop` times out awm lovin `start`.
presence.h2p1: Client chuan `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` chu `{last_read_message_id}` hmangin a POST thin.
presence.h2p2: Node hi `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` ah a awm reng a, `{type:"r", room:..., user:..., message_id:...}` a tichhuak thin.
presence.h2p3: Client te chuan outbound message hnuaiah "seen by N" an render thin.
presence.h2p4: Privacy: user chuan "seen" chu a disable vek thei a; tichuan node chuan an tan receipt a persist lo. Trade-off: midang receipt (symmetry) pawh an hmu lo.
presence.h3p1: Node hian user pakhatah `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) a track thin. WebSocket frame tin ah update thin a ni.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (user-choosable): dik tak, min 5 hnaih ber thlenga round, darkar hnai ber thlenga round, "tun hnai", emaw off emaw.
presence.h3p3: `GET /api/users/{id}/presence` hmanga zawhna zawh a ni. `{type:"sub_presence", user:...}` hmanga subscribe a ni.
presence.h4p1: User pakhat chu a device eng pawhah active WebSocket pakhat tal a neih chuan "online" a ni.
presence.h4p2: Contact-te tan chauh hmuh theih — contact ni lote chuan last-seen an hmu a, live dot erawh an hmu lo.
presence.h1_a: Typing indicator hi WebSocket frame `{type:"t", room, state: "start"|"stop"}` hmangin thawn a ni a, node hmangin room chhunga subscriber zawng zawng hnenah a broadcast a ni.
presence.h1_b: Client chu 3 s-ah a debounce — keystroke hmasa ber chuan `start` a thawn a, a hnua 3 s chhungin engmah a ti lo. Keystroke hnuhnung ber atanga 10 s hnuah client chuan `stop` a thawn a. Node hian frame chu thumal hmangin a broadcast a, a hmaah `user_id` a dah a ni. No persistence — type state chu in-memory per-room dicts (or Redis pub/sub for multi-node) ah a nung a. Receiver lam ah 10 s auto-expire: update a lo thlen loh chuan client te chuan tihtawp an ti thin.
presence.h1_c: Typing indicator te hi AIM / ICQ (1997) atang khan a ni. Modern debounced designs trace to Skype 2006 and iMessage 2011. 3 s / 10 s number te hi iMessage-in a hmuh dan atanga lak a ni — kan A/B test 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 leh 3/10 te khan subjective "matches human rhythm" feedback tha ber kan nei a.
presence.h2_a: Read receipt chu a awm reng a: client POSTs last-read message id; node hian `read_receipts` ah a dah a, broadcast a ti bawk.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` tih hmangin `{last_read_message_id}` tih a ni. Node hian `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` chu UPSERT semantics hmangin a update thin. `{type:"r", room, user, message_id, read_at}` tihchhuah a ni. Client te chuan outbound message hnuaiah "seen by N" an render thin. Privacy: user chuan receipt chu a disable vek thei a; tichuan node chu an tan a persist lo AND midang receipt (symmetric) an hmu lo.
presence.h2_c: Read receipt hi iMessage 2011 leh WhatsApp 2014 hnuah hmun tinah a awm ta a, symmetry rule (i ta i thup chuan midang ta i hmu lo) hi Telegram 2014 atanga siam a ni a, one-way surveillance channel pumpelh theihna awmchhun a ni. Vortex hian server-ah symmetry a enforce a — client chauh ni lovin — chuvangin flag chungchanga thu dik lo sawitu client-te chuan visibility an la hmu lo.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen hi per-user timestamp pakhat a ni a, WebSocket frame tinah update thin a ni a, frame a thlen loh chuan aging out thin.
presence.h3_b: Node hian `presence.last_seen_at` chu unix ms angin a track thin. Chu user hnen atanga authenticated WebSocket frame tin ah update thin. `GET /api/users/{id}/presence` hmangin chhiar rawh. `{type:"sub_presence", user}` hmangin subscribe la, live push on change i hmu thei ang. Granularity hi user-configurable a ni: timestamp dik tak, 5 min-a round, 1 h-a round, "tun hnai", emaw off emaw a ni.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers hian kum 2012-a WhatsApp-in stalking hmuh hnuhnung ber chungchanga complaint a neih hnuah kum 2012-a privacy update a neih hnuah a zawn chhuak a ni. Telegram chuan kum 2013 khan "tun hnai / kar khat chhunga / thla khat chhunga" bucket te chu a rawn dah belh leh a. Vortex-a 5 min / 1 h / "tun hnaia" tih chu Telegram a ni. "Off" option hian read receipt ang bawkin midang last-seen a hmuh loh nan symmetrically a thup a ni.
presence.h4_a: Online indicator: user pakhat chu a device eng emaw zat ah live WebSocket pakhat tal a neih chuan "online" a ni.
presence.h4_b: Node hian `active_ws_count(user_id)` chu memory ah a vawng reng thin. WS upgrade-ah a pung a, close-ah a tlahniam bawk. `online = active_ws_count(user_id) > 0` a ni. Contact-te tan chauh hmuh theih — contact ni lote chuan last-seen an hmu (granularity hnuaiah) mahse live green dot an hmu ngai lo. Count hian kawng khata zero a pelh chuan events fire thlak rawh.
presence.h4_c: Contacts-only visibility hi messenger serious zawng zawngin stalking vawi tam tak an neih hnua an settled model a ni (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Vortex hmasa ber online chu mi zawng zawng hmuh theih tura siam; beta reviewer pakhatin public room-ah mi hriat loh sang tam tak awmna chu mi hriat loh dang sang tam tak hnenah a leak dawn tih a sawi hnuah default chu kan flip a ni.

         Keystroke hnuhnung ber atanga s 10 hnuah → {type:"t", state:"stop"} thawn rawh.
receiver: "start" hnuhnung ber atanga s 10 hnuah "stop" a lo thlen loh chuan auto-stop

user.hides_receipts a nih chuan:

presence.h3_f:
granularity a awm a: 1.1.
  exact → last_seen_at-ah rawn kir leh rawh
  5_min → ⌊hmuh hnuhnun ber / 300000⌋ · 300000 kir leh rawh

online(u) = (|{ws ∈ open_ws : ws.user_id == u}| > 0) A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em bawk a.
visibility: contacts-only (contact ni lote tan last-seen chauh en rawh)

calls.title: WebRTC a rawn call a
calls.subtitle: Voice + video, 1:1 leh group, WebSocket hmanga signal pek, coturn hmanga relay.
calls.intro: Vortex hian stock WebRTC stack a hmang a. Node hi signalling chauh a ni. Peer-te’n an ICE candidate-te an connect hnu chuan media chu direct-in (peer-to-peer) emaw, TURN relay hmangin bad NAT-ah emaw a luang chhuak thin.
calls.h1p1: Caller: `POST /api/calls/{room_id}/start` tih hmangin `{video: bool, audio: bool}` tih a ni. Node hian call_id a allocate a, room-ah `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` a broadcast thin.
calls.h1p3: Offer/chhanna inthlengna: `{kind:"offer", sdp:...}` → `{kind:"chhanna", sdp:...}` → `{kind:"candidate", ice:...}` × N connect a nih hma loh chuan.
calls.h1p4: Call tawp: `POST /api/calls/{call_id}/tawp`. Khawi lam pawhin phone an dah thei. Node hian `call_records(call_id, duration_s, video, audio, party hrang hrangte)` a record thin.
calls.h2p1: Server Interactive Connectivity din a ni. Peer te chuan candidate (host, srflx, prflx, relay) te an inthleng thin.
calls.h2p2: STUN: coturn nen bundled a ni. Symmetric-NAT detection atan stun-only mode hman a ni.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn chu HMAC-a signed hun rei lote chhunga credentials nen. Call tin hian fresh creds 24 h chhung hman theih a hmu thin.
calls.h2p4: Credentials: `{username: <timestamp>:<user_id>, password: base64(HMAC-SHA1(thuruk, hmangtu hming))}`. Standard RFC 5389 hmanga siam a ni.
calls.h3p1: Audio: Opus 48 kHz a bitrate danglam thei (6-128 kbps) a ni. DTX on for silence tihtawp nan.
calls.h3p2: Video: VP9 (duh zawk) / H.264 / AV1 (opt-in) tih a ni. Group call atan simulcast: caller hian a rualin resolution pathum a encode thin.
calls.h3p3: FEC: audio atan on reng; video atan bitrate headroom a awm chuan.
calls.h4: Group call (SFU) te pawh a awm thei.
calls.h4p1: Mi > 2 tan chuan Vortex hian node-ah SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) a spawn a. Inelnaa tel apiangin vawi khat an upload a, SFU fans out.
calls.h4p2: Tunah hian audio-only mi 100 thleng an tel thei a; video group-te chu v0.1-ah 8-ah capped a ni (video SFU hardening in v0.3 roadmap).
calls.h4p3: SFU hian traversal atan coturn relay ang chiah a hmang a; service dang pek belh a ngai lo.
calls.h5: Screen hmanga insem darh a ni
calls.h5p1: `getDisplayMedia` kaltlangin. Client chuan PeerConnection awmsa ah track thar a dah belh a; offer/answer a renegotiate leh thin.
calls.h5p2: Recipient te chuan shared screen chu video track hran angin an render thin. Mobile-ah chuan screen sharing atan OS-level permission a ngai a — iOS-in a hriattir a, Android-ah chuan system dialog a lang.
calls.h6: Jitter buffer leh recovery a ni
calls.h6p1: WebRTC-a built-in NetEQ hian loss leh jitter a handle a ni. Degradation na tak a awm chuan client chuan resolution a drop emaw, video chu a disable vek emaw a, audio chu a nung reng a ni.
calls.h6p2: 500 ms freeze chuan reconnect tum (ICE restart) a tichhuak thin. User te chuan "Reconnecting..." overlay an hmu thin.
calls.h1_a: Call signaling hian chat atana hman thin WebSocket ang chiah hi a ride thin. Node hi signalling-only a ni — peer inkara SDP leh ICE broker mahse media a khawih ngai lo.
calls.h1_b: Caller chuan `{video, audio}` hmangin `/api/calls/{room_id}/start` a POST thin. Node hian `call_id` a allocate a, room chhungah `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` a tichhuak thin. Callee hian `/api/calls/{call_id}/accept` → `{type:"c", chi:"accepted"}` a post thin. SDP offer/chhanna inthlengna: `{kind:"offer", sdp}` → `{kind:"chhanna", sdp}`. ICE candidates: `{kind:"candidate", ice}` × N PeerConnection-in `connected` a report hma loh chuan.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE signaling hi RFC 8839 leh 8841-a tarlan standard WebRTC pattern a ni a, hetah hian Vortex hian engmah a siam chhuak lo; chu chu flow Chrome, Firefox, leh library implement zawng zawng WebRTC zawng zawng a ni. Node-as-signalling-only choice hi SFU-style media forwarding hian bandwidth a tie up a, base install-a kan ship duh loh hardware a mamawh tih hriatchhuah atanga lo chhuak a ni.
calls.h2_a: ICE hian host + server-reflexive + relay candidate hmangin NATs kaltlangin kawng a zawng chhuak thin. coturn hian STUN leh TURN a Vortex lam a handle a.
calls.h2_b: Peer tin hian candidate an chhiar chhuak a, chungte chu: host (local IPs), srflx (server-reflexive via STUN), relay (TURN-allocated) te an ni. Peer-te chuan candidate zawng zawng an inthlak vek a; pair tin hian "pair" an siam a, connectivity check hian UDP chungah STUN binding request a thawn a ni. Pair hlawhtling hmasa ber chu kawng thlan a lo ni ta a ni. Symmetric NAT hnung lamah chuan relay pair chauhvin hna an thawk — chu chu TURN relay hian media a relay tak tak lai a ni.
calls.h2_c: ICE hi kum 2010 khan RFC 5245 tia standardized a ni a, kum 2018 khan RFC 8445 tia refresh a ni a, carrier-grade-NAT hnuaiah hian STUN hi 15 % velin a fail a, TURN hi pumpelh theih a ni lo. coturn hi reference open-source TURN server a ni a; kan thawn chhan chu a danglamna (commercial Twilio/Vonage TURN) chu minute khatah relayed audio man a nih vang a ni.
calls.h3_a: TURN credentials hi call khata pek chhuah, hun rei lote chhunga HMAC-signed username/password pairs pek chhuah a ni a, thuruk rei tak a ni lo.
calls.h3_b: Call tan tirh hian node hian `username = "<expiry_unix>:<user_id>"` leh `password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, username))` a siam chhuak thin. An pahnih hian TTL 24 h an nei. Client hian a RTCPeerConnection config ah a hmang thin. coturn hian session setup-ah HMAC chu a verify thin. Expired creds te hian HMAC check an fail — revocation database awm lovin automatic in hna an thawk tawh lo.
calls.h3_c: Short-lived HMAC creds hi RFC 5389 (STUN) atanga lo chhuak a ni a, production WebRTC deployment tinte hman thin pattern a ni. Twilio, Google, Xirsys te chuan an ti vek. A danglamna — static TURN creds — chu client tu pawh tihchhiat a nih chuan a leak thin. Short-lived creds hian damage window chu 24 h ah a tihtlem.
calls.h4_a: Audio chu Opus a ni a, 48 kHz-ah DTX a ni a; video hi VP9 primary / H.264 fallback / AV1 opt-in a ni.
calls.h4_b: Audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR a ni. DTX (Discotinuous Transmission) hian silence laiin a thawn a titawp a, voice-ah a chhunzawm leh thin. FEC on reng reng. Video: VP9 chu a bul tanna hmunah; H.264 hi hardware VP9 decode nei lo device (A10 Bionic hmaa iOS) tan advertise a ni a; AV1 hi tunlai hardware-a premium-a opt-in atan pek a ni. Group call atan simulcast: caller hian resolution pathum chu a rualin a encode a, SFU viewer tin hnenah a dik tak a fans out.
calls.h4_c: Opus hi IETF-a royalty-free audio codec a ni a (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 hi Google-a open H.265-equivalent a ni. H.264 hi fallback a ni a, a chhan chu Apple hian kum 2021 thleng khan VP9 support a la chhunzawm zel a, AV1 hi iPhone 15 Pro (2023) leh Pixel 8 (2023)-in hardware decode an dah belh hnuah phone-ah hman theih a ni ta a ni. Vortex-a codec mix hi Google Meet hman dan ang chiah a ni.
calls.h5_a: Group call-ah chuan node-ah SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) hman a ni. Inkhawmnaa tel apiangin vawi khat an upload a; SFU forward zawng zawng hnenah.
calls.h5_b: Peer > 2 tan chuan caller chuan `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start` a post thin. Node hian call-a bound instance SFU a spin up a. Mi tin hian peer dang zawng zawng ni lovin SFU tan PeerConnection an hawng thin. Uplink: pakhatin stream 1 a thawn thin. Downlink: SFU hmalam pan N-1 streams. Simulcast layers tih awmzia chu SFU hian viewer tinte bandwidth awmsa nena inmil resolution a thlang tihna a ni.
calls.h5_c: SFU architecture hi Jitsi-a Videobridge (2013) atanga siam a ni. SFU hma khan WebRTC group call hi full-mesh a ni a — peer tin hian N-1 stream an encode a, chu chu quadratically-in a scale a ni. Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi, Signal group call zawng zawng hian SFU an hmang vek. Vortex audio-only group call chu v0.0.8-ah thawn chhuah a ni a; video group call te hi v0.3 roadmap ah a awm a.
calls.h6_a: Screen sharing hi PeerConnection awm tawha media track thar a ni a, offer/answer hmanga inremna siam thar leh a ni.
calls.h6_b: User chuan Share Screen → browser / iOS / Android calls `getDisplayMedia()` tih chu a tap a. MediaStream rawn kir leh chu PeerConnection ah addTrack-ed a ni. Renegotiation fires: offer/answer thar leh track dah belh. Recipient te chuan shared screen chu video element hran angin an render thin. iOS-ah chuan screen sharing hian Broadcast Upload Extension a mamawh a; Android-ah chuan foreground service + MediaProjection phalna a awm.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia hi kum 2017 khan standardized a ni a, kum 2019 atang khan browser tinah a awm tawh a, iOS Broadcast Upload Extension hi iOS 11 (2017) ah a rawn lut a ni. Android MediaProjection hi Lollipop (2015) atang khan a nghet tawh hle. Vortex screen sharing hi v0.0.8 ah thawn chhuah a ni.

federation.title: Federation a ni
federation.subtitle: Pubkey rintlak, thuthang signed, cross-node DM te.
federation.intro: Federation hian node A-a hmangtute chu node B-a message hmangtute a phalsak a, operator pakhatah opt-in a ni. Node pubkeys hi chiang takin rintlak a ni a; automatic "node eng pawhin ka ta nen an inzawm thei" mode a awm lo.
federation.h1p1: Node tin hian `federations(pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by)` an vawng reng thin.
federation.h1p2: Peer add tur chuan operator signed admin action a ngai a ni. Admin UI hian remote fingerprint a entir avangin operator te chuan out-of-band an verify thei a ni.
federation.h1p3: Peer paih chhuah tawhte chu audit atan DB-ah `revoked_at` tih chhinchhiahnaah an awm reng a ni. Pubkey khat atanga federation thar dilna chu admin pakhatin a un-revoke hma loh chuan hnawl a ni.
federation.h2p1: A atanga user@B thlenga outbound: node A chuan message envelope chu signed blob-ah a wrap a, node B-ah `/federation/deliver` a POST thin.
federation.h2p2: Envelope: `{source_node, target_user, chhungril_ciphertext, chhungril_nonce, thawn_at, sig}`. Sig hian sig ngei tih loh chu engkim a huam vek.
federation.h2p3: Node B hian a `federations` table atang hian `source_node` pubkey lakah signature a verify thin. Sign dik lo → 401 + audit event.
federation.h3p1: B chu thlen theih loh a nih chuan A chu `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, attempts, next_retry_at)` ah a queue thin.
federation.h3p2: Exponential backoff: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, 6h-a capped a ni. Ni 14 hnuah a hlawhchham vek.
federation.h3p3: Operator alert hi outbox depth > 1000 messages a nih chuan a kang chhuak thin — federation link stuck a nih thu a tarlang.
federation.h4p1: S 60 danah node tin hian peer tin ah `GET /v1/health` an ping thin. Chhanna hun + dinhmun track a ni.
federation.h4p2: Health score: initial 100. Timeout apiangin 1 a paih chhuak a; hlawhtlinna tin hian 1 (cap 100) a belhchhah a ni. Score 0 → federation chuan chu peer tan chuan a chawl ta a.
federation.h4p3: Operator dashboard hrang hrang tan `GET /v1/peers` hmanga tihchhuah a ni.
federation.h1_a: Vortex-a Federation hi node operator pahnih inkara inrintawkna inzawmna a ni. Node tin hian 32-byte Ed25519 public key an tichhuak a; node dang chuan a endpoint leh health score bulah `trusted_nodes` table-ah a dah belh a ni.
federation.h1_b: Pubkey rintlak tak dah belh tur chuan operator chuan node-in a release key hmangin admin request a sign a ngai a ni. UI hian remote fingerprint chu 64-hex-char form-in a entir a, chuvang chuan admin-te chuan out of band an verify thei a ni. Vawikhat tih belh a nih chuan inbound federation envelope tin chu chu pubkey-a Ed25519 signature nen chuan verified a ni — forgeries chu hmuhchhuah nghal a ni a, logged a ni. Revocation hi a soft: row chu audit atan `revoked_at` tih chhinchhiahna a awm reng a, mahse tunah chuan envelope signature chu a fail ta.
federation.h1_c: Pattern hi Matrix-a federation (server tin hian signing key an advertise a, event tin chu a sign vek) atanga lak chhuah a ni a, email-a DKIM (DNS-in signing pubkey a publish na hmun) atanga lak chhuah a ni bawk. Matrix chuan model hian scale-ah hna a thawk tih an finfiah — an network hian federated server 100k chuang a nei a ni. Vortex-a variant hi a danglam a, Matrix-a "any server can federate by default" rule ai chuan explicit mutual opt-in a ngai a; rogue federation laka invenna chak zawk atan convenience kan trade a.
federation.h1_f:
rintlak_nodes row:
  pubkey : 32 bytes a ni Ed25519 a ni
  tawp ber : https://...
  hriselna_score : int [0, 100] a ni.
  added_at : unix_ms tih a ni
  added_by : admin_a hmangtu_id
  revoked_at : unix_ms | NULL a ni.
federation.h2_a: Cross-node message hian local message ang chiah E2E envelope a ride a, signed outer envelope-ah a khuh a, chu chuan sending node chu receiving node-ah a authenticate a ni.
federation.h2_b: Node A hian user@B ah a rawn thawn duh a ni. Step 1: A chuan `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at}` te chu a serialize ang. Step 2: A chuan serialized byte te chu a Ed25519 private key → `sig` hmangin a sign ang. Step 3: A chuan tuple chu node B-ah `POST /federation/deliver`-ah a POST a, Step 4: B chuan a `trusted_nodes`-ah `source_node` a zawng a, `sig` a verify a, replay-window-ah `sent_at` a check a, a local `messages` table-ah inner envelope chu a persist ang. Recipient client chuan local message ang chiah hian a hmu a — federation layer hi end user te tan hmuh theih loh a ni.
federation.h2_c: Pawn lam signed envelope hi Matrix-a `m.room.message` federation events atanga loan lak a ni. Replay window (minute 5) leh source-signed timestamps te wall clock nena inmil tura tih te hi DKIM atanga loan lak a ni. Vortex (v0.0.2) hmasa khan TLS client certs hmanga unsigned federation siam a tum a; client certs te hi load balancers te an damchhuak lo tih kan hriat hnuah v0.0.5 ah payload signatures ah kan inthlak a, application layer atanga authentication tak tak chu an thup a ni.
federation.h2_f:
envelope = { 1000 a ni.
  source_node : hex32, 1999 a ni.
  target_user : int64, 1999 a ni.
  chhungril_ciphertext: byte, .
  chhungril_nonce : byte, .
  thawn_ah : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign(source_priv, CBOR(envelope)) a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a in ang lo.
POST /federation/deliver { envelope, sig } tih a ni.
federation.h3_a: Remote node a thlen theih loh chuan sending node chuan a `federation_outbox` ah envelope chu a queue a, exponential backoff hmangin a retry leh thin.
federation.h3_b: Backoff schedule: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, 6h ah capped a ni. Attempt hlawhchham apiangin row-a `attempts` column chu a increment a, `next_retry_at` chu now + current-step-ah set a ni. Background worker (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) chu s 5 danah a harh a, `next_retry_at <= now()` awmna row a pick up thin. Hlawhtlinna chuan row chu a delete a; Ni 14 chhunga a hlawhchham chuan a awm reng tur a ni tih chhinchhiah la, admin alert thawn rawh.
federation.h3_c: Ceiling nei exponential backoff hi Kafka-in producer retries-a a hman dan leh SMTP-in bounced mail atana a hman dan ang chiah kha a ni. Ni 14 chhung cap hi SMTP-a RFC 5321 recommendation nen a inmil hle. Version hmasa lamah chuan fixed 60-second retries an hmang a, chu chuan outage hnua peer pakhat online-a a rawn kir leh chuan thundering-herd spike a siam a; exponential spread chuan v0.0.7-ah khan a fix a.
federation.h3_f:
delay(n) = min(6h, 1s · 2−) chu n = 0, 1, 2, ...

retry schedule: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h te a ni
alert: outbox_depth > 1000 a ni a, > 5 min chhung a ni
federation.h4_a: Second 60 danah node tin hian peer tin `/v1/health` endpoint an ping thin. Score chu hlawhtlinnaah a sang chho a, hlawhchhamnaah a tlahniam a, [0, 100]-ah a innghat.
federation.h4_b: Score hi add-ah 100 atanga tan a ni. Hlawhtlinna apiangin +1 (capped at 100) a belhchhah a, timeout apiangin -1 (0-a floored) a paih chhuak thin. Score 0 hian chu peer hnenah chuan federation a titawp a — message thar chu outbox-ah queue-ah a awm a, score 20 aia sang a san leh hma loh chuan outbound delivery thar tum a awm lo. Window tawi chhunga peer tam tak atanga score tlahniam nghal chuan "network partition suspected" alert a thlen thin.
federation.h4_c: AIMD-style score hi TCP-a congestion window leh Akamai-a health-check damper aṭanga infuih a ni. Asymmetric ±1 step (TCP halving ai chuan) hian recovery chu failure aiin a ti slow zawk a, hei hian system chu fimkhur lam hawiin a biase a — flapping link hmanga duplicate message thawn ai chuan kan chiang lo a nih chuan federation hi pause kan duh zawk. Peer nungchang tha lo takin peer tha pahnih retries hmanga a flood hnuah v0.0.6 ah added a ni.
federation.h4_f:
hlawhtlinna chungchangah: score = min(100, score + 1)
hun tawp dawnah: score = max(0, score - 1) a ni.
score == 0 a nih chuan: pause_federation(peer) a ni.
score >= 20 a nih chuan: resume_federation(peer) // hysteresis tih a ni

gossip.title: Gossip leh peer hmuhchhuah
gossip.subtitle: Central registry nei lovin node te chu engtin nge an inhmukhawm thin.
gossip.intro: Controller-in attested list a tihchhuah piah lamah chuan Vortex node te hian anmahni zingah peer te an gossip thin. Hei hian operator-te’n an spin up angin node thar a hmuchhuak a, controller-in a la attested lo a nih pawhin.
gossip.h1p1: S 60 danah node hian random peer a thlang a, peer hriat tawhte 256-bit Bloom filter a thawn thin. Peer hian filter chhunga peers NOT hmangin a chhang a, chubakah a filter ngei pawh a chhang bawk. Bandwidth hi `O(new peers × 32 bytes)` a ni a, a tlangpuiin round khatah 1 KiB hnuai lam a ni.
gossip.h1p2: Advertised peer tin hi advertising node hian a sign vek a ni. Client-te chuan first contact-ah signatures an verify ṭhin — attacker chuan peer chu gossip-ah a forge thei lo.
gossip.h1p3: Round hi rate-limited a ni a: s 30 chhungin peer khatah exchange pakhat (sliding window).
gossip.h2p1: Node thar hi hardcoded bootstrap controller 8 atanga tan a ni. First gossip round hian a rualpui tam tak a hmuchhuak a; network chu ~1 minute chhungin a inzawm khawm thin.
gossip.h2p2: Bootstrap list hi `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...` hmangin edit theih a ni.
gossip.h3p1: Advertised peer tinte chu operator Ed25519 release key hmanga sign vek tur a ni. Peer announcement forge tur chuan key dik tak ruk a ngai a ni.
gossip.h3p2: Peer registration thara proof-of-work (adjustable, default 2^18 leading zeros) hian bulk Sybil-bot wave te chu a ti thei lo.
gossip.h3p3: Reputation system: peers nungchang tha lo (signatures tha lo, forged announcement, repeated timeouts) te chuan an reputation a tichhe thin. Zero hmingthanna → blacklist.
gossip.h1_a: S 60 danah node tin hian random peer an thlang a, peer hriat tawhte khaikhawmna 256-bit Bloom filter an thawn thin. Peer hian peer thar + a filter hmangin a chhang thin. Bandwidth chu `O(new_peers × 32 bytes)` a ni.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom filter k=5 hashes, m=256 bits a ni. Node A hian a peer_id hriat tawh zawng zawng a insert vek. Peer B hnenah a thawn a, B chuan a peer tinte nen filter chu a zawtfiah a; eng thil pawh a tlakchham chuan B chuan A hnenah a thawn thin (plus a filter ngei bawk). A pawhin chutiang bawk chu reverse in a ti ve bawk. Exchange hnuah node pahnih hian hriatna inang tlangpui an nei vek a. Exchange pangngai: 200-800 byte vel a ni. Gossip property vang hian network pumpuiah ~5 round (minute 5) chhungin update a inzawm khawm thin.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter thuthang hi kum 1998-a Cornell-a’n bimodal multicast paper a siam aṭang khan a ni. Apache Cassandra hian membership atan a hmang a; Bitcoin hi transaction relay atan hman a ni a; IPFS chu DHT enkawl nan a ni. O(log N) convergence property hi kan hmanna atana fit tha tak a ni — global views kan mamawh lo va, eventually-consistent peer knowledge chauh kan mamawh a ni. Filter size (256 bits) chu tuned a nih avangin false-positive rate chu peers 100 ah < 1 % a ni.
gossip.h2_a: Node thar hi hardcoded bootstrap controller 8 atanga tan a ni. First gossip round hian a hmuchhuak tam zawk a; ~1 minute chhungin a converge thin.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` hi `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...` hmanga thawn a ni. Startup-ah chuan node hian a hnuaia mi ang hian a try vek a. First to respond hian peer list hmasa ber (`GET /v1/trusted_nodes` kaltlangin) a pe a. Node chuan chutiang chu a local peers table-ah a dah lut a, bootstrapped tiin a mark a, 60 s gossip loop chu a start ta a ni. Round hnuhnung zawkah chuan peers-of-peers an hmuchhuak.
gossip.h2_c: Hardcoded bootstrap hi Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS hman dan inang chiah a ni. A danglamna — DHT-based discovery — chu engtin pawhin initial entry a ngai a ni. Vortex-a bootstrap count 8 chu > 4 neih hian a ruala downtime event 2-3 lakah resilience a pe a, < 16 hian `.env` file chu chhiar theih turin a vawng tlat a ni. `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS` edit hmangin per-deployment siamrem rawh.
gossip.h3_a: Advertised peer tin hian an origin operator Ed25519 release key hmanga sign vek tur a ni. Attacker chuan network chhungah peers a fabricate thei lo.
gossip.h3_b: Node A hian node B-ah gossip-a peer P a advertise hian A-ah hian `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, leh timestamp te a tel a, chung zawng zawng chu P-a release key-in a sign vek a ni. B chuan P a rin hmain signature chu a verifies a, B-in a hnua a contact P leh P-te TLS cert + first heartbeat chu advertised pubkey nen a inmil lo a nih chuan advertisement chu poisoned tih chhinchhiah a ni a, hnuai lam hawiin a darh a ni.
gossip.h3_c: Signed peer advertisement hi Chord (2001) leh Kademlia (2002) te hnen atanga standard anti-Sybil primitive a ni. Bitcoin-a addr message-te hian model chak lo zawk an hmang a (signatures a awm lo, Sybil deterrent atan connection cost-ah a innghat); Ethereum-a discv5 chhinchhiahna. Vortex chuan testnet attacker pakhatin legitimate node pakhat kaltlangin fake peer 1000 a advertise hnuah v0.0.6-ah signed advertisement a hmang a ni.

filter: k=5, m=256 bits a ni
insert(x) = 0..k-a i tan: filter[hash_i(x) mod m] = 1
query(x) = 0..k-a i tan: filter[hash_i(x) mod m] en rawh.
false-positive chu peer 100-ah a awm a, bit 256-ah a awm a, k=5: ~0.4 %

.env: a ni.
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.entirna,efgh...@https://b.entirna

thuthang tha tak: [..., {ad, sig}, ...]
