stealth.title: Stealth network hmanga siam a ni
stealth.subtitle: Layer panga, mechanism 28 a awm. TLS padding atanga Tor onion service thlengin engkim.
stealth.intro: Vortex chuan nation-state-grade hmelma a ni. Stealth stack hi layered a nih avangin pawn lam layer te bypass a nih pawhin chhung lam te hian degraded-but-working service an la pe reng a ni.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — kutziak (fingerprint) tih dan pangngaia siam. Passive classifiers te chu a titawp thin.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — a pianzia / a lian zawng inthlak danglamna. Traffic-analysis classifier te chu a titawp thin.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — protocol inthuamna (camouflage) a ni. Active DPI a titawp.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — plug theihna tur transports. Kan primary block tu network-ah hna a thawk.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — a hnuhnung ber atanga fallback. Onion, BMP, multi-hop relay hmanga tih theih a ni. Thil dangin a tih loh laiin hna a thawk.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello hian Windows 11-a Chrome hi byte-for-byte-in a match a. JA3/JA4 hash hi Chrome 120 nen a inmil a — Vortex-specific fingerprint a awm lo.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: record TLS zawng zawng chu 16 KB thlenga padded vek a ni. Packet size te hi bulk browser traffic nen a inmil hle.
stealth.h2p3: Constant-rate send: queue hian application activity eng pawh nise N ms khatah frame khat a pe chhuak thin. Idle period hian inner envelope-a marked dummy frame a chhuah avangin a dawngtute chuan an paih chhuak thin.
stealth.h2p4: Timing jitter: latency-based DPI hneh turin egress-ah 0-50 ms random delay a awm.
stealth.h3: Level 2 — Thil ruk chhuah hmasak ber
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: packet-size distribution, burst cadence, leh silence gaps te hi YouTube live stream nen a inmil a ni. Messenger heartbeat zawngtu classifier te chu an inmil lo.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: flow inang chu Wi-Fi, cellular, leh active VPN eng pawh chungah a rualin a inthen darh thin. Receiver-ah reassembly leh rawh. Single-path shaping a hneh.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data channel tunnel: TLS chu block a nih laiin WebRTC chuan hna a thawk a nih chuan Vortex chu DTLS-SRTP channel kaltlangin peer hriat lar takah a tunnel thin.
stealth.h3p4: Decoy connections: Hun rei tak chhung idle TLS session 3 Google, YouTube, leh Cloudflare ah te. Observer hian browser awm dan pangngai a hmu thin.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS zawng zawng chu DoH kaltlangin Cloudflare / Google / Quad9 thlenga chinfel a ni. ISP hian chu resolver te hnenah chuan HTTPS chauh a hmu a, domain list tak tak chu a hmu lo.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI DNS HTTPS record-a key tihchhuah hmanga encrypt a ni. Passive observer te chuan destination hostname an hmu thei lo.
stealth.h4p3: Probe detection: node hian auth session nei lovin request a track thin. Min 5 chhunga IP atanga probe failed pathum chuan "decoy site" mode a tichhuak a — chu IP chuan tunah chuan plain HTML landing page 200 OK a hmu ta a ni.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): vawiin ni nen hian deterministic domain generator seeded a ni. Primary endpoint block a nih chuan client te chuan candidate lo awm tur chu an compute a, an try thin.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: V2Ray-style transport standard, pluggable JSON config hmanga siam a ni.
stealth.h5p2: Thil tak tak: TLS-chhung-TLS tunnel. Pawn lam kut inthlakna tur target www.microsoft.com; chhungril kut inthlakna chu Vortex a ni. Pawn lam dotu probes te chu Microsoft ah an forward thin avangin active probing hian engmah a pholang lo.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: volunteer browser te chuan Vortex traffic chu WebRTC chungah an relay thin. Snowflake extension install tu user te chuan cover an pe thin.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: HTTPS probes te chu Chromium ngeiin a nungchang nena inmil turin microsecond thlengin a siam danglam thin.
stealth.h6p1: Onion services: node tin hian `.onion` tiin an inhriattir bawk. Tor support nei client te chu thil dang zawng zawng a hlawhchham chuan hetiang hian an tlu lut thin.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): thuchah thawn tur chu hming hriat loha dahkhawm leh thawn chhuah. BMP bung en rawh.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: message te chu intermediate node 5 thleng a bounce thei a, pakhatin envelope layer a belhchhah thei. Tor ang mahse kan mesh-ah.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): relay hmanga hriat loh HTTP. Party pakhat mahin dilna leh chhanna an hmu vek lo.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth hi independent layer panga anga buatsaih a ni. Layer tin hian adversary class hrang hrang an hneh vek a ni. Layer pakhat a hlawhchham chuan a dang a tlahniam a — a cascade lo.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 hian kan TLS fingerprint a normalise avangin passive DPI hian a classify thei lo. Layer 2 hian traffic shape chu streaming angin a morph a. Layer 3 hian ECH / DoH / probe-response tricks hmangin protocol chu a camouflage a. Layer 4 hi primary active taka block a nih chuan pluggable transports (vmess, reality, Snowflake) ah a inthlak thin. Layer 5 hi a hnuhnung ber a ni: Tor onion, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Layered model hi Tor-a pluggable-transports architecture (2013) atanga lak chhuah a ni. Vortex chuan Tor-a pathum aiah layer panga a dah belh a, a chhan chu kum 2025-ah chuan adversarial landscape-ah chuan Tor-a transport-te ngei pawh hrechiangtu DPI a tel a ni (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Vortex layer tin hi field incident hnua dah luh a ni: L1 Kazakhstan blocking (2019-equivalent), L2 Iran-in kum 2022-a a beih hnuah, L3 China-in 2020-a DoH a hmuhchhuah hnuah, L4 Turkey-in 2023 block a neih hnuah, L5 inbuatsaihnaah.

------------------- | -----------

traffic thlirletna | L2 (a pianzia) .

stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 hian Vortex traffic chu Windows 11-a Chrome nen TLS layer-ah a thliar hrang thei lo.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello ordering, extension list, cipher suite list, ALPN value — zawng zawng hi Chrome 120 byte dik tak nena inmil turin tuned vek a ni. JA3/JA4 hash hi tuna Chrome release nen a inmil a ni. TLS record padding chu 16 KB ah a ni. Constant-rate sender hian idle laiin dummy filler hmangin N ms khatah frame khat a pe chhuak thin. Latency analysis hneh turin timing jitter 0-50 ms a ni. Google, YouTube, Cloudflare te decoy connection te chu background ah 45 s inkar ah a kal thin.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 fingerprinting hi Salesforce engineer te chuan kum 2017 khan an tichhuak a, kum 2019 thleng khan enterprise DPI ah chuan standard a ni ta. Vortex-a fingerprint normalization hi uTLS hmanga model a ni a, chu chu Snowflake-in chutiang bawka a hman Go library a ni. Constant-rate sender te hi WireGuard-in "cover traffic" a rawtna direct port a ni.
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 hian traffic chu interactive chat aiin bulk streaming media angin a morph a ni.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: packet-size distribution chu 720p YouTube live stream (empirical table) nen a inmil a, burst cadence match, silence gaps match a ni. Multipath: logical stream inang chu Wi-Fi, cellular, leh active VPN eng pawh chungah a rualin a inthen a; receiver chu sequence number order-in a inzawm khawm leh thin. WebRTC data channel fallback: TLS chu block a nih laiin WebRTC a paltlang chuan Vortex chu DTLS-SRTP data channel hmangin peer hriat lar takah tunnel rawh.
stealth.h3_c: Traffic morphing zirchianna hi Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 chuan kum 2014 khan a "morph" sub-mode angin a implement a, Meek+domain-fronting hian encryption ang bawkin shape hi a pawimawh tih min zirtir a. YouTube-specifically hi thlan a nih chhan chu restrictive network tam zawka non-blocked site lian ber pakhat a nih vang a ni — YouTube-shaped traffic chhunga inthup chu "mipui zingah inthup" a ni.

stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 hian protocol identity ngei — SNI, DNS, response code te chu a camouflage a ni.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS zawng zawng hi DNS-over-HTTPS kaltlangin Cloudflare/Google/Quad9 thlengin a kal vek a ni. ISP hian chutiang resolver te hnenah chuan HTTPS chauh a hmu thin. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI hi DNS HTTPS record-a key tihchhuah hmanga encrypt a ni. Passive observer te chuan front-end IP chauh an hmu thin. Probe detection: node-te chuan unauth'd IP-te chu `/api/*` hit-in an track a; min 5 chhunga hlawhchham vawi thum chuan IP chu "decoy mode" ah flip rawh — chu IP chuan tunah chuan static HTML landing page 200 OK a hmu ta a ni. DGA: deterministic domain generator seeded with today’s date chuvangin client-te chuan primary block a nih chuan fallback an hmu thin.
stealth.h4_c: DoH hi Firefox 2018-ah a tlangzarh a, 2019 khan Chrome tan default a ni ta a, ECH hian kum 2024-a standardization hmain draft panga a paltlang a — Vortex draft-13 lai khan support a thawn a, tunah chuan final spec a support tawh. Probe-response decoys hi meek-in kum 2014-a a design aṭanga loan lak a ni a, Iran-a active prober-te'n a response timing aṭanga meek an hriatchhuah hnuah kum 2023 khan refined a ni.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 hian pluggable transports a hmang a — third-party tunnel, thil dang ang deuh vek a ni.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: V2Ray-a siam chhuah dan pangngai; config JSON tih a ni. Thil tak tak: TLS-within-TLS tunnel-a pawn lam kut inthlakna hmun www.microsoft.com; chhungril kut inthlakna chu Vortex a ni. Active probes to the outer chu Microsoft ah forward a ni a, chuvangin probing hian engmah a lang lo. Snowflake: volunteer browser-te chuan Vortex chu WebRTC chungah an relay a; kan lamah infra a awm lo. NaiveProxy: Chromium thiltih dik tak nena inmil turin HTTPS probes te chu a siam danglam thin.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray-a VMess hi kum 2015 khan Chinese anti-censorship community-in an lo siam tawh a ni. Trojan hi kum 2019 khan tlangzarh a ni a, thil tak tak chu kum 2022 atang khan a ni — Great Firewall-in TLS fingerprint a hmuhchhuah chhanna a ni. Snowflake hi Tor Project-in kum 2020-a obfs4 thlaktu tur a ni a; Vortex hian kum 2023-a Iran-in Tor entry point full-scale block a neih hnuah v0.0.9-ah support a belh leh a ni.
stealth.h5_f:

stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 hi trick hnuhnung ber bag a ni: onion service, BMP store-and-forward, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node tin hian `.onion` address an tichhuak vek a. Tor-capable host nei client te chu TLS + L1-L4 zawng zawng an fail vek chuan an fall through thin. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): sender chuan `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")` hmanga keyed node eng pawhah encrypted blob a thlak a; thuthang a thehdarh a; recipient chuan an home node atang chuan a pull a. Multi-hop: message te chu intermediate node 5 thleng a bounce a, pakhatin envelope layer a dah belh a — Tor ang bawkin mahse kan mesh chhungah. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP through a relay chuvangin party pakhat mahin dilna leh chhanna an hmu vek lo.
stealth.h6_c: Tor-ah hian kum 2004 aṭang khan onion service hi hman ṭan a ni. BMP hi kan thil siam chhuah a ni a, Tor-a hidden service descriptor gossip model-a siam a ni. Multi-hop relay hian Signal-a sealed-sender bakah onion routing a entir bawk. OHTTP hi kum 2024 aṭanga siam a ni a, Cloudflare leh Apple te chuan mimal chanchin humhalhna telemetry atana an siam chhuah a ni a; fallback hnuhnung ber atan v0.0.9 ah kan adopt a.

bmp.title: Mitdel Mailbox Protocol a ni
bmp.subtitle: Gossip mesh hmanga message thawn tur chu anonymous store-and-forward a ni.
bmp.intro: BMP hian sender chu eng node-ah pawh identity puang lovin message a deposit tir thei a ni. Message hian a dawngtu home node a thlen thlengin a sawisel a, chutah chuan a hma ang bawkin a decrypt a ni.
bmp.h1p1: Sender chuan `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)` a hmu chhuak a. Sender (recipient_pubkey hretu) chauhvin a compute thei a; dawngtu pawhin a hria.
bmp.h1p2: Sender chuan `POST /bmp/deposit` chu `{mailbox_id, blob}` hmangin eng gossiping node ah pawh a post thin.
bmp.h1p3: Node hian pair hi 7200 s thleng a dahkhawm thin. Node hian next gossip round-a Bloom filter-ah mailbox_id hi a dah tel bawk.
bmp.h1p4: Node dangte chuan local-a an ngaih pawimawh mailbox_ids (an node-a recipient) te tan blob an pull thin.
bmp.h1p5: Recipient client chuan `GET /bmp/messages` a poll a, blob thar awm apiang chu a key material hman thin hmangin a decrypt thin.
bmp.h2p1: Node engmah hian blob chu sender nen a link thei lo — sender TLS connection hian source IP a hriat chian tir a, mahse sender leh first BMP node inkara onion hop chain chuan chu pawh chu a paih chhuak bawk.
bmp.h2p2: Recipient-hiding: blob hi recipient pubkey hmanga encrypt a ni. Middle node te hian opaque byte string leh random mailbox_id chauh an hmu thin.
bmp.h2p3: Sender hnenah delivery confirmation a awm lo. Vawi khatah semantics.
bmp.h3p1: Blob lian ber: 1 MB. Payload lian zawk chu file flow pangngai hmangin chunked a ngai a ni.
bmp.h3p2: Node khatah Max storage: Deposit zawng zawng 500 MB a ni. LRU hnawhchhuahna at cap. Operator te pawhin an tune thei.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP deposit rate chu 10 / min. Node pakhata darkar 3 aia tam mailbox ID hmuhte chu tuilian rinhlelh angin rate-limited a ni.
bmp.h4p1: High-censorship dawngtu: sender hian recipient home node a hriat a ngai lo.
bmp.h4p2: Intermittent connectivity: blobs te hian recipient re-connect leh poll hma chu an nghak thin.
bmp.h4p3: Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = tuin nge eng nge a dah tih metadata a awm lo.
bmp.h1_a: BMP hi hming hriat loh store-and-forward layer a ni. Sender hian gossip-enabled node eng pawhah blob a thlak a; blob chu a dawngtu public key chauh keyed mailbox-ah a nghak a.
bmp.h1_b: Sender chuan `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)` a chhut chhuak a. `recipient_pubkey` hretu chauhvin a compute thei — a dawngtu chuan a hria a, a thawntuin a hria a, third party pawhin a hre lo. Sender hian eng gossiping node pawh hnenah `{mailbox_id, blob}` a POST thin. Node hian pair hi 7200 s (2 h) thleng a dahkhawm a, gossip exchange Bloom filter lo awm tur ah mailbox_id chu a puang bawk. Node dangte chuan mailbox_id chu local-a user cached mailbox nena inmil an hmuh chuan blob chu an pull a, chu user client hnenah an forward a.
bmp.h1_c: BMP hi Vortex team te chuan a bul atanga design a ni. Kan siam chhan chu mainstream messenger tumahin metadata end-to-end thup nan resources mamawh an hman duh loh vang a ni — product serious zawng zawng hian content encryption an thawn chhuak a, mahse delivery layer chu hawn vekin an dah a, chuvangin server chuan tu nge tu nge biak a, engtikah nge biak tih a la hre reng a ni. Team chhungah chuan "social graph leak tu secure messenger chu a chanve chauh a secure" kan ti fo thin. BMP hi kan chhanna a ni: thawntu, dawngtu leh thupui zawng zawng chu opaque an ni vek a; mesh chhunga node pakhat mah hian inbiakna siam thar leh thei tur khawpa piece a keng lo. Bolted-on infrastructure aiin Vortex-a gossip fabric chungah a tlan a, hei vang hian sumdawnna man a tlawm a, design pawh in-house-a audit theih a ni.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(a dawngtu_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

A chhuahna tur hmun: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Thupuan: thuthang Bloom filter += mailbox_id

TTL: 7200 s |  node khata dahkhawmna cap: 500 MB |  deposit rate: 10/min/IP a ni ang.
bmp.h2_a: BMP hian independent privacy property pathum a pe a, chungte chu sender-hiding, recipient-hiding, content-hiding te an ni.
bmp.h2_b: Sender-hiding: TLS depositing node nena inzawmna chuan source IP a rawn pholang a; BMP node hmasa berah Tor hop emaw onion-routed chain emaw dah chuan chu chu a paih chhuak ta a ni. Recipient-hiding: mailbox_id hi recipient_pubkey-a one-way hash a ni a, BMP version string hmanga salted a ni — middle node chuan opaque 32-byte identifier a hmu a. Content-hiding: blob hi recipient tan E2E-encrypted a ni tawh a, Vortex room / DM key pangngai hmangin middle node hian ciphertext chauh a hmu a ni.
bmp.h2_c: Three-property formulation hi Pond-in kum 2014-a a thil tum a sawi dan a ni a, Vortex chuan mailbox_id chu collision-resistant (256-bit hash)-a siamin a tithianghlim a, chutiang chuan user inzawm lo pahnih chuan accident-a mailbox an share thei lo. Second 7200 chhunga TTL hi kan beta-a dawngtu zinga 95 % chuan 2 h chhunga an pull tih hmuhchhuah atanga lo chhuak a ni a; a rei zawk TTL inflated per-node storage chu delivery gain hmuh tur awm lovin.
bmp.h2_f:
Node state hmutu hmelma:
  - mailbox_id chu hun T-ah a awm tih a hria
  - NOT hian a thawntu a hre em (was a TLS/Tor hop away)
  - NOT hian dawngtu a hre em (mailbox_id hi one-way hash a ni)
  - NOT hian content a hre em (blob hi E2E-encrypted a ni)
bmp.h3_a: Blob size, per-node storage, leh deposit rate-a hard limits hian BMP chu arbitrary data tan dead-drop a nih loh nan a veng a ni.
bmp.h3_b: Blob lian ber: 1 MB. Payload lian zawk chu file system pangngai hmangin chunk a ngai a, chu chuan a storage path a nei ve tho. Max per-node storage: 500 MB a vaiin BMP deposit a ni. Cap a thlen chuan oldest-first eviction chuan an TTL hmain blob a thlak a — operator te chuan `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var hmangin an adjust thei. Deposit rate per IP: minute khatah 10, attacker pakhat atanga tuilian dona tur. Network pumpuiah darkar khata vawi 3 aia tam Mailbox ID hmuhte chu "suspected flood target" anga rate-limited a ni.
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap hi IRC DCC-send convention leh Signal-a sealed-sender cap nen a inmil a — message tawi leh thumbnail atan a lian tawk a, attacker-in file hosting atan BMP a hman theih loh khawpa te a ni. 500 MB per-node chu OSS-default sensible a ni a; operator lian tak takte chuan `BMP_MAX_BYTES` hmangin an chawi sang thin. Rate limits hi v0.0.8 beta hnua lo awm a ni a, tester pakhat test script chuan minute 20 chhungin node 50 chu deposit hmangin a khat a ni.
bmp.h3_f:
a huam chin: 1.1.
  A rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah em em bawk a. 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = minute khatah 10 # IP ah a ni.
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = Darkar khatah # mailbox_id inang # 3
bmp.h4_a: BMP hi scenario pathum-ah a eng a, chungte chu: high-censorship dawngtu, intermittent connectivity, anonymous whistleblowing.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: sender hian recipient home node a hre lo (engtin pawhin a thleng thei lo mai thei). Eng peer pawh drop la, gossip route hmang rawh. Intermittent connectivity: a dawngtu chu darkar tam tak offline a ni a; blob a nghak a, retries a ngai lo. Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = tuin nge eng nge a dah tih metadata a awm lo. Mi rintlakte chauhin an hriat room key nen a inzawm chuan, a chhunga thu awmte pawh hi eng interceptor tan pawh opaque a ni.
bmp.h4_c: Use case pathumte hian physical espionage (Soviet-era)-a dead drops awm chhan, Usenet-a `alt.anonymous.messages` (1990s), leh SecureDrop (2013 onwards)-a historical motivations te chu an track a ni. BMP chu chu history chu hmanraw hran ngai lovin tunlai palaiah luhtir kan tumna a ni.

push.title: Push hriattirna te
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — zawng zawng hi envelope sealed nei vek an ni a, chuvang chuan provider te chuan an chhiar thei lo.
push.intro: Standard push service (APNs, FCM, Web Push) te hian payload zawng zawng an hmu vek. Vortex hian notification tin chu E2E layer hranah a wrap a, chuvangin provider chuan room id, sender, text nei lo opaque blob chauh a hmu thin.
push.h1p1: Client chuan platform token (APNs device token, FCM registration id, emaw Web Push subscription JWT) a hmu a.
push.h1p2: Client hian 32-byte X25519 key thar `p256dh_pub` leh 16-byte `auth` secret a siam chhuak thin. `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform}` hmangin `/api/push/subscribe` a POST thin.
push.h1p3: Node chu `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, siam_at)` a awm reng a ni.
push.h2p1: Notification a lo thlen hun (muted room-a message thar, notify, mention, call invite tura set a nih chuan) node chuan `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` atanga HKDF kaltlangin key hmanga payload chu AES-GCM hmangin a encrypt a.
push.h2p2: Node hian `{endpoint, TTL, urgency, topic: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` te a package a, APNs / FCM / Web Push server ah a thawn thin.
push.h2p3: Provider hian `data` (ciphertext) + `topic` chauh a hmu thin. Plaintext leak a awm lo.
push.h3p1: Room khata thupui pawimawh ber: `room:<id>`. Room khata message tam tak chu OS level-ah notification pakhatah a collapse.
push.h3p2: Call khata thupui: `call:<id>` tih a ni. Chhan emaw, hnawl emaw chuan banner a hrual a; room khata call thar sawmna chuan a hlui chu a thlak leh ang.
push.h4: Recei a nih chuan decryption a awm
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension hian NSE process (main app atanga inthen) ah a decrypt thin. CryptoKit primitives ang chiah a hmang.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService hian background service ah a decrypt thin. JobScheduler hian app foreground a nih chuan actual UI update a schedule thin.
push.h4p3: Web: Service Worker hian SW context ah a decrypt a, Web Notifications API hmangin local notification a post thin.
push.h5p1: APNs: provider token chu min 60 danah refresh a ngai. Token refresh hi Apple-a `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 key file hmangin automation a ni.
push.h5p2: FCM: legacy HTTP tawp ber chu hman tawh loh; HTTP v1 endpoint kan hmang a, OAuth2 service account credentials kan nei bawk. Rotation 1 h danah a awm thin.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID keys (node ​​khatah keypair khat). TTL browser tam zawk chuan ni 28 chhungin an capped.
push.h1_a: Client hian device token (APNs/FCM/Web Push) chu X25519 public key thar leh 16-byte auth secret nen a register a.
push.h1_b: Client hian `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` leh `auth = rand(16)` a siam chhuak thin. `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G` tih a ni. `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, user_agent}` hmangin `/api/push/subscribe` a POST thin. Node chu a awm reng a `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, siam_a, a hnuhnung ber_refreshed_at)`. Rotation: client chuan app launch apiangin a subscribe leh thin a, chu chuan `last_refreshed_at` a refresh thin. Ni 30 aia upa subscription te chu purge a ni.
push.h1_c: p256dh + auth field te hi Web Push RFC 8291 (2017) atanga lo chhuak a ni. Chutiang service-te chuan sealed format mamawh lo mah se APN leh FCM atan kan hmang leh a — chutianga tih chuan pathumteah code path pakhat a vawng reng a ni. v0.0.5 hma khan Vortex chuan push services kaltlangin plaintext payload a thawn thin a; Apple-a kum 2022-a push privacy update leh thil thleng hran, FCM project configuration dik lo pakhatin notification a leak hnuah, engkim chu sealed envelope-ah kan sawn vek a ni.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32) a ni.
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 tih hi a ni.
auth = rand(16) tih a ni.

POST /api/push/subscribe theih a ni

push.h2_a: Notification a lo thlen hunah node chuan payload chu a encrypt avangin a dawngtu device chauhvin a chhiar thei a ni. Push service (Apple / Google / Mozilla) hian opaque blob chauh a hmu a.
push.h2_b: Node hian ephemeral X25519 keypair a thlang a. `ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)` tih a ni. HKDF(salt=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → key a kal thei. `{title, body, room_id, message_id}` chu CBOR → AES-GCM tiin derived key + random 96-bit nonce hmangin a encrypt thin. APNs/FCM/Web-Push-ah `{endpoint, TTL, hmanhmawhthlakna, thupui: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {salt, pub_ephemeral}}` a thawn thin. Device chuan a dawng a, extension / service worker chuan key derivation ang chiah chu reverse-in a run a, a decrypt a, notification a entir bawk.
push.h2_c: Sealed push hi kum 2017 atanga Web Push Message Encryption spec (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188) atanga lo chhuak direct a ni. Apple-a 2022-a iOS 16 update-ah khan decryption titu notification service extension-te tan first-class support a dah belh a; Android hian kum tam tak chhung chu FCM data message hmangin a support tawh a ni. Vortex hi platform pathum-a code inang hmanga full flow implement tu messenger tlemte zinga mi a ni — iOS hian `NotificationServiceExtension` a hmang a, Android hian `FirebaseMessagingService` a hmang a, Web hian service worker a hmang bawk.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand (32) a ni a, a man pawh a to hle.  ephemeral_pub = hun rei lote chhunga thil thleng (priv) · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub) tih a ni.
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm) tih a ni.
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "A chhunga thu awmte encoding: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\x00", 12) A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a.
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt(key, vawi khat, payload) tih a ni.
send { tawp ber, data: chi∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Collapse key hian chat khata notification tam tak chu banner pakhat zel angin a stack thei lo — OS hian pakhatah a coalesce a ni.
push.h3_b: Room khata tlakchhiatna: topic = `room:<id>`. APNs te `apns-collapse-id` leh FCM te `collapse_key` te hian OS te chu notification hmasa te chu topic inang hmanga thlak turin a hrilh a. User hian room khatah banner pakhat a hmu a, message engzat pawh lo thleng se. Call khata tlakchhiatna: topic = `call:<id>`; room khata call thar sawmna chuan a hmaa call invite te chu a thlak leh ang. Per-mention: topic = `thu sawina:<user>:<room>`; user-room pair khatah mention banner pakhat.
push.h3_c: Collapse key hi iOS 10 (2016)-ah APN-ah dah a ni a, kum 2014 khan FCM-ah dah a ni bawk a, chumi hma chuan multi-message burst hian multi-banner stack a siam a, chu chu user-te pawhin an huat em em a ni. Telegram hian kum 2015 khan room khata chim UX hmahruaitu a ni a; palai lian zawng zawng chuan an zui vek a. Vortex's split into room / call / mention collapse hi v0.0.6 beta-a user feedback aṭanga lo chhuak a ni a, "call invite replaces chat banner" tih hi a dik lo niin a lang — topic hrang hrangin an siam ṭha a ni.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = room:42 → banner hmasa te chu a thlak thin
FCM: collapse_key = call:17 → banner hmasa te chu a thlak leh thin
Web: topic = mention:u12:r5 → banner hmasa te chu a thlak thin
push.h4_a: Platform tin hian gotcha hrang hrang an nei vek a. iOS hian Notification Service Extension a mamawh a; Android hian FCM data message a mamawh a; Web hian service worker + VAPID a mamawh a ni.
push.h4_b: iOS: app bundle hian `NotificationServiceExtension` target a thawn chhuak thin. System chuan encrypted payload chu NSE ah a deliver a; NSE hian notification a lan hmain decrypt leh mutate turin CPU 30 s + 25 MB memory a nei a. FCM: `data` message (`notification` ni lovin) kan thawn thin avangin app-a FirebaseMessagingService chu kan thlen veleh a kal thin — chu chuan banner kan lantir dawn leh dawn loh control min pe a ni. Web Push: service worker chuan `push` events te chu a intercept a, a decrypt a, show te chu `self.registration.showNotification` hmangin a intercept thin.
push.h4_c: NSE pattern hi Apple chuan iOS 10 (2016) ah message-decryption hman dan tur bik atan a rawn hmang a ni. Chumi hma chuan end-to-end encrypted messenger te chuan plaintext push payload (privacy-hostile) leh badge-only push (UX-hostile) te chu an thlang tur a ni. WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram zawng zawng chu kum khat chhungin NSE-ah an zuang lut vek. Vortex pawhin chutiang bawk chu a zui ve bawk.
push.h5_a: Provider-specific quirks — push chapter-a tel ve a ni. Hei hi Vortex reference pumpuiah hian core mechanism reference pakhat a ni. A chhehvêl bung chu a thupui zau zâwk hriat nân chhiar la; he section hian nungchang bik chu a zoom in a ni.
push.h5_b: "Provider-specific quirks" te tana implementation thlirletna. Mechanism hi a inmil module-ah `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, emaw `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` tih hnuaiah implement a ni. Module README hian file path dik tak a ko chhuak thin.
push.h5_c: "Provider-specific quirks" mechanism hi Vortex release hrang hrangah a lo thang chho ta a ni. Design hi a hmaa messenger-te research leh production practice tihchhuah tawh atanga lo chhuak a ni. `CHANGELOG.md`-a version history-ah chuan piece tinte chu engtikah nge a tlak tih leh eng thilin nge a chhan tih a record a ni.

controller.title: Controller service a ni
controller.subtitle: Integrity attestation, entry hmuhchhuah, hriselna enkawl.
controller.intro: Controller hi Python process hran a ni. A attack surface hi a te hle (route dozen vel) a ni a, a rinna chu client-te hnena baked Ed25519 public key pakhatah a pin a ni.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — tihdikna result. Schema: `{status, signed_by, rintlak_pubkey, version, built_at, inmil, inmil lo, bo, extra, message}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/hriselna` — nunna. Schema: `{status: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{online, pawm, a vaiin}}`.
controller.h1p4: `GET /v1/mirrors` — darthlalang controller (DNS + IPFS + .onion chi hrang hrang) te.
controller.h1p5: `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` — federated peer hriat lar tak takte.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/thinlung thawk/{pubkey}` — node nunna chhui dan. Federated node ten an registration thar zel nan an hmang thin.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — rinna atan node thar a dil. `AUTO_APPROVE=true` a nih loh chuan admin phalna lak a ngai.
controller.h2p1: Manifest file chu: `INTEGRITY.sig.json` tih a ni. File khatah BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 signature a awm.
controller.h2p2: A siam chhuah: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. `keys/release.key` atanga release key a chhiar a, tree a kal a, manifest a ziak.
controller.h2p3: Verification: controller hian startup-ah manifest a chhiar a, disk nen a khaikhin thin. Startup hi mismatch ah a fail nasa hle.
controller.h3p1: Mirror hian controller code inang chiah chiah a kalpui a, release key inang chiah copy over a nei bawk. Client te hian mirror hrang hrangah `signed_by` inang chiah chiah an hmu a — mirror lem hriat theihna kawng khat chu pubkey te khaikhin hi a ni.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS mirror engemaw zat zinga pakhatah pointer a tichhuak thin. Client te chuan timeout hmangin priority order-in an tum thin.
controller.h3p3: He repo-a `vortex.sol-mirror/` directory hi hmasawnna atana trycloudflare mirror hman theih tura inpeih tawh a ni.
controller.h1_a: Controller-a public API surface hi kawng sawmhnih vel a ni. A te zawng zawng, attestation leh entry-URL discovery lam hawi vek.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — signed manifest attestation a ni. `/v1/health` — nunna + pubkey + stats. `/v1/entries` — connect theihna tur URL entry. `/v1/mirrors` — darthlalang controller te. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — federation peer te an ni. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — node nunna chhui dan. `/v1/register` — node thar chu rinna atan a dil (`AUTO_APPROVE=true` a nih loh chuan admin phalna lak a ni). Chu chu a ni — tumruh taka tih tawi a, attack surface minimal lo turin.
controller.h1_c: Narrow-surface design hi client-te’n an pin hnuah attestation process chu highest-value target a lo ni ta tih enfiahna atanga hriattir a ni. Code te zawk = surface te zawk. Route 120+ nei node nen khaikhin la; the controller has 12. Pattern inang: Debian-a apt-get hian package hosting atanga danglam `Release.gpg` process tenau tak a ring a.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` hian source tree a kalpui a, file tin a hash a, release key hmangin a sign a, `INTEGRITY.sig.json` a ziak bawk.
controller.h2_b: Tool chuan `keys/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 private key) tih a chhiar a. Walks `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (gitignored files te chu a huam lo). File tin tan: `blake3(content) → hash` tih hi a ni. Builds manifest `{version, built_at, files: [{path, sha256, size}]}` a awm a. `canonical_bytes = CBOR(manifest)` tih a chhut chhuak. Signs: `sig = Ed25519-Sign(chhuahna_key, canonical_bytes)`. `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, signed_by: pubkey, sig}` tih a ziak.
controller.h2_c: Signed manifests te hi Debian-a Release.gpg (1997) leh PGP-signed Linux kernel tarballs te atang khan a kir leh a. Sigstore (2021) chuan supply-chain attestation atan model chu a siam \ha leh a. Vortex version hi a rit zawk a, a chhan chu multi-party release chain ni lovin deployment pakhat chauh a attest vang a ni. Public release atan v0.4 ah Sigstore kan hmang mai thei.
controller.h3_a: Mirror te hian controller code inang an hmang a, release key inang an hmang bawk. DNS / SNS / IPFS entry tam tak chuan mirror engemaw zat zinga pakhat a kawk a.
controller.h3_b: Operator te chuan N mirror (a tlangpuiin 3-5) an siam thin. An vai hian `vortex_controller` code inang an run vek a, `keys/release.key` inang an hmang bawk. Client te chuan mirror hrang hrangah `signed_by` inang chiah chiah an hmu a — sanity check tha tak a ni. DNS/SNS/IPFS hian thil pawimawh ber berte nen list mirror a record thin. Client te hian priority order-in an try a, attempt khatah second 7 timeout an nei thin. He repo-a `vortex.sol-mirror/` directory hi trycloudflare mirror entirnan pre-wired a ni.
controller.h3_c: Priority lookup nei mirror tam tak hi SMTP-in MX record-a a hman leh HTTPS-in SRV record-a a hman pattern inang a ni. Tor-a directory thuneitute hi a kaihhnawih model a ni — 9 hardcoded DAs + votes. Vortex chuan "quorum vote" aiin "pick a mirror that works" a thlang zawk a, a chhan chu vote hmanga design siamte hi a resilient zawk a, mahse bootstrap erawh a slow zawk hle.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/integrity : GET → tihdikna result
/v1/health : GET → {a dinhmun, version, pubkey, stats}
/v1/entry : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...] tih hi a ni.
/v1/mirrors : GET → [controller_url, ...].
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{pubkey, tawp ber, hriselna}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (registered node atanga lak chauh)
/v1/register : POST (node thar tan)
controller.h2_f:
hmanrua = sign_tool
input = source thing, keys/release.key te a ni
manifest = { 1000 a ni.
  version: "0.1.0" tih a ni.
  built_at: unix_ms, 1000 a ni.
  files: [{kawng, sha256, lian leh te}, ...]
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign(tihchhuahna_priv, CBOR(manifest)) a ni.
output = INTEGRITY.sig.json = {a lan chhuahna, signed_by: pub_hex, sig: sig_hex}
controller.h3_f:
A rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah lutuk chuan a rilru a buai em em bawk a. DNSlink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS record vortexx.sol: {"darthlalang": [url1, url2, url3]} a ni.
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json tih leh a ni
client picks: a hmasa berin a hmasa berin a chhang thei a, 7 s timeout a ni

storage.title: Storage layer a ni
storage.subtitle: Dev atan SQLite, prod atan Postgres, migration atan Alembic, client-ah GRDB/Room/IndexedDB.
storage.intro: Vortex-a node storage chu SQL a ni. SQLite (dev) leh Postgres (prod) inkara inthlak hi DATABASE_URL thlak danglamna a ni — code fork a awm lo.
storage.h1: Core table hrang hrang a awm
storage.h1p1: `users(id, username, password_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email, created_at, is_active)` — identity table hmasa ber a ni.
storage.h1p2: `user_devices(id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, hmuh hnuhnun ber, revoked_at)` — device pakhata session row awm.
storage.h1p3: `rooms(id, type, hming, is_private, is_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, sawifiahna)` — room table, room khatah row khat.
storage.h1p4: `room_members(room_id, user_id, role, joined_at, muted_until)` — member nihna + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `messages(id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, deleted_at?, reply_to?, thread_id?, chi)` — message tin, `(room_id, id)`-ah index a ni.
storage.h1p6: `reactions(thuchah_id, user_id, emoji, siam_at)` — compound primary key `(thuchah_id, user_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `files(id, user_id, mime_type, size, sha256 /* a takah chuan BLAKE3 */, storage_path, uploaded_at)` — file metadata.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — room khata user pakhatin a chhiar hnuhnung ber pointer.
storage.h1p9: `presence(user_id, hmuh hnuhnun ber, room_id-ah_type_a awm em?)` — ephemeral, prod-a Redis-backed.
storage.h1p10: `federations(pubkey, endpoint, hriselna_score, added_at, added_by, revoked_at)` — peer list.
storage.h1p11: `federation_outbox(id, target_node, payload, tumna, next_retry_at)` — chhuak tur queue.
storage.h1p12: `scheduled_messages(id, room_id, ciphertext, nonce, thawn chhuah, siam, siam, cancelled_at)`.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs(user_id, url, zau zawng, san zawng, added_at)` — hmangtu pakhat tan GIF khawlkhawm.
storage.h1p15: `folders(user_id, id, hming, room_ids, is_system, siam_at)` — chat folder te.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(user_id, bot_id, installed_at)` — hmangtu pakhatin bot a install thin.
storage.h1p17: `sessions(jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)` — token registry tihthar leh tur a ni.
storage.h1p18: `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, siam_ah)` — registration chu nawr rawh.
storage.h2p1: Alembic chu `alembic/versions/` ah a awm. Linear history, release khatah revision pakhat (a chang chuan release khatah tlemte).
storage.h2p2: Dev mode: `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` tih hi iteration chak tak neih theih nan.
storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `alembic upgrade head` tih hi a start hmain a ni. Docker image hian entrypoint ah a run thin.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — paginated fetch atana index hmasa ber.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — edit-naah hun bi neia order siamna atan.
storage.h3p4: `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — `N` lookup-in a hmuh theih nan.
storage.h3p6: FTS virtual tables (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) hmanga thupui kimchang zawn theihna tur.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` hian timestamped archive a siam chhuak thin. Operator key hmanga chawlh laiin encrypt a ni.
storage.h4p2: Retention: nitin ni 14 chhung, kar tin kar 4 chhung, thla tin thla 12 chhung.
storage.h4p3: Restoration: `db-restore FILE=<path> siam rawh`. Staging DB pakhatah a tlan hmasa a; operator chuan a verify hnuah a swap leh thin.
storage.h1_a: Node storage hi SQL a ni. SQLite for dev leh self-hosted tenau te; PostgreSQL chu federated emaw multi-node emaw siamna atan a ni. SQLAlchemy 2.x async code inang hian a pahnih hian a drive vek a ni.
storage.h1_b: `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` emaw `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@host/db` emaw hmangin configure rawh. Single config, code fork awm lo. SQLite hi in-process-ah a kal a; Postgres hi a hranin a kal thin. Performance: SQLite hian M1-ah ~50 concurrent users chu nuam takin a handle a; Postgres scale chu sang tam takah a ni. Migration Postgres → SQLite hi kawng khata kal a ni a, `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite import hmangin; kawng dang pawh chutiang bawk chu a ni.
storage.h1_c: "One ORM, two backends" pattern hi kum sawm kalta chhunga SQLAlchemy practice a ni. Vortex hian async 2.x API a hmang a chuvangin query tin hian a nghak vek a ni. Migration story hausa zawk leh FastAPI-a async idioms nena inmil tur atan Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` aiin SQLAlchemy Core kan thlang zawk a ni.
storage.h2_a: 18 core tables: users, user_devices, rooms, room_members, messages, reactions, files, read_receipts, awmna, federations, federation_outbox, scheduled_messages, contacts, saved_gifs, folders, bot_installations, sessions, push_subscriptions te.
storage.h2_b: Users table hi identity root a ni. room_members hian (room, user, role, joined_at, muted_until) a nei a. message-te hian ciphertext + metadata a keng tel a; paginated fetch atan (room_id, id) ah index a ni. reactions chu compound-primary-key table a ni. Thil dang zawng zawng chu a dik vek. Storage hi message count nen linear takin a thang a — index overhead hnuah disk-a message khatah 1 KB vel a ni.
storage.h2_c: v0.0.4 hnuah schema chu a stable hle. Tun hma chuan `dm_messages` leh `group_messages` table hrang hrang kan nei a; fanout code chu an pahnih a duplicate hnuah v0.0.3 ah an inzawm khawm a ni. Table 18 hi feature-complete messenger tan chuan a tlem ber a ni a; deployment lian zawkah chuan analytics table a dah belh a mahse chu chu operation atan a ngai lo.
storage.h3_a: Alembic hian migration te a enkawl thin. Linear revision history, release khatah revision pakhat. Revision tin hian `upgrade()` leh `downgrade()` function pahnih a nei vek a.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` hian siamthatna a keng tel. File pakhat zel hi Python file a ni a, upgrade/downgrade a awm bawk. CI hian `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` hmangin round-trip a finfiah thin. Production: app start hmain Docker entrypoint ah `make db-migrate` tih a execute thin. Dev mode hian `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` a hmang a, chuvangin rebase tinah migration ngai lovin iteration hi a rang hle.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) hi SQLAlchemy migration tool canonical a ni a, a hman dan tur pawh a inang lo hle. Linear history (branching ni lo) hi duhthlan tur a ni — "developer pahnih hian revision number inang an siam" tih buaina chu a pumpelh a ni. Django-a migration-ah pawh hetiang bawk hian an hmang a ni. Rails hi kum 2014 khan linear aṭangin timestamped-ah a kal a, mahse kum 2020 khan linear-with-merge hi a hmang leh ta a ni.
storage.h4_a: Key index te hi uluk taka thlan a nih avangin hot reads (messages, reactions, read receipts) te hian disk hit an nei tlem hle.
storage.h4_b: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — a hmasa ber atan chuan a bulpui ber a ni. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — edit-na atana hun bituk anga fallback. `reactions(message_id)` — room hawn chunga aggregation. `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — "N hmanga hmuh" tih chhiar a ni. `user_devices(user_id)` — hmanrua list. FTS virtual tables zawn nan (SQLite-ah FTS5, Postgres-ah tsvector).
storage.h4_c: Index thlan turte chu v0.0.4 load testing neih lai khan explain-plan-profiling atanga lo chhuak a ni. Naive index hmangin kan tan a, observed query patterns atanga kan add/remove a ni. `messages(room_id, id DESC)` hi index hot ber pakhat a ni — roughly 80 % of reads hit it. A tawi zawnga dah (no include columns) chuan memory-ah a fit thei.

bots.title: Bot framework a ni
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + bazar hmun + antispam.
bots.intro: Bot te hi first-class room-a tel an ni. Message te hi bot pakhat Ed25519 key hmanga sign a nih avangin forgeries te chu hriat theih a ni.
bots.h1p1: Thil tih theih pahnih: Python SDK emaw Gravitix DSL emaw. Python hi hnathawh dan buaithlak tak tak tan a ni a; Gravitix event-driven chat bots te tan, rang taka thawn chhuah ngai te tan.
bots.h1p2:
Python entirnan: `vortex_bot atanga import Bot
bot = Bot(token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): nghah bot.send(msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run()`. SDK hian WebSocket, reconnection, encryption key exchange te a buaipui a ni.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix entirnan: `on /start { emit "Chibai, {ctx.hming hmasa ber}!" }` tih a ni. Bytecode-ah a compile a, sandboxed interpreter-ah a kal thin.
bots.h1p4: Bot token hi bot siam hunah pek chhuah a ni. Token hloh tawh em? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` chuan a thar a tichhuak.
bots.h2p1: Deployment model pahnih: in-process (node ​​chhunga coroutine) leh external (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`) te an ni.
bots.h2p2: In-process: network hop zero, chak ber, mahse operator chuan bot code a ring tur a ni. Good chu mahni bot tan a ni.
bots.h2p3: Pawn lam: webhook emaw long-poll emaw. Node-level rintlak a ngai lo. Third-party bot leh marketplace tan Good a ni.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots hi sandbox-ah in-process-in an kal fo thin — explicit API tih loh chu filesystem emaw network access emaw an nei lo.
bots.h3p1: Public bot te chu marketplace ah an submit thei a ni. Reviewer te hian code hian phish a ti lo, spam a ti lo, user data a leak lo tih an verify thin.
bots.h3p2: Categories: productivity, games, chanchinbu, utilities, ai, lehlin.
bots.h3p3: Install: vawi khat click rawh. Node hian user chu bot username ah a subscribe avangin DM te hian route dik tak an siam thin.
bots.h3p4: Monetization: a thlawna, vawi khat lei theih, subscription. Platform fee chu gross atanga 10 %% a ni.
bots.h4p1: Room tin hi hmuh theih loh antispam bot hmanga enkawl a ni. Checks: minute khatah link density > 3, char 10+ tan capital-letter ratio > 70 %%, message repeat, account thar joiner puak nghal mai.
bots.h4p2: Thiltih tur: warn → timeout (5 min) → kick → ban. Appeal chu room admin hnenah a kal thin.
bots.h4p3: Bot config hmangin room khatah tune theih a ni.
bots.h1_a: Bot te hi first-class room-a tel an ni. Ed25519 key leh token pakhat theuh an nei a; an message thawn apiang chu sign vek a nih avangin forgeries chu hriat theih a ni.
bots.h1_b: Siam rawh: neitu chuan `/api/bots` chu `{username, display_name, code}` hmangin a POST thin. Node hian `is_bot=true` hmangin `users` row a siam a, Ed25519 keypair a siam a, private-key bot token chu a neitu hnenah a pe kir leh a (vawi khat a lantir). Run: bot hi in-process-ah coroutine angin a nung emaw, pawn lam atangin a token hmangin `/api/bots/{id}/updates` a poll emaw a ni. Bot atanga message lo lut hian `from_bot: true` flag a keng tel a, bot private key hmanga sign a ni.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs hi Slack (2014) chuan a hmahruaitu a ni a, Telegram (2015) chuan a tithianghlim bawk. Vortex's twist: bot signatures hian message te chu bot identity ah a bind a, chuvangin compromised node chuan "@bot said X" a fabricate thei lo. Matrix-a bot support hian kum 2021 khan federated signatures hmangin he property hi a rawn dah belh a; Vortex hian v0.0.5 atang khan a nei tawh.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix hi event-driven bots ziah nan domain-specific language a ni. Tiny, expressive, sandboxed bytecode-a compiled a ni.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `on /start { emit "Chibai, {ctx.hming_ hmasa ber}!" }` tih a ni. Handler te hian trigger (command, regex, event) te nen an binding thin. Body hi `emit`, `let`, `if`, `schedule`, etc. te inzawmkhawm a ni a, Compiler hian bytecode a pe chhuak a; runtime hian filesystem nei lo, arbitrary network nei lo, Vortex’s API chauh nei sandbox-ah a interpret a. Gravitix docs bung-ah hian a kimchangin a awm.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix hi v0.0.6 lai khan bot code tam zawk chu Vortex SDK wire up turin 80 % boilerplate a nih thu an hmuh hnuah design a ni a, a laiah actual logic kernel a awm a ni. A DSL hian logic chu a ti eng a, sandbox tlanchhuah theihna tur bot-dev environment-a arbitrary Python shovelling a veng bawk.
bots.h3_a: Room tinah hian hmuh theih loh antispam bot a awm a, chu chuan tuilian, link spam, message repeated leh new-account join burst te a en reng a ni.
bots.h3_b: Rules: user pakhat atanga minute khatah link density > 3, message ≥ 10 chars-ah ALL-CAPS ratio > 70 %, message repeat > 30 s chhung, account age < 24 h nei joiner burst > 60 s chhungin 20. Actions a zual zel: warning → minute 5 chhung timeout → darkar 1 chhung kick → ban (admin approval for ban). `/antispam config` hmangin room khatah tune theih a ni.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics hi IRC hunlai bot rules (Eggdrop, BitchX) leh tunlai system Discord AutoMod ang chi te inzawmkhawm atanga lo chhuak a ni. Vortex-a threshold bikte chu thla 6 chhunga beta corpus message 200k awmna nen tuned a ni a; false-positive rate chu ban-appeal rate hmuhchhuah zingah ~0.3 % a ni.
bots.h4_a: Public bot te hian marketplace ah an submit thin. Reviewer te chuan phishing a awm lo / spam a awm lo / data leak a awm lo tih an verify thin. User te chuan category hrang hrangin an browse a, click khatah an install thin.
bots.h4_b: Submission: neituin bot source + sawifiahna a post. Reviewer hian code chu sandbox-ah a run a, anti-pattern hriat tawhte chu a chhiar a, network call eng pawh allowed APIs kaltlangin a check a, privacy policy a verify bawk. Listing: category, man, rating, install zat. Install: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node hian user pakhat tan subscription a siam a. Monetization: a thlawna / vawi khat / subscription; platform hian 10 % a la a ni.
bots.h4_c: App marketplace te hi kum 2008 App Store atang khan a ni. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot Listings (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024) te a ni. Vortex-a 10 % cut hi Apple-a 30 % aiin a hniam a, Shopify-a 20 % aiin a hniam deuh a, hei hi developer-te publish tura incentivize nana thlan a ni. Review policy hi GitLab-in "review by default, delist on complaint" a tih ang chi model a ni.

ops.title: Operation hrang hrang
ops.subtitle: Deploy, monitor, rollback te pawh a awm bawk.
ops.intro: Operational task tin hian `make` target emaw CLI command emaw a nei vek a. Ops page te hi `deploy/` ah an awm thin.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` hian node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy te a rawn keng tel a.
ops.h1p2: Volume hrang hrang: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` te a ni. Persistence atan host turin mount rawh.
ops.h1p3: Environment: `.env` chu repo root ah a awm. Engtikah mah inpek suh. `.env.example` tih hi a template a ni.
ops.h1p4: Caddy hian auto-fetch Let's Encrypt certs a nei a. Let's Encrypt rate limits hman a ni — experiment atan staging hmang rawh.
ops.h2p1: `make install` — Python deps + dev hmanrua te install rawh.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn chu port 9000-ah reload a ni.
ops.h2p3: `test siam` — pytest + coverage; `coverage.xml` a siam chhuak thin.
ops.h2p4: `lint siam` — ruff + mypy. CI a hlawhchham chuan block a ni.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` — CI pipeline kimchang chu tualchhung lamah kalpui rawh.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` hi PyInstaller bundle a ni a, pywebview GUI a awm bawk.
ops.h3p2: Flow hmasa ber: node hming thlang → release key siam → configure TLS (Let's Encrypt / bring-your-own / self-signed) → entry URLs thlang → stealth enable → firewall port hawng.
ops.h3p3: Setup zawhah wizard chu admin console angin a awm reng a: start/stop node, logs en, keys rotate, federated peers add.
ops.h4p1: Release tin hi git-a tagged a ni. Tag pawh release key hmanga sign a nih avangin tag ngei pawh hi verifiable a ni.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && docker-build siam && docker compose up -d`. Running node te chu an drain a, an restart leh thin.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` chu minor version pakhat tan a support leh tawh. Further back ah chuan kut hmanga inrawlh a ngai.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` hian Vortex stack kimchang a rawn keng tel a: node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` tih chu repo root ah a awm. Volume `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` host-a mount a nih avangin restart zawng zawngah data a awm reng a ni. Healthchecks: node hrisel iff `/health/ready` chuan 200 a rawn pe leh ang; controller iff `/v1/integrity` a rawn kir leh a, a dik tih finfiah a ni. Caddy hian auto-fetch Let's Encrypt certs a nei a. `.env` hian thuruk a supply (commit ngai lo). `.env.example` tih hi a template a ni.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose hi multi-container self-hosted service hrang hrangte de-facto pattern a ni. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux te hian an hmang vek a ni. Vortex-a compose file chu v0.0.2 atang khan iterated a ni a; tuna a pianzia chu v0.0.5 ah a stabilise. Alternatives (k8s, nomad) chu operator lian tak takte tan exercise atan dah a ni.
ops.h2_a: Makefile hi dev leh ops action tin atan central entrypoint a ni. `make help` hian target a tarlang a.
ops.h2_b: `make install` → `pip install -r mamawh.txt`. `make dev` → uvicorn chu reload nen a awm. `make test` → pytest + coverage, `coverage.xml` tih chhuah. `lint siam` → ruff + mypy tih a ni. `docker-build siam` → `docker siam -t vortex:$VERSION`. `make db-migrate` → `alembic tihchangtlunna lu`. `db-backup siam` / `db-restore siam FILE=...`. `make ci` → full CI pipeline tualchhung lamah.
ops.h2_c: Canonical entrypoint atan Makefile hi kum sawm tam tak kalta atanga Unix practice a ni a, Python project lian ber ber (pytest, django, flask, fastapi) zawng zawngin an lo hmang tawh a ni. Hmanraw dang (Poetry, Hatch, uv) te hi kum khat chhunga flavour-of-the-year an ni a; Make hi a boring a, universal a ni.
ops.h3_a: Setup wizard hi PyInstaller bundle (`Vortex Wizard.app`) a ni a, pywebview GUI a awm a, chu chuan a vawi khatna atana operator chu deployment kaltlangin a kalpui a ni.
ops.h3_b: Flow hmasa ber: node hming thlang → release key siam (Ed25519 keypair chu `keys/release.key` ah save) → configure TLS (Let's Encrypt / bring-your-own / self-signed) → entry URLs (vortexx.sol / custom domain / .onion) thlang → stealth level enable → firewall port hawng (iptables/ufw/pf) a ni. A hmasa ber run hnuah wizard chu admin console angin a awm reng a: start/stop node, logs en, keys rotate, federated peers add.
ops.h3_c: Setup wizards hi sysadmin hmang lote target-a self-hosted tools pattern a ni a: Ghost-a onboarding (2015), Standard Notes-a server setup, Mastodon-a installation zawhnate. PyInstaller hian double-click theih binary pakhat kan thawn thei a; pywebview hian 127.0.0.1 — browser UX-a bundled FastAPI admin API-in a service local HTML page chu native GUI siamna kawnga harsatna awm lovin a render a.
ops.h4_a: Release tin hi git hmanga tag a ni. Rollback hi `git checkout <tag> && docker-build siam && docker compose up -d` a ni. Migrations hian `downgrade()` function a nei a.
ops.h4_b: Tags hi release key hmanga sign a nih avangin tag ngei pawh hi verifiable a ni. Rollback kalphung: tag hlui checkout, image siam thar, container siam thar — connection kal lai SIGTERM (default 15 s grace) ah a drain. DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` hian revision pakhat a rawn let leh. Data hloh loh: release khatah column kan drop ngai lo; drops hi code-in a chhiar tawh loh hnuah N+1-in a thleng thin.
ops.h4_c: "code-then-code" migration pattern (expand-migrate-contract) hi zero-downtime deployment atan chuan standard a ni. Stripe-a migration guide (2019) hian a sawifiah tha ber. Vortex hian v0.0.3-a thil thleng pakhat, column tlak avanga minute 30 chhung maintenance window neih a ngai hnuah a adopt a ni.

release flow: 1.1.

  2. migration: code thar chuan "v2" a ziak a; hlui chuan "v1" a la chhiar reng.

mobile.title: Mobile client te tan a ni
mobile.subtitle: iOS leh Android — native UI, protocol inang.
mobile.intro: Mobile client pahnih hi full peer an ni a, thin web wrapper an ni lo. Native look, native performance, native integration (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets) te pawh a awm bawk.
mobile.h1p1: Swift Package hi `ios/Modules/` ah dah a ni. Feature module 30+ a awm a, pakhat zel chu SOLID-a then `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/` a ni.
mobile.h1p2: App target chu `ios/VortexApp/` ah a awm. `ios/project.yml`-a XcodeGen spec hian xcodeproj chu a siam thar leh a.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id) te hi a ni.
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Mutation zawng zawng hi `db.write` kaltlangin a kal vek.
mobile.h1p5: WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework tih a ni.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNs te chu `UNUserNotificationCenter` kaltlangin + Notification Service Extension hmangin decryption atan.
mobile.h2: Android structure hmanga siam a ni
mobile.h2p1: Gradle project chu `android/` ah a ni. Feature module 22 Hilt DI nei, `api / impl / di / ui` split ang chiah.
mobile.h2p3: Crypto: AndroidX venhimna + Tink + `argon2-jvm` tih a ni.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Room ah hian FTS4 triggers a awm.
mobile.h2p6: Push: FCM + FirebaseMessagingService hmanga tihchhuah a ni.
mobile.h3p1: 146-locale bundle ang chiah, native hming (`Русский ru`, `English en`, `中文 zh`, ...) nen.
mobile.h3p2: 1500-emoji catalog ang chiah a ni a, category 9 + skin-tones + MRU + search a awm bawk.
mobile.h3p3: Switching atan pawh multi-account X25519 challenge-response ang chiah.
mobile.h3p4: Chat folder inang (All / Archived / custom) ah drag-and-drop reordering a awm bawk.
mobile.h3p5: Saved-GIFs list inang (Tenor a awm lo — mimal khawlkhawm chauh).
mobile.h3p6: Scheduled-message inang UI, contacts screen, premium status page te pawh a awm bawk.
mobile.h1_a: iOS client hi Swift Package a ni a, feature module 30+ a awm a ni. Client dang zawng zawng ang bawkin HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocol inang.
mobile.h1_b: Feature hrang hranga modules buatsaih: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Calls`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premium`, `Reactions`, .... Tin, `api/` (protocols), `impl/` (concrete class), `ui/` (SwiftUI views) ah an inthen vek a. A rilru a buai em em a, a rilru a hah em em bawk a. X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2id tan Argon2Swift a ni. DB: GRDB leh FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework tih a ni. Push: Sealed-push decryption atan Notification Service Extension nei APN te.
mobile.h1_c: Modular package hi Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019) atanga Swift hman dan pangngai a ni. api/impl/ui-a kan in\henna hi SOLID-ish a ni: dependency inversion (modules te hi api/ chauh a innghat), ngaihtuahna hrang hrang inthen darh, testability (test atan impl thlak). Module 30+ count hi build parallelism atan duhthlan tur a ni — module tin hian isolation-in an compile thin.
mobile.h2_a: Android client hian iOS a entir a: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. Feature module 22, `api / impl / di` inthen ang chiah a ni.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), targetSdk 34 (Android 14) a ni. Crypto: AndroidX security + Tink hi AES-GCM tan a ni a; Argon2id atan argon2-jvm a awm. DB: Room ah hian FTS4 triggers a awm. WebRTC: WebRTC Android ah stream theih a ni. Push: FCM FirebaseMessagingService hmanga + envelope sealed decryption hmanga tihchhuah a ni. Gradle multi-module, Hilt hian feature module te chu direct dependency awm lovin a thlunzawm thei a ni.
mobile.h2_c: Compose hi Google-a declarative UI toolkit a ni a, kum 2021 atang khan stable a ni a, Hilt (2020) hi Dagger 2 chunga Google-endorsed DI framework a ni a, an pahnih hian iOS-a SwiftUI + property wrappers te nen an inmil a, architectural feel inang deuh vek a ni. Vortex chuan v0.0.4 atang khan Compose/Hilt a hmang tan a; a hmain Android hi View-based a ni.
mobile.h3_a: iOS leh Android pahnih hian 146-locale JSON set inang chiah an bundle a, native name leh 1500-emoji catalog — user pakhatin iOS 17-a 🥹 a ziah hian Android 9-ah a render 🥹.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` hian `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json` a entir a. Apps pahnih hian an launch hmasak ber (language picker screen)-ah locale dik tak an load a, duhthlanna chu an persist bawk. Emoji catalog hi category 9 JSON a ni a, bundle pahnihah hian thawn chhuah a ni a; OS-level emoji-set divergence a sidestep a, chu chuan OS hlui zawka unrendered `?` glyphs a thlen thin.
mobile.h3_c: I emoji catalog i thawn chhuah hi Telegram-in a hman dan pattern (an Twemoji fork) leh WhatsApp-in kum 2022 thlenga a hman dan a ni a, a trade-off: ~300 KB extra per app bundle for emoji + ~1.2 MB for locales. Cross-platform consistency atan a hlu hle.

webclient.title: Web client a ni
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, offline mode, service hnathawk.
webclient.intro: Web client hi vanilla-JS PWA a ni. React awm lo, ESM aia bundler awm lo. ~400 KB gzipped zawng zawng, locale 146 telin.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` tih a ni. Feature modules hman hmasak ber ah lazy-load a ni.
webclient.h1p2: State: IndexedDB-a room khata ring buffer awm, in-memory decrypted cache. Service Worker chuan fetch a mediate thin.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Liquid Glass hian CSS backdrop-filter hmangin a nghawng thei. Framework a awm lo; event delegation + idempotent render tanpuitute an ni.
webclient.h2p1: Offline-a IndexedDB-a queue-a awm laiin write siam eng pawh. SW connection a lo kir leh chuan a flush thin.
webclient.h2p2: Idempotency key on every POST chuan duplicate retries chu him takin a hlawhtling thei a ni.
webclient.h2p3: Chhiar hi offline-ah a thawk kim vek — synced ciphertext zawng zawng hi IndexedDB-ah a nung vek.
webclient.h3p1: `static/locales/*.json` ah hian locale 146 a awm. Welcome screen (`lang-picker.js`) hian native-name hints hmangin a cycle a.
webclient.h3p2: Runtime locale switch: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + `data-i18n` attribute hmangin label te chu re-render leh rawh.
webclient.h1_a: Web client hi vanilla-JS PWA a ni. No React, ESM bundling aia build step awm lo. JS thawn chhuah zawng zawng: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` hi Jinja2-a siam shell a ni. `static/js/main.js` tih hi ES-module-a lut tur a ni. Feature module te chu `static/js/<feature>/` ah hman hmasak ber ah lazy-load a ni. CSS chu `static/css/`-ah 1-file-per-component convention hmangin a awm. Service Worker hian cache a enkawl a; initial load chu network atanga lo chhuak a ni a, a hnuah cache atanga lo chhuak a ni; update checks te chu navigation ah a awm.
webclient.h1_c: Staying off frameworks chu React leh Vue PWAs ~1.5 MB gzipped with similar features benchmarking hnuah tumruh taka v0.0.1 thutlukna a ni. Vanilla JS + ES module te hian ~400 KB min pe a. Trade-off chu DOM-manipulation boilerplate a ni zawk a, chu chu `static/js/lib/dom.js`-a helper te te hmangin kan mitigate thin.
webclient.h2_a: Offline mode: outgoing chuan IndexedDB-ah queue a ziak a; Service Worker chuan connection a lo kir leh chuan a flush thin.
webclient.h2_b: User-in offline-a a siam POST / PATCH eng pawh hian idempotency key a hmu a, `outbox` (IndexedDB) ah a tla thla thin. Service Worker hian `online` event a ngaithla a, idempotency key chu header atan hmangin a post leh thin. Server hian idempotency key hmangin duplicate a hre thei a, original response chu a pe let leh thin. Reading hian offline-ah hna a thawk kim vek — synced ciphertext zawng zawng hi IndexedDB-ah a awm vek a, in-memory key hmangin local-in a decrypt vek bawk.
webclient.h2_c: Retryable POSTs atana Idempotency keys hi Stripe-in ​​2017 convention a siam a ni a, tunlai API tam zawkin an pawm a ni. Outbox angin IndexedDB hi offline edit atan Google Drive web-in a hman thin pattern a ni. Vortex implementation chu `static/js/lib/outbox.js` ah line ~200 a ni.
webclient.h3_a: `static/locales/*.json` ah hian tawng 146 bundle a awm. Welcome screen hian native-name hints (`Выберите язык` / `I tawng thlang rawh` / `选择语言` / ...) hmangin a cycle a.
webclient.h3_b: First launch: `lang-picker.js` hian typewriter-animated hint a tarlang a, chu chu locale 97 kaltlangin 45 ms/char-in a rotate a, 1.8 s a pause a, 30 ms/char-ah a delete a, advances a ni. User chuan ṭawng pakhat a thlang a; `localStorage.vortex_lang` ah a awm reng. A hnua run apiangin saved choice chu a chhiar vek thin. Runtime switch: `setLang(code)` hian JSON a load a, `data-i18n` element te chu a re-render leh thin.
webclient.h3_c: Typewriter-hint pattern hi terminal splash screen hlui zahna a ni a, v0.0.6 beta-a user-te’n static dropdown an ngaihthah hnuah UX warmth atan hman a ni. Cycling hints hian second 1 chhung window a pe a, user tinte chuan an tawng hming an hmu thei a, an hre nghal thei bawk.

security.title: Security dinhmun a ni
security.subtitle: Threat model, defence-in-depth, WAF, audit trail, canary te pawh a awm bawk.
security.intro: Vortex hian defence-in-depth a hmang a: layer khat tihchhiat hi a tawk lo, attacker tak tak chuan independent win tam tak a mamawh a ni.
security.h1p1: **Passive network observer**: packet TLS a hmu a; size/timing analysis a ti thin. Level 1 stealth hmangin hnehna a chang.
security.h1p2: **Active network attacker**: a drop/delay/inject thei. Level 2-4 stealth hmanga hneh loh a ni.
security.h1p3: **Node operator tihchhiat**: ciphertext + metadata a hmu. Message content chu thuruk a ni reng.
security.h1p4: **Client device rukbo**: message hmasa pholan tawhte plaintext. Double Ratchet hian session hman mek a tihkhawtlai a; wipe-on-next-unlock theih a ni.
security.h1p5: **Quantum adversary with stored past traffic**: a rualpui pahnihin PQ an advertise laiin hybrid Kyber-768 session key hmangin hneh a ni.
security.h2p1: Inspector dilna: SQLi patterns, kawng zawh dan, template injection, LFI, NoSQLi te. App code hmain a tla thla.
security.h2p2: Rate limit: khawvel pum huapa 1000 req/s soft cap burst nei; kawng khatah (login 10/min, register 5/min); per-user auth hnuah req/s 100 a awm.
security.h2p3: Geo-blocking hi `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN` hmangin duhthlan theih a ni.
security.h3p1: Security nena inzawm thil thleng (admin action, federation thlak danglam, release upgrade, panic wipe) te chu `app/security/canary.py` hmangin hash-chained a ni.
security.h3p2: Chain break ⇒ tampering hmuhchhuah a ni. Alert kangmei chhuak.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` hian log chu a pholang (admin auth chauh). Append-na tur chauh a ni.
security.h4p1: Canary file ah nitin release key hmangin sign thin a ni. Absence ⇒ inremna siam nia rinhlelh.
security.h4p2: Emergency revocation: admin chuan WebSocket tin hnenah `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` a tichhuak thin. Client te hian cached key te chu an wipe thin.
security.h4p3: Rotation: release key thar, manifest sign leh, tihchhuah leh. Client te chuan an bootstrap leh thin.
security.h1_a: Adversary class pali hian design hi an khalh a, chungte chu passive observer, active attacker, compromised operator, compromised device te an ni. Layer hrang hrangin an hneh vek.
security.h1_b: Passive observer: TLS-encrypted packet a hmu a, traffic analysis a ti bawk. Level 1-2 stealth hmangin an tlawm. Active attacker: packet a drop/delay/inject thei. Level 3-4 stealth hmanga hneh loh a ni. Operator tihchhiat: ciphertext + metadata a hmu. E2E crypto + metadata tih tlem hmangin hneh a ni. Compromised device: message hmasa plaintext a hmu thei. Damage chu hmalam thuruk (Double Ratchet) leh panic wipe hmanga tihkhawtlai a ni.
security.h1_c: Class pali model hi Schneier-a'n kum 1999-a "Applied Cryptography" threat model taxonomy aṭanga lo chhuak a ni a, Snowden hnu lama state-level observer-te chungchanga a thil hmuhchhuahte nen a tizau a ni. Tunlai secure-messenger design zawng zawng hian chutiang thil chu a tarlang vek a ni. Vortex-a twist chu v0.4 roadmap atan class pangana a dah belh a ni: quantum-enabled adversary with stored past traffic, hei hi Kyber hian a handle a ni.
security.h2_a: WAF hian request tin chu app code a thlen hmain a enfiah vek a, SQL-i, path traversal, template injection, NoSQLi te chu a hnawl vek a ni.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` hian URL, query, leh body te lakah ~50 regex check a kalpui thin. Pattern tha lo hriat tawh (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Rate limit: global 1000 req/s soft cap burst tolerance nei kawng khatah `/login` 10/min, `/register` 5/min; per-user auth hnuah req/s 100 a awm. Geo-blocking optional via `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` hmangin compliant operator-te tan sanction mamawh phuhrukna tur a ni.
security.h2_c: Middleware anga WAFs hi pattern din tawh a ni — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare-a WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex’s hi tumruh takin a tlem ber a, a chhan chu WAF rit tak hian false positive a siam a, chu chuan hlauhawm tak tak a pil bo a ni. Regex list hi OWASP Top 10 signatures atanga siam niin, beta WAF rule hmangin SQL chungchang chat message chhunga literal string "DROP TABLE" a block hnuah v0.0.5 ah refined a ni.
security.h3_a: Security nena inzawm thil thlengte chu hash-chained audit log-ah a tla thla thin. Chain chhunga break a awm chuan tampering a awm tih a tilang.
security.h3_b: Admin action, federation thlak danglam, release upgrade, emaw panic wipe zawng zawng hi `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)` ah dah vek a ni. Row tin hian `prev_hash = hash(prev_row)` a keng tel vek a. Tuna row awm mek hash hi `ts ∥ event ∥ prev_hash` hmanga chhut a ni. Row eng pawh tihbo emaw tihdanglam emaw a nih chuan a hnua row awmte `prev_hash` chain a chhe — chain replay hmanga hriat theih.
security.h3_c: Hash-chained audit logs hi primitive hlui tak a ni (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd hian a hmang thin. Git-a commit DAG hi a bulpui berah chuan structure inang a ni. Vortex chuan v0.0.6-ah consultant pakhatin compromised node chuan log rows chu ngawi rengin a erase thei tih a sawi hnuah a added a ni.
security.h4_a: Incident response hi ruahman lawk a ni: canary chuan release key chu a inrem lo tih a finfiah a; emergency revocation hian client zawng zawngah cached keys a wipe vek a ni.
security.h4_b: Nitin `canary.txt` chu release key hmanga sign a ni a, controller bulah tihchhuah a ni. Client te chuan startup-ah duhthusamin an verify thin — absence ⇒ compromise rinhlelh. Inremna a awm tih finfiah a nih chuan: admin chuan WebSocket tin chungah `{type:"n", event:"compromise", reason}` a tichhuak thin. Client te chuan cached key te chu an wipe a, re-login an force thin. Release key thar minted, manifest re-signed, clients te chu mirrored integrity endpoint atanga re-bootstrap an ni. Ciphertext hlui chu design hmanga chhiar theih loha siam a ni.
security.h4_c: Canary files te hi Apple-in kum 2013-a warrant canary leh `canarywatch.org` project atanga a trace a ni. Signal hian a hmang thin. Vortex's hi automated a ni: cron pakhat chuan 24 h danah release key hmangin `canary.txt` a sign thin. Emergency revocation broadcast hi certificate mass-revocation atana Let's Encrypt hman dan ang chiah a ni.
security.h2_f:
dilna apiangah a check thin:
  SQL injection : hriat chhuah UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- etc.
  kawng zawh : ../, ..%2f, URL-a encoded chi hrang hrangte hriatchhuah
  template injection : hriat chhuah {{, {% .
  XSS : hriat chhuah <script, javascript:
  NoSQLi : $ne, $khawiah nge, $regex tih hriatchhuah
rate limit: 1000/s global, 10/min login, 5/min register
security.h3_f:
row: {ts, thilthleng, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash} te chu a hnuaia mi ang hian a ni.
row_hash = SHA-256(ts ∥ thilthleng ∥ actor_id ∥ ... ∥ prev_hash)
verify: walk log, row_hash tin chu re-compute la, stored value nen khaikhin rawh
break ⇒ chu row-ah chuan tampering hmuhchhuah a ni
security.h4_f:
canary.txt (nitin):
  {ni, sig: Ed25519-Sign(chhuahna_priv, ni)}
client verifies → awm lo emaw dik lo emaw ⇒ inremna siam nia rinhlelh

emergency a nih chuan:
  admin POST /api/admin/revoke-engkim {a chhan}.
  node broadcasts {type:"n", thilthleng:"inremna", chhan}
  client te chuan key an wipe a, re-bootstrap an force thin

privacy.title: Privacy leh zawm dan tur
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, right-to-erasure, metadata tih tlem, data phurh theihna.
privacy.intro: Vortex chuan GDPR leh CCPA tooling chu box atangin a thawn chhuak thin. Regulated jurisdiction-a operator-te chuan statutory request apiangah admin endpoint pakhat an nei vek a.
privacy.h1p1: Default-ah chuan IP logs a awm lo. Operator-in a duh loh chuan reverse proxy strip `X-Real-IP` a ni.
privacy.h1p2: Message row-a `sender_pseudo` hian sender ID tak takte chu a hash a — DB dump-ah chuan per-room pseudonyms chauh a lang.
privacy.h1p3: Search hian encrypted-tokens a hmang thin. Client hian keywords chu room key hmangin a encrypt a; node hian opaque token a dahkhawm a; lookup hi ciphertext token-ah chuan exact-match a ni.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen chu user thlan granularity-ah truncated a ni.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` hian user row chu a hming a ti lo a, an message thawn (metadata chu quorum atana dah) a wipe a, disk atanga file a delete bawk.
privacy.h2p2: Federation: signed gossip chuan a rualpuite a hriattir a; an sir lamah 72 h chhungin an erase.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: erasure hi timestamp leh (hashed) user id hmanga logged a nih avangin operator chuan compliance a finfiah thei a ni.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` hian zip a stream a: profile JSON, ciphertext thawn/ dawn, file reference pakhata file root key hmanga file reference, contact list.
privacy.h3p2: Generation hun: ~5 min message 10 k atan, IO hmanga bounded.
privacy.h3p3: Recipient chuan ciphertext chu local-ah a decrypt tur a ni; export tooling pawh a rualin an thawn chhuak bawk.
privacy.h4p1: Long-press logo 5 s → local wipe nghal: key, cached message, attachment.
privacy.h4p2: Coupled wipe: `/api/privacy/panic` pawh hian server-side account chu tombstone a ni.
privacy.h1_a: Default-ah chuan IP logs a awm lo. Message row-ah user-identifying metadata a awm lo. Encrypted token hmanga full-text zawn.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy hian node-in a hmuh hmain `X-Real-IP` a strip a, operator-in rate-limiting a duh loh chuan. Message row-ah hian `sender_id` (ACL tan) leh `sender_pseudo` (fan-out atan) te dah a ni a; sender_pseudo hi HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) a nih avangin DB dump hian room hrang hrangah tuin nge eng nge a sawi tih a lang lo. Search: client hian room key hmangin keywords a encrypt a; node hian opaque token a dahkhawm a; lookup hi ciphertext token-ah chuan exact-match a ni a, plaintext index a awm lo.
privacy.h1_c: Metadata minimization hi Snowden hnu lama inremna a ni — Signal chuan kum 2014 khan a ti lar hle a, WhatsApp chuan kum 2019 khan sender-pseudo hmangin a zui a, ciphertext token hmanga encrypted search chu CryptDB (2011) leh ShadowCrypt (2014) pattern a ni. Vortex implementation hi stripped-down version a ni a, query flexibility thenkhat chu awlsam zawk nan a trade a ni.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` hian user row chu a hming a ti lo a, an ciphertext thawn chu a wipe a, file a delete a, federated peer te a hriattir bawk.
privacy.h2_b: Server-side: `users` row-a sensitive field-te zeroed (`username = "deleted-<id>"`, `phone = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[deleted]"`); `messages.ciphertext` hian row zawng zawng tan NULL set a, chutah chuan `sender_id = u.id`; disk atanga delete tawh message atanga link file te. Federated peer-te chuan signed `{event: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}` thuthang an dawng a; an sir lamah purge ang chiah chu 72 h (SLA) chhungin an tlanpui thin.
privacy.h2_c: Right-to-erasure hi kum 2018 atang khan GDPR Article 17-in a phut a ni a, CCPA hian kum 2020 khan a zui a; LGPD (Brazil) in 2021. Vortex hian primitive out-of-the-box a thawn chhuak a, chuvangin regulated jurisdiction-a operator-te chuan an siam a ngai lo. 72 h federation SLA hian GDPR-in ni 30 chhunga a chhanna window a siam chu a thehdarh theihna tur headroom nen a inmil a ni.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` hian zip a stream a: profile JSON, ciphertext thawn/ dawn, file reference pakhata file root key hmanga file reference, contact list.
privacy.h3_b: Generation hi async a ni a, a chhan chu account lian tak tak hian minute a mamawh a ni. Client POSTs dilna → node enqueue hna → hna chu background-ah a kal → client poll `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 signed URL nen a inpeih hunah. Zip chhunga thu awmte chu: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (room khatah pakhat), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + file khatah root keys), `files/` (downloaded-as-is blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Data portability hi twin requirement a ni a, GDPR ah erasure a awm bawk. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal te hian takeout hmanrua an nei vek a. Vortex’s hian key material (file_root per file) a dah belh avangin users te chuan export chu local takin an decrypt thei a — chutiang a nih loh chuan export chu a tangkai lo. Hetiang detail hi awm lo se Apple / Google takeouts te hi effective takin plaintext-only an ni a, a chhan chu an decrypt tawh avangin.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: Vortex logo chu second 5 chhung long-press la, key leh cached data on-device zawng zawng chu a tichhia vek ang. A let leh theih loh.
privacy.h4_b: Client-side: second 5 chhunga long-press-ah chuan confirmation entir; confirm hunah chuan `wipeKeychainItems()` / `clearKeystore()` / `localStorage.clear() + indexedDB.databases().forEach(deleteDatabase)` tih chu ko rawh. Cached ciphertext a bo tawh a, key a bo tawh a, JWT a bo tawh bawk. Optional coupled wipe: `POST /api/privacy/panic` pawh hian account server-side-ah tombstone a siam a, erasure gossip a federate bawk.
privacy.h4_c: Panic button / dead-man switch hian secure messaging-ah hian history rei tak a nei tawh a: Wickr-a 2014-a "Shred", Cryptocat-a 2013-a "Forget", Signal-in "Secure Deletion" proposal (2016, a thawn ngai lo). Vortex-a second 5 chhunga long-press hi tumruh takin accident-a trigger harsa tak a ni — iPhone 15 leh Pixel 8-a haptic feedback kan zirchiang a, "emergency-a chak tawk" leh "pocket-button hmanga kah theih loh" inkar sweet spot atan 5 s kan thlang a ni.
privacy.h1_f:
thawntu_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(room_salt, thawntu_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB dump: {room, a thawntu_pseudo, ciphertext}
  ⇒ attacker chuan sender_pseudo chu room hrang hrangah a link thei lo (salt hrang hrang)

search token = HMAC-SHA256(room_key, thu pawimawh)
  ⇒ "hello" tih zawhna ⇒ compute token ⇒ exact-match index lookup
  ⇒ node hian plaintext keyword a hmu ngai lo
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/privacy/erase (mahni rawngbawlna) .
  UPDATE hmangtute SET username='delete-'||id, phone=NULL, email=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE message SET ciphertext=NULL WHERE thawntu_id=$u
  DELETE FROM files WHERE uploaded_by=$u
  gossip {thilthleng:"erasure", user_id, sig:Ed25519(release_priv, thilthleng)}

VORTEX logo-ah ≥ 5 s rei tak hmet la:
  confirm dialog a ni
  on confirm hunah:
    Keychain.deleteAll(a hmasa ber="vortex.") a ni.
    UserDefaults.removeObject(Key atan: "vortex.*") tih a ni.
    SQLite vortex.db DROP zawng zawng table
