debugging.title: Debugging leh diagnostics te a awm bawk
debugging.subtitle: Dev, staging, leh prod-a issue awmte track down na tur tools.
debugging.intro: Subsystem tin hian logging structured leh /metrics surface an nei vek a. Hetah hian diagnosis playbook hman thin chu kan rawn tarlang e.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-structured a ni. `logger.info("action", extra={"user_id": ...})` hian `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"action", "user_id": ...}` a siam chhuak a.
debugging.h1p2: 100 MB-ah rotate rawh; 14 gens gzipped a awm tur a ni.
debugging.h1p3: Module khata level chu `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` (e.g. `LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG`) hmangin a ni.
debugging.h1p4: Correlation id: request tin hian `X-Request-Id` an dawng vek a; downstream RPC te chuan an hmang leh thin.
debugging.h2p1: Prometheus format chu `/metrics`-ah (prod-ah admin-a authenticated a ni).
debugging.h2p2: RED: kawng khata rate / tihsual / hun chhung.
debugging.h2p3: USE: DB pool khatah hman dan / saturation / tihsual, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Custom: active room, message/s, stealth-level histogram te a awm bawk.
debugging.h3p1: Runtime sampling atan `py-spy` tih a ni. Running node PID ah attach rawh.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` tih hi heap profiling atan hman a ni. Minute 1 chhunga snapshot-ah leak a awm nghal vat.
debugging.h3p3: Rust extension `vortex_chat` hian flamegraph nena inmil trace ziaktu `--profile` flag a export a.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` hian local node lakah register/login/send/receive/logout a kalpui thin. Eng thil pawh a hlawhchham chuan non-zero-in a chhuak.
debugging.h4p2: CI hian PR tin ah meikhu a run bakah merges to main ah pawh a run thin.
debugging.h4p3: Production smoke: pawn lam probe hian minute khatah vawi khat canary account a hit thin.
debugging.h1_a: Logs hi default-in JSON-structured a ni. Log line tin hian ts, level, module, message, leh correlation id te a keng tel vek a.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("user_siam", extra={"user_id": u.id})` hian `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"user_siam", "user_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}` tih a ni. Correlation id hi `X-Request-Id` header atanga lo chhuak a ni a; downstream RPC apiangin an hmang leh thin. 100 MB-ah rotation a ni a; thlah 14 gzipped-a awm reng tur. Level per-module chu `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` hmangin a ni.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging hi tuna inremna awm mek a ni — Stripe, Datadog, tunlai observability vendor zawng zawngte chuan an pawm a ni. Correlation ID te hian X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) thlengin an trace a, Jaeger / Zipkin (2015) kaltlangin microservices-ah canonical an ni ta a ni. Vortex hian distributed trace ai chuan header-propagated correlation id awlsam tak a hmang a, a chhan chu distributed-trace tooling hian kan la mamawh loh complexity a belhchhah a ni.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metrics chu `/metrics` (production-a admin-a authenticated) ah a awm. Grafana dashboard te chu `deploy/grafana/` ah an thawn chhuak thin.
debugging.h2_b: RED metrics per-route: dilna rate, tihsual rate, hun chhung histogram. USE metrics per-resource: DB pool hman dan, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwidth. Custom: active room, second khata message thawn, stealth-level histogram. `/admin/metrics`-a Admin dashboard-ah hian chart chungnung ber berte a lang a; Prometheus chuan history kimchang a scraping a.
debugging.h2_c: RED (rate / errors / duration) hi Weaveworks-in kum 2016 a acronym a siam a ni. USE (utilisation / saturation / errors) tih hi Brendan Gregg-a’n kum 2013-a a hman dan a ni. An pahnih hian service-level leh resource-level signal te an cover dun a ni. Kum 2016 atang khan Prometheus + Grafana hi open-source default a ni tawh a.
debugging.h3_a: Runtime sample lakna atan `py-spy`; `memray` hi heap snapshot te tan a ni; `vortex_chat` Rust extension hian flamegraph trace te tan `--profile` a nei a.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` hian 60 s chhung chu flamegraph SVG a siam a, chutah chuan hot Python stack a lang. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` hian allocation te a track a; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` tih a ni. Rust extension hian `--profile` hmanga invoke a nih chuan internal profile te chu Chrome-tracing JSON angin a export thin. Heng zinga eng pawh hi `scripts/smoke/all.sh` kaltlanga load-test kalpui nen pair la, shape inang lo tak tak a awm theih nan.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) hi non-intrusive statistical profiler a ni a, code thlak danglam ngai lovin Python process kal laiah a attached a — Python profiler-te Go a ni. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) hi tunlai Python heap profiler tha ber a ni. Rust-a ngei pawhin a profiling ecosystem chu a puitling a, mahse a inzawm tlat lo; kan extension hian Chrome-tracing hi a export bik a, a chhan chu browser tin hian viewer built in an nei vek a ni.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` tih hian local node pakhatah register/login/send/receive/logout tih a hmang thin. CI hian PR apiangin a run thin.

Eng thil pawh a hlawhchham chuan non-zero-in a chhuak. CI hian post-build-ah a invoke thin. testing.title: Test dan tur ruahmanna siam a ni
testing.subtitle: Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS te inkarah 29 k line test a ni.
testing.intro: Layer tin hian test suite an nei vek a. CI hian minute 10 hnuai lam chhungin a tlan vek.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` hian router, security, transport, bots te a huam a ni.
testing.h1p2: Hypothesis property-based tests on crypto: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` chu random m 1000 chhung atan.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz on WAF: input dik lo maktaduai tam tak — 5xx leak a awm lo tih a sawi.
testing.h2p1: `ios/Modules/`-a `swift test` hian RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 test vectors te nen unit test a kalpui thin.
testing.h2p2: XCUI tests hian SwiftUI views chu headless simulator-ah a khalh a; snapshot-a tehkhin a ni.
testing.h3p1: `./gradlew test` hian JVM-chauh test (fast) a kalpui thin.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` hian emulator kal laiah instrumented test a kalpui thin.
testing.h4p1: Playwright hian web client a khalh a, lu nei lo Chrome + lu nei lo Firefox. Call te hi `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` hmanga exercise a ni.
testing.h4p2: Scenarios: account pahnih register → DM → file thawn → delete → verify sync → tawp.
testing.h1_a: Python test-ah hian pytest + coverage hman a ni. Router tin, security primitive tin, transport module tin hian test an nei vek a. ~80 % cover a ni.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` hian core pakhatah minute 2 hnuai lam chhungin full suite a run thei. Hypothesis property-based tests on crypto primitives: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` chu random message 1000 tan a ni. AFL-style fuzz tests on the WAF: inputs malformed maktaduai tam tak chuan 4xx (5xx ni lo) response a siam tih an sawi. `pytest --cov=app` hmanga coverage a awm theih nan.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) hi de-facto Python test tlantu a ni. Property-based testing atana Hypothesis (2015) chuan QuickCheck ngaihtuahna chu Haskell atangin a port a. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) chu fuzz tan chuan canonical coverage-guided fuzzer a ni. Vortex-a stack hi mainstream a ni a; flavor awm chhun chu test-class inheritance aiin pytest parametrisation kan duh zawk hi a ni.
testing.h2_a: `ios/Modules/`-a Swift test hian crypto primitives te chu RFC test vectors te bakah SwiftUI snapshot test te nen a huam a ni.
testing.h2_b: `ios/Modules/` atanga `swift test` hian unit test chu 1 s hnuai lamah a kalpui thin. RFC 7748 (X25519) vek a ni. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ah hian a awm a. RFC 5869 (HKDF) vek a ni. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) a ni. SwiftUI preview snapshot te chu image diff hmanga git-tracked baseline nen khaikhin a ni a; pixel eng pawhah regression a awm chuan build a fail thin.
testing.h2_c: Official test vectors nena crypto test hi bulletproof practice ber a ni — i code hi RFC vectors nen a inmil a nih chuan a awmziaah chuan a inmil a ni. SwiftUI tana snapshot testing hi ~2022 state of the art a ni a, pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing hmangin a lar hle. Vortex hian dependency a awm loh nan minimal in-house version a hmang a.
testing.h3_a: Kotlin test: JVM-chu `./gradlew test` hmangin chauh; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` chu emulator kal lai a ni.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` hi second tlemte chhungin a kal thei — Android framework a ngai lo, JUnit + Hilt-android-testing chauh a ni. Unit-test target: crypto, presenter, coroutine-a innghat flow te. `./gradlew connectedCheck` hian emulator a spin up a, app chu a install a, Espresso hmangin UI test a run bawk. E2E a luang chhuak: login → message thawn → chat-ah en rawh.
testing.h3_c: JVM-only test leh instrumented test thliar hran hi Android 2019+ convention a ni. JVM test hi a rang (second) a ni a; instrumented test te hi a slow (minute) a ni. Robolectric (2014) hian he inthlauhna hi a titawp thin a, mahse tunlai Android development-ah hian he inthenna hian nasa takin a thlak ta a ni.
testing.h4_a: Playwright hian web client chu headless Chrome leh Firefox hmangin a khalh a, real register → DM → call flows a exercise thin.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` hian TypeScript ah scenario a keng tel a. Test session khatah throwaway node + Postgres chu docker compose hmangin spun up a ni. Test hian web UI a khalh a: account pahnih register la, DM hawng la, message thawn la, delivery verify la, `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` flag hmangin video call siam la, chutiang chuan Chrome hian synthetic audio/video a siam chhuak thei a ni. Scenario-te chu Playwright hnathawkte kaltlangin parallel-in a kal a.
testing.h4_c: Playwright (Microsoft, 2020) chuan web E2E testing tam zawkah Selenium a thlak a, a chhan chu a rang zawk a, a rintlak zawk a, debugging a nei tha zawk bawk. WebRTC headless browser-a testing chu Chrome 69-in fake-device flag a dah belh hma chuan pain point a ni a; chuta tang chuan standard practice a lo ni ta a ni.

- `admin` — JWT a claim-ah `is_admin: true` tih a awm.

members.h1_b: He route atana handler hi `app/` hnuaia module inmil ah a awm a. Path pattern `/api/rooms/{id}/members` chu `@router.get('/api/rooms/{id}/members')` hmanga puan a ni.
members.h1_c: `Members` theihna angin Vortex release hmasa berah thawn chhuah a ni.
members.h2_a: A mamawh: **jwt**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` hian he route hi a gate a, a mamawh credential a awm loh emaw, a dik lo emaw a nih chuan `401 unauthenticated` hmangin a hnawl thin.
members.h2_b:
- `none` — tihdik loh (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT access token chu `Authorization` header-ah a awm a.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT tihthar lehna token.
- `admin` — JWT a claim-ah `is_admin: true` tih a awm.
- `peer-signed` — request body chu peer rintlak Ed25519 key hmanga sign a ni.
members.h2_c: Auth tier hian least privilege principle a lantir a: pre-login endpoints chu account siam leh recovery-ah khauh takin tihkhawtlai a ni a; JWT hnung lama thil awm zawng zawng hian user tak tak a hmu a; admin endpoints ah hian UI ah badge a awm avangin hman dik loh chu hmuh theih a ni.
members.h5_a: Standard Vortex tihsual envelope `{tisual, dinhmun, kawng}`. Credential tha lo chungchangah `401` a awm a; `403` chu chanvo tling lo chungchangah; `422` tihdik a nih chuan; Rate limit-ah `429` a awm a; `5xx` chu chhungril lama tihsual a awm.

resumeInit.h1_a: `{file hming, size, chunk_size_hint}` a pawm a; `{upload_id, chunk_size}` a rawn pe leh ang. Upload_id TTL chu 24 h a ni.
resumeInit.h1_b: He route atana handler hi `app/` hnuaia module inmil ah a awm a. Path pattern `/api/files/resumable/init` chu `@router.post('/api/files/resumable/init')` hmangin declare a ni.
resumeInit.h1_c: `init` theihna pakhat angin Vortex release hmasa berah thawn chhuah a ni.
resumeInit.h2_a: A mamawh: **jwt**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` hian he route hi a gate a, a mamawh credential a awm loh emaw, a dik lo emaw a nih chuan `401 unauthenticated` hmangin a hnawl thin.

- `none` — tihdik loh (pre-login).

- `peer-signed` — request body chu peer rintlak Ed25519 key hmanga sign a ni.

push.intro: Client te hian device khatah vawi khat an register thin. Payload te hi recipient-specific X25519 pubkey hmanga sealed a nih avangin push provider chuan opaque blob chauh a hmu thin.

subscribe.title: POST /api/push/subscribe theih a ni
subscribe.subtitle: Push atan device register rawh
subscribe.intro: subscribe — auth: **jwt** tih hi a ni.
subscribe.h1_a: Upserts `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, a hnuhnung ber_refreshed_at)`. Client te hian app launch apiangin an subscribe leh thin.
subscribe.h1_b: He route atana handler hi `app/` hnuaia module inmil ah a awm a. Path pattern `/api/push/subscribe` chu `@router.post('/api/push/subscribe')` hmangin declare a ni.
subscribe.h1_c: `subscribe` theihna pakhat angin Vortex release hmasa berah thawn chhuah a ni.
subscribe.h2_a: A mamawh: **jwt**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` hian he route hi a gate a, a mamawh credential a awm loh emaw, a dik lo emaw a nih chuan `401 unauthenticated` hmangin a hnawl thin.
subscribe.h2_b:
- `none` — tihdik loh (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT access token chu `Authorization` header-ah a awm a.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT tihthar lehna token.
- `admin` — JWT a claim-ah `is_admin: true` tih a awm.
- `peer-signed` — request body chu peer rintlak Ed25519 key hmanga sign a ni.
subscribe.h2_c: Auth tier hian least privilege principle a lantir a: pre-login endpoints chu account siam leh recovery-ah khauh takin tihkhawtlai a ni a; JWT hnung lama thil awm zawng zawng hian user tak tak a hmu a; admin endpoints ah hian UI ah badge a awm avangin hman dik loh chu hmuh theih a ni.
subscribe.h5_a: Standard Vortex tihsual envelope `{tisual, dinhmun, kawng}`. Credential tha lo chungchangah `401` a awm a; `403` chu chanvo tling lo chungchangah; `422` tihdik a nih chuan; Rate limit-ah `429` a awm a; `5xx` chu chhungril lama tihsual a awm.
subscribe.h5_f:
401 tihdik loh token bo/dik lo
403 khap tlat, chanvo tling lo
422 validation_error field tihkhawtlai a ni
429 rate_limited a tum tam lutuk
500 internal_error beisei loh server fault a awm
subscribe.h6_f:
curl -X POST 'https://node.example/api/push/subscribe' \ tih hi a awm lo.
  -H 'Content-Type: hmanna/json' \
  -H 'Thihna: Bearer $TOKEN' tih a ni.

roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — vantlang hriata tihchhuah vawi hnihna. Kyber PQ on by default, Variant-B hmanga public room lian zawk, Tauri desktop package, open bot marketplace te a awm bawk.

roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 hi primitive thar siam ai chuan primitive awm tawhte scale out a ni. Kyber hi roadmap-ah a awm reng a; default-a switch chu load hnuaia stability-ah a innghat. Electron aiin Tauri hi thlan a ni a, a chhan chu bundle hi ~5 MB vs ~150 MB a nih vang a ni. Bot marketplace public submissions chu review infrastructure-ah block a ni a, chu chu v0.1-ah a tla thla a ni.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — group-a kohna. SFU-a innghat audio group 100 thleng; video group 32 thleng siam theih a ni a; adaptive simulcast hmanga tihchhuah a ni.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU chu performance atan Rust ah kalpui a ni. Audio atan Opus DTX + FEC + a ruala tihchhuah theih a ni. VP9 L1/L2/L3 video atan simulcast a awm a, reported downlink atanga thlirin SFU picking per-viewer layer a awm bawk. Per-participant mute leh kick atanga UI. Call recording (consent-gated, off by default) chu encrypted-a dah a ni a, per-call root key hnuaiah a telte zingah a insem a ni.
roadmap.h2_c: Group call hi v0.1 beta atanga thil dil tam ber pakhat a ni. SFU design hian Jitsi Videobridge + Janus pattern a zawm a ni. Rust implementation ai chuan mediasoup hman nawn leh ai chuan mediasoup-a Node.js runtime hian hot path-ah kan duh loh latency a belhchhah a ni.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — thawhhona canvas. Miro-style shared board chu CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) aia tam messaging layer awmsa kaltlangin.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT room message awm tawhte chu document sync piggybacks a ni. Board edit tin hi CRDT operation CBOR anga serialized, room key hmanga encrypted, `kind:"board_op"` message anga post a ni. Client te chuan deserialise, apply, render te an ti thin. `kind:"board_cursor"` message type hran hmanga real-time cursor awmna. Client-side canvas rendering hmangin PNG / SVG / PDF ah export theih a ni.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) te chu Yjs te nen chuan production-viable an lo ni ta a ni (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma hian an thawhhona hi custom CRDT ang chi structure-ah an siam lar hle. WebSocket channel hran siam ai chuan kan encrypted message layer hi hman nawn leh tumna hi principle pakhat atanga lo chhuak a ni: transport path tlem zawk, bug tlem zawk.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — pawisa pek chhuah. On-chain escrow (Solana + EVM) + Stripe Connect kaltlangin fiat on/off ramp hmanga siam a ni.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot lei tur hian on-chain escrow contract hmangin a lei thin. Buyer chuan a pawm a; 24 h chhungin a holdback a; tichuan funds release to seller minus 10 % platform fee a ni. Inhnialna chu staking hmanga thlan chhuah community arbiter-te hnenah a kal ṭhin. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect accounts operator pakhat emaw bot seller pakhat emaw; off-ramp: bank-a direct-a transfer emaw USDC settlement emaw. Crypto support: Solana leh Ethereum-ah te pawh SOL, USDC, USDT.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart contract hi a hlui tawh (OpenBazaar 2016) mahse UX lamah chuan a sir vel chu a la rough hle. Vortex hian a complexity chu a rochun a, mahse a tam zawk chu a thup a — lei duhtute chuan "buy" button hriat lar tak an hmu thin. Platform fee 10 % hi App Store convention nen a inmil a (Apple hian 30 % a la a nih pawhin); lower cut hi thil zuartute hip nan tumruh taka tih a ni.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — dinhmun nghet tak. Security audit, platform zawng zawngah reproducible build, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5_b: Third-party audit scheduled pre-1.0 freeze — sumdawnna quote atanga chhut chuan Trail of Bits emaw NCC Group emaw a nih a rinawm. Reproducible builds tih awmzia chu source tree khat hian build machine pahnih eng pawhah bit-identical binary a siam chhuak tihna a ni; hei hian supply-chain tampering a hmuchhuak a ni. SemVer frozen tih awmzia chu wire protocol, storage schema, leh public SDK surface te hian 1.x chhungin backward-compat guarantee an hmu tihna a ni. Bug bounty program chu node-a remote code execution atan $25k top tier nen a intan a.

aead.title: AEAD a ni.
aead.subtitle: Associated Data hmanga Encryption tihdik a ni.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) hi cryptographic primitive a ni a, call pakhatah thuruk leh dikna a inzawm khawm a ni. Key, nonce, plaintext, leh optional associated data (AAD) pek a nih chuan ciphertext + authentication tag a siam chhuak a, chutiang chuan plaintext, ciphertext, emaw AAD emaw tihdanglamna eng pawh chu verification a hlawhchham thei a ni.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) hi cryptographic primitive a ni a, call pakhatah thuruk leh dikna a inzawm khawm a ni. Key, nonce, plaintext, leh optional associated data (AAD) pek a nih chuan ciphertext + authentication tag a siam chhuak a, chutiang chuan plaintext, ciphertext, emaw AAD emaw tihdanglamna eng pawh chu verification a hlawhchham thei a ni.
aead.h1_b: Vortex te AEAD hi AES-256-GCM a ni reng a. AAD slot hian context dik tak a decrypt theih nan a dawngtuin a hriat tur (room id, file id, offset) a keng tel a ni. Binding AAD hian cross-context replay a veng a — room A atanga ciphertext lo chhuak chu room B angin decrypt theih a ni lo.
aead.h1_c: AEAD as a named primitive traces to Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) chu SP 800-38D (2007) ah NIST hmangin standardized a ni. TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018) ah chuan default AEAD a lo ni ta a ni. Tunlai secure protocol zawng zawng hian AEAD an hmang vek a.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len(pt) byte, tag = 16 byte a ni
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt emaw ⊥ emaw a ni

aead.h3_a: AES-GCM, HKDF, vawi khat lo, tag

argon2id.intro: Argon2id hi memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing function a ni a, a hman dan tur pawh a inang lo hle. Parameters: memory size (m), hun senso (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), leh hash sei zawng te. ‘id’ variant hian data-independent (Argon2i) leh data-dependent (Argon2d) pass te a mix a.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id hi memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing function a ni a, a hman dan tur pawh a inang lo hle. Parameters: memory size (m), hun senso (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), leh hash sei zawng te. ‘id’ variant hian data-independent (Argon2i) leh data-dependent (Argon2d) pass te a mix a.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex hian Argon2id a hmang a, m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32 te a hmang bawk. Hei hian iPhone X (kan supported device slow ber) ah ~0.5 s a la a, high-end ASIC ah chuan roughly 5 ms a hmang bawk — 100× speedup hi SHA-256-based hashes nena khaikhin chuan a tlem hle a, ASICs te hian maktaduai tam takin hnehna an chang.
argon2id.h1_c: Kum 2015-a Dmitry Khovratovich leh Alex Biryukov-te buatsaih Password Hashing Competition-ah Argon2 hian hnehna a chang. Kum 2021 khan RFC 9106 tia standardized a ni a, 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass te hman a ni. Vortex-a parameters hi OWASP 2023 recommendation atanga lo chhuak a ni.

blake3.title: BLAKE3 a ni.
blake3.subtitle: Cryptographic hash chak tak a ni.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 hi BLAKE2 leh BLAKE atanga lo chhuak cryptographic hash function a ni. Input duh duh atanga arbitrary-length output a siam chhuak a; Blob lian tak takah SHA-256 aiin 10× a chak zawk a, hei hi internal tree hashing vang a ni.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 hi BLAKE2 leh BLAKE atanga lo chhuak cryptographic hash function a ni. Input duh duh atanga arbitrary-length output a siam chhuak a; Blob lian tak takah SHA-256 aiin 10× a chak zawk a, hei hi internal tree hashing vang a ni.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex hian file integrity atan BLAKE3 a hmang a: file upload tin hian a decrypted content `plain_blake3` hash a keng tel a, chuvangin a dawngtu te chuan download + decrypt hnuah an verify thei a ni. DB column hi historically chuan migration compatibility atan `sha256` tih a ni a, mahse BLAKE3 output a awm thung.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 hi Jack O’Connor leh a thawhpuiten an tichhuak a ni. in 2020. BLAKE atanga lo piang a ni a, kum 2012 khan SHA-3 finalist a ni a, tree-hashing design hian BLAKE3 chu core hmangin input lian tak tak atan a scale thei a ni. SHA-256 hi input tenau tan chuan a la chak zawk a; BLAKE3 hian eng thil pawh > 4 KiB ah a thunun.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // default output a ni
BLAKE3(byte, len) = len byte (XOF) a ni.
throughput: ~3 GB/s on Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s

bmp.title: BMP a ni.
bmp.subtitle: Mitdel Mailbox Protocol a ni.
bmp.intro: BMP hi Vortex-a hming hriat loh store-and-forward layer a ni. Sender-te chuan gossip-enabled node eng pawhah encrypted blob an deposit a, chu chu a dawngtu pubkey-a one-way hash hmanga keyed a ni. Blobs hian gossip a ride a, a dawngtu node a pull thlengin.
bmp.h1_a: BMP hi Vortex-a hming hriat loh store-and-forward layer a ni. Sender-te chuan gossip-enabled node eng pawhah encrypted blob an deposit a, chu chu a dawngtu pubkey-a one-way hash hmanga keyed a ni. Blobs hian gossip a ride a, a dawngtu node a pull thlengin.
bmp.h1_b: BMP hian independent privacy property pathum a pe a, chungte chu sender-hiding (TLS + optional onion), recipient-hiding (mailbox_id hi middle node-ah opaque a ni), content-hiding (blob hi E2E-encrypted a ni tawh). Max blob 1 MB, node khata cap 500 MB, deposit rate 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP hi Vortex team te chuan a bul atanga design a ni. Kan siam chhan chu mainstream messenger tumahin metadata end-to-end thup engineering cost an pek duh loh vang a ni — content an encrypt a, mahse social graph an leak thung. Ni khatna atang khan kan dinhmun chu who-talks-to-whom leak tu secure messenger chu a chanve chauh secure a ni tih hi a ni. BMP chuan chu chanve chu a khar a, sender, recipient leh content te chu independent taka opaque-ah siamin, bolted-on infrastructure aiin Vortex-a gossip mesh-ah a siam a ni.

vapid.title: VAPID a ni.
vapid.subtitle: Voluntary Application Server hriat theihna (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID hi application server pakhatin Web Push provider te hnena a inhriat chian nan Ed25519 key pahnih a ni. Web Push deployment atana "tuin nge push thawn phal" tih zawhna chu a ti bo.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID hi application server pakhatin Web Push provider te hnena a inhriat chian nan Ed25519 key pahnih a ni. Web Push deployment atana "tuin nge push thawn phal" tih zawhna chu a ti bo.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex-a web client chuan node-a VAPID public key hmangin Web Push a subscribe thin. Payload te hi subscription khatah sealed-push key (p256dh) hran hmanga encrypt a ni. Rotation: VAPID key hi a dam rei a, mahse signed payload te hian JWT-style expiry tawi an nei thung.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID hi kum 2017 khan RFC 8292 tiin standardized a ni a, VAPID hma khan Web Push hian FCM-brokered subscription emaw auth mechanism hran emaw a mamawh a ni. VAPID hian self-hosted deployment a ti awlsam a — Firebase project a ngai lo.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, controller `/v1/health` kaltlangin tihchhuah a ni a, natna hriatchhuahna atan tihchhuah a ni.
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, sealed push, Ed25519, JWT tih a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.

waf.title: WAF a ni.
waf.subtitle: Web Application Firewall hmanga siam a ni.
waf.intro: A WAF chu middleware a ni a, HTTP request te chu a enfiah a, thil tha lo hriat tawh (SQL injection, path traversal, template injection) te chu application code an thlen hmain a block thin.
waf.h1_a: A WAF chu middleware a ni a, HTTP request te chu a enfiah a, thil tha lo hriat tawh (SQL injection, path traversal, template injection) te chu application code an thlen hmain a block thin.
waf.h1_b: Vortex-a WAF hi `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` angin a kal a ni. ~50 regex checks against URL, zawhna, taksa. `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`, hriat lar XSS pattern te chu block a ni. Tin, global rate limit (1000 req/s), per-route limit (login 10/min, register 5/min), per-user limit te pawh a tihlawhtling bawk.
waf.h1_c: WAFs te hi mod_security (2002) atanga siam a ni. Cloudflare-a WAF (2014) chuan pattern chu commoditised a ni. Tunlai web framework zawng zawng hian default set of check an thawn chhuak vek a. Vortex-a regex list hi OWASP Top 10 signatures atanga siam a ni.
waf.h1_f:
dilna apiangah:
  SQLI_PATTERNS-a pattern atan: pattern.search(url + query + body): hnawl a nih chuan
  TRAVERSAL-a pattern atan: pattern.search(url): hnawl a nih chuan
  TEMPLATE-a pattern atan: pattern.search(body): hnawl a nih chuan
rate-limit chu (IP, kawng, user_id) hmanga keyed a ni.
waf.h3_a: rate tihtlem, audit log, OWASP, SQL injection te a ni

x25519.title: X25519 a ni.
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman chu Curve25519 (RFC 7748) chungah a awm.
x25519.intro: X25519 hi a Montgomery angin Curve25519 aiin elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman a ni. 32-byte private leh public key, 32-byte shared secret a ni. Key agreement atan hman a ni.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 hi a Montgomery angin Curve25519 aiin elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman a ni. 32-byte private leh public key, 32-byte shared secret a ni. Key agreement atan hman a ni.
x25519.h1_b: Static device identity tin, ephemeral session key tin, Vortex-a sealed-push subscription tin hian X25519 a hmang vek. Montgomery-ladder implementation hi constant-time a ni a, curve hmasa zawkte tibuaitu side-channel attack class lakah a him lo.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 hi Bernstein (2005)-a tihchhuah a ni a; standardized as RFC 7748 (2016) a ni a, DH variant atan X25519 tih hming a ni. Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (post-quantum hybrid) te hman a ni. Tunlai applied cryptography-ah hmun tinah a awm.
x25519.h1_f:
private key: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 byte tlem-endian, clamped)
public key: A = a · G (32-byte compressed point) a ni a, a chhuahna tur hmun leh a hmanna tur hmun chu a inthlau hle.
shared: s = a · B = b · A (Byte 32, → HKDF input) a ni.
performance: iPhone 11-ah DH khatah ~100 μs a ni
x25519.h2_a: `app/security/crypto.py::x25519_shared_secret`, iOS `VortexCrypto.X25519KeyAgreement`, Android `crypto/dh/X25519KeyAgreement` tih te hi a ni.
x25519.h3_a: Ed25519, HKDF, Curve25519, Signal protocol hmanga siam a ni

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out chhungril lam
websocketFanout.subtitle: Node pakhatin subscriber sang tam tak hnena event a thlen dan.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out hi room khatah subscriber handle Python-native set a ni. Message POST a nih chuan fan-out dispatcher chuan set chu a iterate a, subscriber tinte send queue-ah serialized frame a enqueue thin.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out hian broadcasting-a N-copy cost a pumpelh a: sender lam atanga decryption pakhat, serialized frame pakhat, send-queue push N. Push tin hi O(1) a ni a; copy cost chu OS-in a support laiin zero-copy buffers hmangin `send()` time-ah kernel-ah pushed a ni.
websocketFanout.where: `app/chats/fanout.py` ah implement a ni. Top-level `FanoutRegistry` ah hian `dict[room_id, set[WebSocket]]` a awm a. Registry ziah te hi `asyncio.Lock` hmanga ven a ni a; reads te hi lock-free snapshot a ni.
websocketFanout.how: Message POST ah chuan router chuan `await fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)` a ti a. Method hian lock hnuaia set chu a copy a, a release a, chutah chuan `ws.send_bytes(payload)` nghaktu copy chu socket khatah second 1 timeout hmangin a iterate leh a ni. Timed-out socket-ah chuan a chhe tih mark a ni a, purged a ni.
websocketFanout.when: Message, reaction, read-receipt, typing indicator, call signal, leh room key rotation zawng zawng hi he fan-out vek hmang hian a luang chhuak vek a ni. Frame size hi 64 KiB-ah bounded a ni a; payload lian zawk chu hnawl a ni a, HTTP hmangin caller hnenah a thawn kir leh thin.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — subscriber pakhatin queue thuk zawng a thawn. Overflow hian frame hlui ber a ti tla.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — `send_bytes`-a chunglam bound. A aia tam chuan socket a chhe tih a mark.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — hei aia room lian zawkah hian fan-out a duh lo. Room lian tak takah chuan channel mode leh pull pattern an hmang zawk a ni.
websocketFanout.fail1: Consumer slow — socket khata queue a luang chhuak. Frame hlui ber berte chu a tla thla. Client chuan reconnect-ah `since` hmangin a man thei.
websocketFanout.fail2: Socket thi — `send_bytes` chuan `ConnectionClosed` a tisang a. Dispatcher chuan set atang chuan a remove a, a kal zel.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer — producer chu aggregate consumer bandwidth aiin > 5× a chak zawk a nih chuan back-pressure a kick in via `await` suspend the sender.
websocketFanout.fail4: Memory blow-up — subscriber pakhat tan queue chu frame 256-ah capped a ni a; at 64 KiB each chu chu slow consumer pakhatah 16 MiB max a ni. Consumer tlanbo chuan chu ceiling a rawn hit hmain liveness check hmangin a disconnect ang.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{room,user}` — socket khata queue thuk zawng.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — a chhan (overflow, timeout, khar) avanga frame tlak.
websocketFanout.mon3: Histogram `vortex_fanout_send_duration_seconds` — latency sem dan thawn chhuah.
websocketFanout.tune1: Network slow-but-stable-a client-te tan `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` tihsan rawh.
websocketFanout.tune2: Slow socket-in midang a riltamna hmuna high-contention cluster-ah `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` tihhniam rawh.
websocketFanout.tune3: Room lian tak tak chu sub-room-ah then la, pull-based update hmangin channel mode-ah thlak rawh.
websocketFanout.edge1: Room rotation event (`type:"k"`) te hi 1 s ni lovin 2 s timeout hmanga thawn a ni a, a chhan chu client te hian message tam zawk an pawm hmain key an import leh a ngai a ni.
websocketFanout.edge2: Typing events hi tih nawn leh a ni lo — "user stopped typing" hloh chu a hlauhawm lo.
websocketFanout.edge3: Presence updates hi batched a ni: 250 ms window khata user presence flip tam tak chu frame khatah coalesced a ni.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 chu room khata hman `asyncio.Queue`s — v0.0.5-ah chuan per-message CPU hniam zawk atan lock-copy-iterate pattern hmangin thlak a ni.
websocketFanout.mig2: Future: Redis a awm hunah fan-out hian pub/sub a duh zawk dawn avangin multi-node clusters te hian mesh fan-out tel lovin events an replicate thin.
websocketFanout.ts1: Drop rate sang: consumer slow hnenah network check; bump queue lian leh te; client thiltih dan chhui chian.
websocketFanout.ts2: Send hun chhung sang: TLS renegotiation kalpui mek emaw, NAT traversal timeout emaw a nih a rinawm; kernel logs ah TCP retransmission awm leh awm loh enfiah rawh.
websocketFanout.ts3: Memory creep: user pakhatin `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` chu enfiah thin ang che; persistent depth > 200 nei user tu pawh chu client slow emaw malicious emaw awm thei angin mark rawh.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Disconnect laiin client-in frame a miss chuan eng nge thleng? A: `since=<last_seen_id>` nen a inzawm leh a, server chu DB atang hian a replay leh thin. Fan-out hi best-effort real-time a ni a; durability chu DB ah a nung.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Subscriber tha lo tak chuan fan-out a ti slow thei em? A: Anmahni queue an ti slow a, chu chuan frame a fill a, a drop a, a disconnect bawk. Cross-subscriber inkara inrawlhna a awm lo.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Engtin nge user bik delivery hi ka debug theih ang? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` hian an queue depth, last send timestamp, leh tun hnaia drop te chu an dump thin.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce management a ni lo
nonceManagement.subtitle: Vortex hian device, room leh reboot hrang hrangah AES-GCM nonces te chu a danglam bikna a siam dan.
nonceManagement.what: AES-GCM operation tin hian 12-byte nonce a la a, chu chu MUST chu key pek tawh tan a danglam bik a ni. Key inang hmanga nonce hman nawn leh hian thuruk leh dikna a tichhe vek — attacker pakhat hnuaia ciphertext pahnih (key, nonce) nei chuan plaintext XOR chu a la let leh thei a ni.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex hian room key pakhat a siam a, message sang tam tak atan a hmang thin. Message pahnih atanga compromised nonce chuan plaintext a leak ang. Chuvangin nonce zawng zawng hi OS CSPRNG hmangin bit 96-ah siam a ni — birthday-bound-safe region hi key khatah message 2^32 vel a ni a, key pakhatin a encrypt theih aia tam a ni.
nonceManagement.where: Client-side nonce generation hi `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node) ah a nung a ni. Node hian defensive duplicate-nonce check a kalpui bawk.
nonceManagement.how: Step-by-step: client hian random byte 12 a siam a, AES-GCM encrypt-ah a pass a, ciphertext chu `{ciphertext, nonce}` leh POST angin a frame a. Node hian in-memory LRU cache-ah `(room_id, nonce)` a record a, chu chu entry 10^6-a lian a ni. POST ah chuan node chuan cache chu a check thin — duplicate ⇒ 400 `duplicate_nonce`. Usage pangngai hnuaiah chuan hei hi a fire ngai lo (P(collision) at 10^9 messages is ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: On send apiangah. Receiver-side: nonce check a awm lo — AES-GCM-a tag hian integrity a handle. Engtin emaw takin nonce a repeat leh a nih chuan second decrypt chu a la hlawhtling tho ang mahse confidentiality chu a tichhe dawn a ni.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — node khata tun hnaia nonce track zat.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — entry hlui zawkte chu 24 h hnuah evicted (key tam zawk hi engtin pawhin darkar chhungin an rotate).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG client-a hlawhchhamna — OS-in a pek CSPRNG nen chuan a rinawm loh hle. Cryptographic ni lo RNG-ah kan tlu leh ngai lo.
nonceManagement.fail2: Node restart-a cache miss — cache hi defence-in-depth a nih avangin pawm theih; clients te hian nonces hi legitimate takin an hmang leh ngai lo va chuvang chuan miss hian attack window a hawng lo.
nonceManagement.mon1: Counter `vortex_nonce_duplicates_total{room}` — chu zero-ah a awm tur a ni.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — chu cache cap vel ah a nghet tur a ni.
nonceManagement.tune1: Room lian tak tak: rotation window sei zawk cover turin cache size tihpun.
nonceManagement.tune2: Multi-node clusters: a awm hunah Redis kaltlangin cache chu an share thin.
nonceManagement.edge1: Offline client re-connecting with queueed messages: queueed message tin hian anmahni random nonce an keng tel vek a. Coordination a ngai lo.
nonceManagement.edge2: Multi-device send: device pahnih hian independent random nonces an siam chhuak thin. Device 2 × message 10^4-a P(collision) = a tlem hle.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 hian hun rei vak lo chhung chu counter-based nonces seeded with device id a hmang a — paper pakhatin clock-skew hnuaia cross-device collision a lantir hnuah hman loh a ni. Tunah chuan Random-96 chu malsawmna kawng awmchhun a ni ta.
nonceManagement.ts1: `duplicate_nonce` rejections en rawh: client chu buggy RNG a awm leh awm loh enfiah rawh; device entropy source enfiah rawh.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: room write rate nen cache size enfiah; size tihsan emaw, tihhniam emaw TTL emaw.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Client pahnih in nonce inang chu accident-in an pick a nih chuan engtin nge ni ang? A: Randomness bit 96-ah chuan user zawng zawng zingah first collision beisei chu ~2^48 message-ah a ni — Vortex hmanna dam chhung tam tak. Chutiang a nih chuan node chuan a pahnihna chu a hnawl ang.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Engvangin nge 96 bits leh 128 ni lo? A: AES-GCM-a standard nonce sei zawng. 96 bits hian message khatah byte 4 a save bawk.

keyRotation.title: Key rotation a ni
keyRotation.subtitle: Room, device leh release key te chu engtikah nge a roll over a, engtin nge a roll over thin.
keyRotation.what: Vortex-a key dam rei zawng zawng hi schedule emaw trigger-ah emaw a rotate vek a ni. Membership inthlak hunah emaw, a hun hunah (kar tin) room key hi a inthlak thin. Device key te hi user duhthlan danah a rotate thin. Release keys te hi compromise rinhlelh a nih chuan a rotate thin.
keyRotation.why: Rotation hian compromise pakhata blast radius a tikhawtlai a ni. Nizan atanga room key ruk chuan vawiin message decrypt chu a titawp ta a ni. Kum 2024 atanga release key rukbo chuan 2026 releases attesting a titawp.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` ah hian server-side rotation logic a awm a. Client lam: `ios/.../Keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt` tih te hi a ni.
keyRotation.how: Room rotation: eng admin pawhin a trigger thei; leave-a rotation pangngai chu automatic a ni. Rotator hian 32-byte root thar a derive a, member la awmte hnenah re-envelope a, envelope thar nen `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` a post thin. Node hian atomic takin `room_keys` a update a, `{type:"k"}` a broadcast bawk.
keyRotation.when: Room: on leave, on admin trigger, ni 7 danah automatic in a awm thin. Device: ni 90 danah default (configurable) a ni. Release: inremna siam nia rinhlelh chungchangah ad-hoc.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=true` — leave-a rotation skip turin off (CPU hniam zawk tan security a tihhniam).
keyRotation.fail1: Rotation laiin client offline: connect leh tur chu a man thei. Node hian last 5 rotations a store avangin reconnect te hian an envelope an zawng fo thin.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelope minting race: admin pahnih chu a rualin an inher a. Node chuan a hmasa ber chu a pawm a, a pahnihnaah chuan 409 Conflict a rawn kir leh ta a ni.
keyRotation.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rotation_duration_seconds` — rotation khatah wall-clock a ni.
keyRotation.tune1: Public room-ah member > 1000 awm thei: Variant-B key publish-ah inthlak rawh. Leave-a rotation chu no-op a lo ni ta a; member-te chuan pubkey signature post chu an ring tlat a ni.
keyRotation.tune2: Hun bituk nei room (e.g. journalism source channel): rotation cadence tawi zawk (nitin emaw darkar tin emaw).
keyRotation.edge1: Midang zawng zawng an chhuah hnuah single-member room: rotation hi a ngai lo nain consistency atan triggered a la ni tho; lone member chuan anmahni tan envelope thar an dawng.
keyRotation.edge2: Owner chhuah: neitu nihna chu admin zawm rei ber hnenah a transfer a; neitu envelope hlui chu tihtawp a ni.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 hi leave-ah chauh rotate a ni. v0.2 hian `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS` hmanga control periodic rotation a dah tel bawk.
keyRotation.ts1: Client-te chu decrypt-ah an tang a: envelope table enfiah; rotation event tihchhuah a nih thu enfiah.
keyRotation.ts2: Rotation hlawhchhamna: a tlangpuiin member slow takah network siam a ni. Retry count chu audit trail ah logged a ni.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Rotation hian message hlui te chu a re-encrypt em? A: Ni lo, ciphertext hlui chu key hlui hnuaiah a awm reng a; client te chuan key hlui te chu an local cache ah historical decryption atan an dah thin.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: User pakhatin vawi 100 zet a join a, a chhuahsan nghal vat a nih chuan engtin nge ni ang? A: Action tin hi a rotate vek. Room lianah chuan hei hi a man to hle — membership event-te chu user pakhat tan 1/min-ah kan rate-limit a ni.

rateLimiting.title: Rate tihkhawtlai a ni
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, hmangtu pakhat, kawng khata token-bucket tihkhawtlai.
rateLimiting.what: Rate limit hi bulk abuse laka invenna ber a ni: brute-force login, registration flood, message spam, file-upload exhaustion.
rateLimiting.why: Limit awm lovin, authenticated abuser tu pawhin disk a exhaust thei a, fan-out a saturate thei a, 4-digit 2FA brute-force thei bawk. Limit hi a man tlawm (check khatah ~10 ns) a ni a, otherwise-trivial attack chu man to takah a chantir thin.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` hian limiter chu a vawng tlat a. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` hi auth route hrang hrangte tana wrapper te tak te a ni.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algorithm pakhatah (scope, key) a awm a. Bucket refills chu rate R, capacity C. Request hian token 1 a mamawh. Bucket hrui hring ⇒ 429. Tracker dahna: node pakhatah in-memory dict; Redis chu `REDIS_URL=...` a nih chuan.
rateLimiting.when: WAF middleware hmanga dilna zawng zawng. Static assets leh health check te tan list skip rawh.
rateLimiting.cfg5: `TESTING=true` hian limit zawng zawng (CI) a titawp vek.
rateLimiting.fail1: Shared NAT (office, school) hnung lama legitimate user chuan per-IP limit a hit — user-facing 429 chu thuchah mawi tak nen.
rateLimiting.fail2: Memory blow-up at huge burst — key hrang hrang 100k-a capped; LRU hnawhchhuah.
rateLimiting.mon1: Counter `vortex_rate_limit_denied_total{scope,key_hash}` — scope hmanga chhut a ni.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — chu 100 μs hnuaiah a awm tur a ni.
rateLimiting.tune1: IP tak tak strip tu CDN hnung lamah: `TRUSTED_PROXIES` set la, chuvangin `X-Forwarded-For` kan chhiar ang. Chutiang a nih loh chuan traffic zawng zawng hian CDN’s egress IP hnuaia limit a hit vek a ni.
rateLimiting.tune2: Volume sang tak nei bots: `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000` hmangin API key pe rawh.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: ISP allocation lian tak tak account turin per-address aiin /64 per kan limit zawk.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor exits: shared exits-a Tor hmangtute hrem loh nan looser limit (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) kan hmang a.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 hian `slowapi` chu decorator-per-route nen a hmang a — centralized middleware atan v0.0.5-ah chuan hman tawh loh a ni.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: proxy config rintlak tak check la, shared-NAT setups check la, legitimate traffic in a rawn hit chuan scope limit bump rawh.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: access logs-a misual IP te enfiah; hard block atan `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var ah dah belh rawh.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Node hrang hrangah limits hi sharded a ni em? A: Single-node mode-ah chuan limit chu per-node a ni. Redis hmang hian cluster pumpuiah limits chu global a ni.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Engtin nge keimah tan hian tam zawk ka pek theih ang? A: Authenticated users te chuan `/api/admin/quota` hmangin quota sang zawk an dil thei ang. Admin-te chuan case-by-case-in an pawm.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji catalog tih a ni
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Emoji 1500 awmna dataset hi client zawng zawngah share a ni.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex hian Unicode-version awm theihnaah innghat lovin a emoji set a thawn chhuak zawk. Emoji 1500 chu category 9 (smiley, mihring, rannung, ei tur, zin, thiltih, thil, chhinchhiahna, flag)-ah dah a ni. iOS (`Emoji/Resources/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), leh web client (`static/assets/emoji.json`)-a hman thin JSON ang chiah kha a ni.
emojiCatalog.why: Consistency: iOS 17-a 🥹 thawntu user chuan Android 9-ah 🥹 angin a render tur a ni a, native system emoji hi kum 1-3 chhungin OS version-ah a diverge a, chuvangin mapping stable reng turin kan ta kan thawn chhuak thin.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON a siam dan: `{category: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Client te hian startup ah an load a, search index ah an flatten a, LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid hmangin an render thin.
emojiCatalog.when: App start ah leh user in picker a hawn apiangin. MRU list hi UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage ah a awm reng a ni.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Tun hnaia cap: iOS-ah 30, Android-ah 30, web-ah 20.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Category hrang hrangte chu a hnuaia mi ang hian fix a ni — reordering hian picker layout a tichhia a ni.
emojiCatalog.fail1: User-a OS chu emoji a render thei lo: `?` glyph-ah a tla leh ta. Unicode ≤ 15.0 atang hian codepoint kan thlang a, chu chu tunlai OS zawng zawngin an support a ni.
emojiCatalog.mon1: Pakhatmah. Client lam chauh a ni.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Custom emoji packs: users te chuan sticker packs an install thei a, chu chu a awm dan inang mahse raster images render a ni.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Skin-tone variants: kan catalog hian base emojis chauh a dah a; variant te hi ZWJ sequence hmanga client-side hmanga siam a ni.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Flag emojis: regional-indicator chhinchhiahna pahnih; iOS-ah flag a lang a, Android version thenkhatah chuan letter pair a lang.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 hian emoji-mart upstream atanga emoji.json a hmang a. v0.0.5 forked a ni a, catalog pin nan leh bundle-size avang hian 1500 ah trim a ni.

intro.h3: He reference hi chhiar dan tur
intro.p1: Architex hi declarative UI tawng a ni a, Vortex Mini Apps tan sak a ni. DOM mutate tu JavaScript ziak ai chuan i duh screen i sawifiah a, runtime chuan pixels chu state nen a in sync nghal vek a ni.
intro.p2: Ṭawng hi a te hle a, declaration pali (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), reactive variable tan prefix pakhat (~), leh styling atan operator chain pakhat (::).
intro.p3: HTML + CSS + JS i ziak tawh a nih chuan Architex hi i hre tawh ang mahse boilerplate 10× tlem zawk nen. I la nei lo a nih chuan Architex pawh hi reactive programming lama inhriattirna nêm tak a ni a, a chhan chu a ṭawng a te lutuk a, i lu-ah i vawng vek thei a ni.
intro.p4: He reference-a section tin hian a hmaa mite chu a siam chhuak a ni. Declarative UI framework dang i hriat tawh chuan i duhna hmunah zuang lut rawh; fresh tan i nih chuan top to bottom chhiar rawh.
intro.li1: Declarative — UI siam dan tur step ni lovin a pianzia sawi rawh
intro.li2: Reactive — assignment pakhat hian dependent label, class, node zawng zawng a update vek
intro.li3: Portable — .arx ang chiah hi web, iOS, leh Android host-ah te pawh a kal thei
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + renderer lawng 30 hnuai lam KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex hi domain bik a ni. General-purpose language a thlak dawn lo — mahse chat chhunga screen shipping atan chuan kan tehna framework zawng zawng aiin a rang zawk.
intro.ct2: Language chhunga construct zawng zawng hian runtime primitive pakhatah an map vek a. I sawifiah theih loh magic a awm lo.

syntax.h2: Reactive variable te pawh a awm
syntax.p1: Architex program tin hi top-level declaration pali atanga siam a ni a, chungte chu @screen, @theme, @import, @component, plus @for loop body te an ni. Column 0-ah a intan vek a; a hnuaia indent zawng zawng hi chu block ta a ni.
syntax.p2: Reactive variable te hi ~name tiin ziah a ni — tilde prefix hian tracked cell angin a mark a. ~name hmangin chhiar la, = hmangin assign la, := hmangin compute rawh.
syntax.p3: Components te hi anmahni line-a bare identifier an ni a: text, button, image, col, row, leh a dangte. An dinhmun chungchanga inhnialna chu hetiang hian a lo thleng nghal a ni: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Modifiers te hi :: hnuah an attach thin. I duh ang zat chu i chain thei: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Thiltih chu => hnuah a nung. Arrow khatah action pakhat; arrow tam tak chain: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.
syntax.cc1: // a reactive variable declaration — type chu value atanga infer a ni
syntax.cc2: // type annotation hi optional ni mahse autocomplete + error messages a pui thei
syntax.cc3: // components nest by indentation — level khatah space 2, tab awm lo
syntax.cc4: // modifiers te chu line hmasa lama component ah an attach thin
syntax.cc5: // one action per arrow — arrow tam tak chu line khatah chain la, a hnungzuia i mamawh chuan
syntax.td7: Root of a renderable screen — app tin hian pakhat an nei vek.
syntax.td8: Theme token block — rawng, radii, size te.
syntax.td9: File dang atang chuan @component / @screen declaration te chu la chhuak rawh.
syntax.td10: Reusable component chu parameter hming vuah hmangin define rawh.
syntax.td11: Reactive list element khatah child block pakhat render tur a ni.
syntax.td12: A chunga kan sawi ang bawk khan mahse zero-based index pawh bind bawk.

variables.h1: Reactive variable te pawh a awm
variables.p1: Reactive variable hian value a keng tel a, value thar i ziah hunah a chhiartu zawng zawng chu automatic in a hriattir vek a ni. = hmangin declare la, = hmangin re-assign la, += / -= / *= / /= hmangin update rawh.
variables.p2: Computed variable te hian an value hi expression atanga an lak chhuah a, chu chuan input eng pawh a inthlak apiangin a re-evaluate thin. = ni lovin := hmangin puang rawh. Manual subscription pawh a awm lo, stale-value bug pawh a awm lo.
variables.p3: A hming hnuaiah : Type hmangin type chu annotate rawh. A thlawptu chi hrang hrang: number, string, boolean, array, object. Annotations hi duhthlan theih a ni a; type chu initial value atanga infer a ni.
variables.p4: lowerCamelCase emaw snake_case emaw hmang la; Architex pawhin a enforce lo. Hming tawi takin dah rawh: hming sei tam tak awmna screen chuan indentation a tichhe vek.
variables.p5: Scope: @screen chhunga reactive variable declared chu chu screen taksa chhungah chauh hmuh theih a ni. @theme token hi khawvel pumah hmuh theih a ni.
variables.p6: Lifecycle: screen mount a nih chhung chuan state a nung. Navigating away chuan a tichhe vek a; navigating back chuan initial value ah a siam thar leh thin.
variables.p7: Persistence: screen atanga dam rei zawk tur chuan send(action: "save", data: ~state) call la, bot host chu persist turin phalsak rawh.
variables.cc3: ~items: array = ["a", "b", "c"] tih hi a dik lo a ni.
variables.cc4: ~total := ~count * ~step // computed — pakhat zawk a inthlak chuan a run leh thin
variables.cc5: ~chibai := "Chibai, {~hming}!"  // template string hmanga compute a ni
variables.li1: Reactive cells tan chuan ~ atanga tan tur a ni.
variables.li3: Case-sensitive: ~count leh ~Count te hi a inang lo.
variables.li4: Keywords (on, in, if) hi ~ hnuah pawh reserved a ni.

state.p1: Reactive cell tin hi a enclosing @screen mount a nih chhung chuan an nung vek a ni. Screen hawn hian a declaration te chu chunglam atanga hnuailam thlengin a kalpui a; back() emaw goto() emaw hmanga chhuahsan chuan a tichhe vek.
state.p2: Navigation atanga dam khawchhuahna tur state i mamawh chuan host atang hian derive la: send() hmangin bot ah POST la, open-ah re-fetch la, store(key, value) call hmangin local-ah persist rawh.
state.p3: Resetting: a bul tanna value-ah re-assign leh rawh. Re-assignment hian hna a thawk tawh avangin reset keyword a awm lo; runtime a diffs a, a danglam tawh chauh a re-render leh thin.
state.p4: Derived state chu := hmanga chhut a ni. Architex hian dependency te chu automatic in a track a, chuvang chuan manual in i list lo. Dependency tracking hi property khatah a dik a, object khatah a dik lo.

types.p8: Thudik: value dik lo chu false, 0, "", null, leh empty array / object te an ni. Thil dang zawng zawng hi a dik vek a ni.

modifiers.p1: Modifiers hi :: hnuaiah an lo kal a, chainable an ni reng bawk. Declaration order hriat reng tur a awm lo; buainate hian chhungkaw pakhat chhunga last-writer-wins te chu a chinfel sak thin.
modifiers.p2: Inhlat chhungkua: pad(n) (a sir zawng zawng), pad(x, y) (horizontal, vertical), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS order), gap(n) (naupang inkar), margin(n) (pawn lam kil).
modifiers.p4: Colour chhungkua: color(#rrggbb) (hma lam), bg(#rrggbb) ( hnunglam). An pahnih hian theme token (color(~primary)) leh alpha (#00000080) atan 8-digit hex an pawm a ni.
modifiers.p6: Visibility family: hidden(~flag) chuan flag a dik laiin node a unmount a; visible(~flag) chu a inverse a ni. Unmounted node te hian an DOM an shed — conditional UI hi a man tlawm.
modifiers.p7: Behaviour chhungkua: debounce(ms) on input throttles updates; placeholder("…") hian hint a lantir a; text-a format(kind, arg) hian number ("currency", "percent", "compact") a format a.
modifiers.p8: Ramri / radius: radius(px) chuan corner a round a; border(#rrggbb) hian 1 px stroke a draw a; border(px, #rrggbb) hian thickness a set bawk.
modifiers.li1: Chhungkaw chhunga inrelbawlna hi a pawimawh lo.
modifiers.li2: Color modifiers hian last-writer-wins te chu a chinfel sak thin.

control_flow.p1: Architex hian syntax top level-ah if statement a nei lo. Conditional UI hi hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) modifier hmangin emaw, component value-a ternary expression hmangin emaw a lang chhuak a ni.
control_flow.p2: Ternary hian value pakhat pawm a nihna hmun apiangah hna a thawk a: component argument, modifier argument, computed value.
control_flow.p3: Branch pahnih aia tam tan chuan ternary chu nest rawh. Architex hian right-to-left a parse avangin nesting hian natural takin a chhiar thin.
control_flow.p4: Object pakhat chunga switch ang chi logic neih duh chuan computed lookup: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active] hmang ang che.

reactivity.p4: Computed dependency (~a := ~b + 1 leh ~b := ~a - 1)-a cycle awmte chu declaration hun laiin hmuhchhuah a ni a, error anga report a ni.

errors.p1: Parse error te hi file-load laiin a fire thin. Runtime hian line, column leh hint a report thin. A chhan tlangpui: indent inmil lo, = awm lo, modifier hriat loh, string khar loh.
errors.p2: Evaluation neih laiin runtime error a chhuak thin. A tam zawk chu reactive an ni — expression hian undeclared cell a kawk a, arithmetic-a type mismatch a kawk bawk. Runtime hian a log a, preview-ah banner sen a rawn lang a, chu frame update chu a skip ta a ni.
errors.p3: Modifier errors (modifier hriat loh, argument type dik lo) te chu parse laiin a kang thin. Architex hian forward compatibility humhim nan modifier hriat loh chungchangah a khauh hle.
errors.p4: Debugging: rinhlelh expression chu debug(...)-ah wrap rawh. Runtime hian evaluation zawng zawng chu value thlak danglam lovin console ah a log vek thin. State inthlak danglamna kalpui turin Architex inspector nen pair rawh.
errors.p5: Editor integration: Vortex bot studio-a Architex IDE chuan error awmte chu real time-in a underline a, file chu a save hmain.

bestpractices.cc1: screens chu line 200 hnuaiah dah rawh
bestpractices.cc2: UI repeated chu @component ah extract rawh
bestpractices.cc3: theme token te chu semantically (~primary, ~danger) tiin hming vuah rawh.
bestpractices.cc4: use :: boolean UI atan thup a ni a, ternary text atan ni lovin
bestpractices.cc6: runtime diff arrays ni rawh se — manual bookkeeping tih loh tur
bestpractices.cc7: computed cell-ah template sei tak tak dah rawh
bestpractices.cc8: deep nesting pumpelh rawh — col/row level 3 a tam
bestpractices.cc9: data ni lovin components share nan @import hmang rawh
bestpractices.cc10: responsiveness atan explicit w/h aiin grow + center duh zawk
bestpractices.cc11: state tenau + lian tak hmanga test — list hrui hring, list sei

bestpractices.p1: Architex hian thil awlsam tak chu lawmman a pe a ni. Screen chhiar harsa tia hriat apiang hian nesting level pakhat tam lutuk, inline ternary pakhat tam lutuk emaw, hna pahnih thawk component pakhat emaw a nei vek mai thei.
bestpractices.p2: Ringhlelna i neih chuan extract rawh. 5-line @component chu 30-line @screen block aiin grok a awlsam zawk.
bestpractices.p3: Wrapping ai chuan modifiers duh zawk. A text :: pad(16) hi col :: pad(16)-a phuar ai chuan a tha zawk.
bestpractices.p4: Runtime hian hna chu thawk rawh se. List-a item zawng zawng tan manual hidden flag hi a wasteful — runtime a diff tawh.
bestpractices.p5: Compiler ni lovin chhiartute tan thil hming sawi rawh. ~isLoading > ~l tih a ni.

forms.h4: Error a awm tih a lang
forms.p1: Inputs te hi reactive cell ah kawng hnih in an inzawm a: input ~email. Typing hian cell chu a update a; cell update hian field chu a update thin.
forms.p2: Validation hi computed boolean a ni a: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Error label-ah hidden / visible modifier hmang rawh.
forms.p3: Submit hi button pangngai, chained action nei a ni. disabled(!~formOk) hmanga validation a hlawhchham laiin submission block rawh.
forms.p4: Error display: text emaw label emaw chu visible(!~fieldOk) nen render la, a dik loh hunah chauh a lantir ang. Visual emphasis atan color(~danger) hmang rawh.
forms.p5: Debouncing: :: debounce(300) tih belh la, network-backed validation chu user-in 300 ms a type a chawlhsan hma loh chuan a tikhawtlai ang.
forms.p6: Placeholder: :: placeholder("...") hian cell a khar laiin hint a lantir. Keystroke hmasa berah hint a bo vek.
forms.p7: Input chi hrang hrang: plain input chu text a ni a; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date te hian keyboard leh masking te chu a siamrem thei.
forms.cc3: label "Email dik lo" :: rawng(~hlauhawm) hmuh theih(!~emailOk && ~email != "")
forms.cc6: input ~ zawn :: debounce (300) => send(action: " zawng rawh", q: ~ zawng rawh)
forms.li1: Binding hi kawng hnih a ni — type hian cell a tidanglam a, a lehlamah pawh a tidanglam bawk.
forms.li2: Validation hi computed boolean cell mai a ni.
forms.li3: Visibility modifier hmanga tihsual lantir / thup.
forms.li4: disabled kaltlangin submit button kha disable rawh.
forms.li5: Spam awm loh nan network-backed validation chu debounce rawh.

animations.h1: Implicit transition te chu a awm
animations.p1: Architex hian reactive value in numeric emaw color modifier emaw a drive hian implicit takin a animate thin. Default transition chu 200 ms ease-out a ni. :: animate(ms, curve) hmangin override rawh.
animations.p2: Enter / exit transitions: conditionally rendered node (hidden / visible) te chuan an in leh out a animate thin. :: animate.enter(...) leh :: animate.exit(...) hmangin customize theih a ni.
animations.p3: Curve te chu: ease-out (default), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring te a ni. Spring hian optional stiffness leh damping argument a la a.
animations.p4: Gestures: :: draggable leh :: swipeable te hian platform nena inmil gesture recogniser an dah tel thin. Reactive state nen combine la, drag-ah animate rawh.
animations.p5: Reduced motion: host hian user-in a accessibility setting a zah a. Reduced-motion on a nih chuan animation te chu 100 ms hnuai lamah a tlahniam a, spring curve te chu linear a lo ni ta a ni.
animations.cc1: col :: animate(300, awlsam taka luh theih) bg(~highlight ? ~primary : ~bg)
animations.cc3: text "Ka lawm e" :: animate.enter(400, spring) hmuh theih(~ entir)
animations.cc4: col :: animate.exit(200, awlsam taka luh) thup(~ entir)
animations.li1: A hun chhung chu 200 ms ease-out a ni.
animations.li2: Spring curves hi interactive drag atan chuan natural zawkin a lang.
animations.li3: Reduced-motion host hian engkim a ti tawi vek vek.
animations.li4: Exit transition te hian animation a zawh hma loh chuan unmount an tikhawtlai thin.

performance.p1: Reactivity hi fine-grained a ni: cell thlak danglam chhiartu component chauh re-render. "A thlawna" i ziah engmah hian full tree re-render a tichhuak lo.
performance.p2: Item sang tam tak list pawh a tha khawp mai. Runtime hi element identity hmangin a danglam a, chuvangin prepending chu O(1) a ni. Hrilhfiahna apianga list pumpui ngaihtuah nawn leh thin computed expressions kha pumpelh rawh — hnathawh chu per-item computed cell-ah then rawh.
performance.p3: High-frequency inputs: network call tichhuaktu input eng pawhah :: debounce(ms) hmang rawh. 300 ms hi a dik tlangpui.
performance.p4: Bundle size: Architex parser + renderer hi 30 KB gzipped hnuai lam a ni. Your .arx file adds its own size — keep images out of the bundle and load them by URL.
performance.p5: Profile: Architex inspector chuan per-component render count leh computed-cell evaluation count a entir thin. User interaction pakhatah vawi khat aia tam evaluate tu cell eng pawh hi profiling target a ni.

faq.p1: Q: Architex ah hian app kimchang ka ziak thei ang em? A: Architex hi Mini Apps — chat chhunga awm screen tan siam a ni. Full native app atan chuan SwiftUI / Compose / React i duh a ni.
faq.p2: Q: Flutter nen hian engtin nge a tehkhin theih? A: Flutter hi a zau zawk hle a, mahse runtime a nei ve tho (Dart VM + Skia). Architex hi a te hle a, host primitives hmanga kalpui a ni. Platform lock-in i mamawh chuan Flutter; reach i mamawh chuan Architex.
faq.p3: Q: Engvangin nge if block a awm loh? A: A chhan chu hidden / visible modifiers hian UI conditionals 95%% chu a thianghlim zawk a ni. 5%% dang tan chuan ternary expression hian hna a thawk a ni.
faq.p4: Q: Architex hi open source a ni em? A: Ni e — GitHub repo en rawh. MIT-licensed runtime nei, patent string awm lo.
faq.p5: Q: Native code ka call thei ang em? A: Host-exposed built-ins emaw bot send() action hmang chauhvin. Direct native-bridge hi tumruh takin a support lo — portability a tichhia ang.
faq.p6: Q: Max screen complexity a awm em? A: Runtime hian reactive cell 10 k leh list item 100 k te chu nuam takin a handle thei. Chumi piah lamah chuan screen tam takah break lut rawh.
faq.p7: Q: State ka persist thei em? A: Ni e, store(key, value) (per-Mini-App local) emaw, send(action: "save") emaw hmangin bot (server-side) hmangin.
faq.p8: Q: Offline-ah a thawk em? A: Pure-UI screens tan chuan a ni. Eng thil pawh send() call hian network a mamawh a ni.
faq.p9: Q: Engtin nge custom component hi ka add theih ang? A: Architex chhungah @component emaw, (native primitives i mamawh chuan) Architex host package-ah contribute emaw pawh nise.
faq.p10: Q: Performance overhead vs kut chhuak native? A: A tlangpuiin kutziak SwiftUI / Compose aiin 3-8 %% in a slow zawk. Screen pangngai tan chuan mihring hriat theih loh.

gotchas.p1: Architex hian indent level khatah space 2 a hmang thin. Tabs hi parse laiin reject a ni. IDE tam zawk hi chu automatic in an convert a; beisei loh taka indent error i hmuh chuan mixed whitespace a awm leh awm loh enfiah rawh.
gotchas.p2: Computed expression-a closures chuan reactive cells chu evaluation time-ah a chhiar a, declaration time-ah a chhiar lo. ~a := ~b + 1 hian tuna ~b a hmang fo thin a, declaration-a value a hmang lo.
gotchas.p3: Async send() hian Promise a resolve hunah cell ah a assign a, chu chu multiple sends flight-a a awm chuan out-of-order a ni thei. ~loading flag emaw sequence number emaw hmangin veng rawh.
gotchas.p4: Type coercion: "5" + 1 hian "51" ah a evaluate a, 6 ah a evaluate lo. Number("5") hmang la, cell chu : number tiin annotate bawk ang che.
gotchas.p5: Deeply nested reactive objects: property (~obj.x = 5) mutation hian ~obj chhiartute update a tichhuak lo. Chu ai chuan object pumpui chu re-assign leh rawh.
gotchas.p6: Chhungkaw pakhat chhunga modifier order: color modifier te hian last-writer-wins an resolve thin. Blend beiseiin color(...) pahnih chain suh.
gotchas.p7: @for taksa chu level khata thuk zawka indented tur a ni. Level hnih a naupang chu parse error ni lovin semantic mis-nest a ni — runtime chuan @for unau angin a enkawl a ni.
